https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Lee touts new deposit system as effective in curbing illegal fishing by Chinese vessels
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: President Lee Jae Myung on Thursday touted a tightened deposit system introduced by the Coast Guard, saying it has been significantly effective in curbing illegal fishing by Chinese vessels.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 李在明总统周四赞扬海岸警卫队推出的收紧存款制度，称该制度在遏制中国船只非法捕捞方面成效显著。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung on Thursday touted a tightened deposit system introduced by the Coast Guard, saying it has been significantly effective in curbing illegal fishing by Chinese vessels. Lee made the remarks in a post on his X account, sharing a news report that an increasing number of Chinese fishermen have given up their boats and abandoned illegal operations due to the financial burden since the Coast Guard began requiring deposits of up to 1.5 billion won ($1.1 million) in May from Chinese vessels caught fishing illegally. The Coast Guard requires the deposits in exchange for the release of Chinese vessels caught fishing illegally and their crew members. Previously, the maximum deposit was capped at 300 million won. Illegal Chinese fishing has increased in South Korea's exclusive economic zone in recent years, with the Coast Guard seizing 57 illegal Chinese fishing vessels last year

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Income gap widens as earnings from work fall 9.2% for lowest-income households Real household income in Korea fell for the first time in 10 quarters in the third quarter, according to data released Thursday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Adjusted for inflation, however, it fell 2.1 percent, the first decline since the first quarter of 2024, when real household income fell 1.6 percent.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 随着劳动收入下降9.2%，最低收入家庭收入差距扩大。根据数据与统计部周四发布的数据，韩国实际家庭收入第三季度出现10个季度以来首次下降。不过，经通胀因素调整后，实际家庭收入下降2.1%，这是自2024年第一季度以来的首次下滑，当时实际家庭收入下降1.6%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Income gap widens as earnings from work fall 9.2% for lowest-income households Real household income in Korea fell for the first time in 10 quarters in the third quarter, according to data released Thursday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The decline came even as the economy grew 3.4 percent in the quarter, buoyed by a semiconductor boom, and was expected to expand in the high 3 percent range this year. The benefits of economic growth were uneven across households. Lower-income families earned less from work and received less in transfers while facing higher interest payments, further widening the income gap. Average monthly household income rose 0.8 percent from a year earlier to 5.48 million won ($4,080), the data showed. Adjusted for inflation, however, it fell 2.1 percent, the first decline since the first quarter of 2024, when real household income fell 1.6 percent. The decline stands in contrast to the rise in real gross domestic product (GDP), which grew 3.4 percent over the same period. Disposable income, what households have left to spend or save after taxes and other non-consumption expenses, also fell across all income quintiles, with the monthly average dropping 1.7 percent from a year earlier to 4.3 million won. The decline came as non-consumption expenses, including interest payments, taxes and transfers to other households, climbed 11 percent, while household income rose 0.8 percent. With the Bank of Korea raising its benchmark rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 3.25 percent on Thursday, debt-servicing costs are likely to put further pressure on household budgets. The figures highlight the gap between the country’s headline growth and the incomes of small businesses, self-employed workers and households. Growth driven by exports and investment has yet to translate into higher household incomes and greater spending power. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il acknowledged the uneven recovery at a press briefing on Monday. warning that the semiconductor sector’s growing weight in the economy could “widen the gap between industries and leave the country more exposed to external shocks.” “People’s livelihoods are not improving as quickly as the economy is recovering,” he said. The divide was especially stark between the top and bottom 20 percent of households by income, with the gap between the two groups widening. Average monthly income among the bottom 20 percent fell 2.7 percent from a year earlier to 1.28 million won, making it the only income group to see a decline. By contrast, average monthly income among households in the top 20 percent rose 1.4 percent to 11.7 million won. Despite an overall rise in household earnings from work, monthly earned income for the bottom 20 percent fell 9.2 percent year-on-year to 248,000 won. The top 20 percent saw their earned income rise 4.9 percent to 8.33 million won a month. Households in the bottom 20 percent also continued to run a deficit, with monthly outlays exceeding disposable income by an average of 344,000 won. Their deficit widened by 32.1 percent from a year earlier. Park Soon-ok, who is in charge of household income and expenditure statistics at the ministry, attributed the drop in income among the lowest-income households in part to a change in the group’s composition. “The share of wage-earning households in the bottom income group fell significantly, while that of households without employed members increased,” she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 尽管芯片出口繁荣，实际家庭收入仍下降
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 最低收入家庭劳动所得下降9.2%，收入差距扩大。韩国数据与统计部周四发布的数据显示，第三季度韩国家庭实际收入10个季度以来首次下降。尽管半导体产业繁荣推动经济在该季度增长3.4%，且预计今年经济增速将处于3%高位区间，经济增长带来的利益在各家庭之间却分布不均。低收入家庭劳动所得减少，领取的转移支付也减少，同时还要面对更高的利息支出，进一步扩大了收入差距。数据显示，家庭月均收入同比上涨0.8%，达到548万韩元（$4,080）。但经通胀因素调整后，实际收入下降2.1%，这是自2024年第一季度以来首次下降；当时实际家庭收入降幅为1.6%。实际家庭收入的下降与实际国内生产总值（GDP）的增长形成鲜明对比，后者同期增长3.4%。可支配收入，即家庭缴纳税款和支付其他非消费支出后剩余、可用于消费或储蓄的收入，也across all income quintiles出现下降，月均值同比减少1.7%，降至430万韩元。非消费支出，包括利息支出、税款以及对其他家庭的转移支付，增长了11%，而家庭收入仅增长0.8%。韩国央行周四将基准利率上调0.25个百分点至3.25%，偿债成本可能进一步挤压家庭预算。这些数字凸显了该国整体经济增长与小企业、个体经营者及家庭收入之间的差距。由出口和投资拉动的增长尚未转化为更高的家庭收入和更强的消费能力。财政部长李炯烈周一在新闻发布会上承认复苏不均衡，并警告称，半导体行业在经济中的权重不断上升，可能“扩大行业间的差距，并使国家更容易受到外部冲击”。他说：“随着经济复苏，民生改善的速度并没有同样快。”按收入划分，位居最高和最低20%的家庭之间差距尤其明显，两组之间的鸿沟进一步扩大。最低20%家庭的月均收入同比下降2.7%，降至128万韩元，成为唯一收入下降的群体。相比之下，最高20%家庭的月均收入增长1.4%，达到1170万韩元。尽管家庭劳动所得总体上升，最低20%家庭的月劳动所得仍同比下降9.2%，降至24.8万韩元。最高20%家庭的月劳动所得增长4.9%，达到833万韩元。最低20%家庭也继续出现赤字，月均支出比可支配收入高出34.4万韩元，赤字较上年同期扩大32.1%。该部负责家庭收入和支出统计工作的朴顺玉将最低收入家庭收入下降部分归因于该群体构成的变化。她说：“最低收入组中，有工资收入家庭的占比大幅下降，而没有就业成员家庭的占比则上升。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title: Korea challenges US claims of state-led overcapacity
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary: Korea is pushing back against Washington's claim that its industrial policies are contributing to structural excess capacity in manufacturing, as a new U.S. tariff investigation raises concerns over whether support for domestic semiconductor production could face further trade pressure.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 韩国正反驳华盛顿的说法，即韩国的产业政策正在加剧制造业结构性产能过剩。随着美国启动新的关税调查，支持韩国国内半导体生产是否会面临进一步贸易压力的问题引发关注。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korea is pushing back against Washington's claim that its industrial policies are contributing to structural excess capacity in manufacturing, as a new U.S. tariff investigation raises concerns over whether support for domestic semiconductor production could face further trade pressure. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said Thursday that it disagrees with much of the evidence cited by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR), arguing that Korea's industrial policies are driven by market demand and companies' investment decisions rather than government efforts to expand production beyond actual demand. It emphasized that it would seek to preserve the 15 percent tariff ceiling agreed under last year’s bilateral trade deal. “There are substantial parts of the report cited by the USTR that we cannot agree with. Korea’s industrial policies are based on a market economy and driven by companies’ investment demand. Government support is focused on strengthening companies’ core capabilities and building broader infrastructure. Our position is that this cannot be viewed as structural oversupply led by the state,” a ministry official said during a briefing. “There are also aspects of the U.S. argument that we believe lack a sound logical basis or are not well-founded, and we will actively convey our position on these points to the U.S. side.” The ministry's response came after the USTR announced Wednesday (local time) that it had found 14 economies, including Korea, engaged in practices contributing to excess manufacturing capacity and proposed additional tariffs under its trade law, Section 301. USTR Jamieson Greer specifically criticized Korea's government support and infrastructure plans, arguing they would expand overseas supply without generating corresponding demand. "These are the types of things that are not responding to actual demand. They are government interventions and they are increasing supply overseas without actually increasing consumption overseas," Greer said in an interview with CNBC following the announcement. The USTR's investigation report cited Korea's planned semiconductor cluster in the Jeonnam-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City region as an example of government-backed efforts to expand manufacturing capacity. It also scrutinized state support for the automotive industry and Seoul's handling of persistent oversupply in the petrochemical sector. The ministry said it had also emphasized to Washington that Korea's exports and investments in the United States contribute to American manufacturing competitiveness and supply chain stability. It submitted written comments, held consultations with the USTR and presented its position at public hearings as part of its efforts to challenge the findings. While the USTR proposed a tariff rate of up to 15 percent on Korean goods, it warned that the rate could rise to 25 percent if consultations fail to produce satisfactory results or Korea does not fulfill its commitments. The proposal is subject to further public consultation, with written comments due Jan. 5 and a public hearing scheduled for Jan. 25. Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan noted that the U.S. side had reaffirmed ahead of the announcement that it would respect the bilateral tariff agreement in determining the final rate. “If we can ultimately maintain the 15 percent rate, I think that would be more than a good result,” Kim said. The ministry said that the government is not considering major changes to its industrial policies in response to the U.S. allegations, adding it will work with other ministries and industry groups to prepare counterarguments to the USTR’s claims in the report. Industry experts, however, said Korea would need to remain mindful of Washington's concerns while continuing its domestic investment plans. Lee Jong-hwan, a professor of system semiconductor engineering at Sangmyung University, said the U.S. criticism also reflects Washington's desire to attract more semiconductor investment. “The U.S. has consistently applied pressure for the same reason: It wants more investment in semiconductor production facilities on its soil," the professor said. “In reality, we cannot completely ignore the U.S. government's position.” He said Korea should proceed with its planned semiconductor investments to maintain its technological lead over China and U.S. competitors, while taking a flexible approach to additional investment in the U.S. "Korea's planned investments at home must go ahead … In semiconductors, making investments ahead of demand is important. It is crucial to check and secure mass-production readiness in advance," he said. “At the same time, given the pressure from the U.S., we need to respond flexibly by consulting with the U.S. government on investments that could bring more semiconductor production lines to the country.” Jang Sang-sik, head of trade trend analysis at the Korea International Trade Association, said Korea should emphasize that its growing trade surplus with the U.S. reflects strong American demand for semiconductors used to support the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, rather than deliberate excess production. "Korea needs to emphasize that its trade surplus has grown because semiconductor exports are supporting the U.S. AI industry," he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 韩国反驳美国有关国家主导产能过剩的说法
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国正反驳华盛顿关于其产业政策导致制造业结构性产能过剩的说法。美国启动新的关税调查，引发外界担忧：支持韩国国内半导体生产的措施是否会面临进一步贸易压力。韩国贸易、工业和资源部周四表示，不认同美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）所引证据中的大部分内容，认为韩国的产业政策由市场需求和企业投资决策推动，并非政府试图将产能扩大至实际需求之上。该部强调，将努力维持去年韩美双边贸易协议约定的15%关税上限。一名该部官员在记者会上说：“USTR所引报告中相当一部分内容，我们无法认同。韩国的产业政策以市场经济为基础，由企业的投资需求驱动。政府支持的重点是增强企业的核心能力和建设更完善的基础设施。我们的立场是，这不能被视为由国家主导的结构性供应过剩。”该官员说：“美国论点中也有一些方面缺乏可靠的逻辑依据或依据不足，我们将积极向美方说明我们在这些问题上的立场。”此前，USTR于周三当地时间宣布，已认定包括韩国在内的14个经济体存在助长制造业产能过剩的做法，并依据其贸易法《第301条》提议加征关税。USTR代表杰米森·格里尔特别批评韩国的政府支持和基础设施计划，认为这些计划将在扩大海外供应的同时，却无法创造相应需求。格里尔在公告后接受CNBC采访时说：“这些事项并不回应实际需求，而是政府干预。它们在未实际扩大海外消费的情况下增加了海外供应。”USTR的调查报告将韩国计划在全南－光州特别 Metropolitan City 地区建设的半导体集群列为政府支持扩大制造业产能的实例。报告还审查了韩国政府对汽车业的支持，以及首尔如何应对石化行业长期存在的供应过剩。该部表示，它也曾向华盛顿强调，韩国对美国的出口和投资有助于提升美国制造业竞争力和供应链稳定性。为挑战调查结论，该部提交了书面意见，与USTR举行磋商，并在公开听证会上陈述立场。USTR虽然提议对韩国商品加征最高15%的关税，但警告称，如果磋商未能取得满意结果或韩国不履行承诺，税率可能升至25%。该提案还将进一步征求公众意见，书面意见截止日期为1月5日，公开听证会定于1月25日举行。产业部长金正官指出，美方在公告前已重申，将在确定最终税率时遵守双边关税协议。金正官说：“如果我们最终能够维持15%的税率，我认为这将是再好不过的结果。”该部表示，政府不打算因美国的指控而对产业政策作出重大调整，并称将与其他部委和行业团体合作，准备反驳USTR报告中的相关主张。然而，产业专家表示，韩国在继续推进国内投资计划的同时，仍需关注华盛顿的担忧。上明大学系统半导体工程教授李钟焕表示，美国的批评也反映出华盛顿希望吸引更多半导体投资的意图。这名教授说：“美国一直出于同样原因施压：它希望更多半导体生产设施投资落户美国。现实中，我们不能完全无视美国政府的立场。”他说，韩国应继续推进计划中的半导体投资，以保持相对于中国和美国竞争对手的技术领先，同时对在美追加投资采取灵活做法。李钟焕说：“韩国计划中的本土投资必须继续推进……在半导体领域，提前投资很重要。提前检查并确保具备量产能力至关重要。”他补充道：“与此同时，鉴于美国施加的压力，我们需要灵活应对，就可能为美国带来更多半导体生产线赴美投资的事宜与美国政府进行磋商。”韩国国际贸易协会贸易趋势分析主管张相植表示，韩国应强调，其对美贸易顺差增长反映的是美国对人工智能（AI）产业所用半导体的强劲需求，而非蓄意的过剩生产。他说：“韩国需要强调，贸易顺差增长是因为半导体出口在支持美国人工智能产业。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: PM expresses gratitude to CSAT supervisors, promises to look for ways to lessen burden next year
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook expressed gratitude Thursday to test supervisors at last week's annual college entrance exam, saying they must have remained on edge throughout the test due to a series of measures added to prevent cheating and that the government will look for ways to minimize their burden next year.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 首相韩成淑周四向上周年度大学入学考试监考人员表示感谢。她说，为防止作弊而采取的一系列措施使监考人员在整个考试期间想必始终绷紧了神经，政府将在明年寻找减轻其负担的办法。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook expressed gratitude Thursday to test supervisors at last week's annual college entrance exam, saying they must have remained on edge throughout the test due to a series of measures added to prevent cheating and that the government will look for ways to minimize their burden next year. Thousands of additional personnel, usually school teachers, were mobilized to supervise the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), known as Suneung in Korean, to enforce a series of anti-cheating measures, including checking test-takers' glasses and clothing. "This year's Suneung was an unfamiliar experience for both students and teachers," Han said on X. "As teachers checked the students' glasses and clothing, they likely remained on edge until the very end, anxious about whether anything had been overlooked, yet equally concerned that an unnecessary suspicion might hurt a student's feelings." "When you receive notice of your supervisor assignments next year, we want you to feel more at ease than you did this year, and to that end, we will explore ways to minimize the responsibilities placed on supervisors," she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 总理向中央中等教育考试监考人员致谢，承诺寻找减轻明年负担的办法
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国总理韩升淑周四向上周年度大学入学考试监考人员表示感谢。她说，为防止作弊，政府采取了一系列措施，监考人员想必在整个考试期间都保持着紧张状态；政府明年将寻找办法，尽量减轻监考人员的负担。数千名增派人员——通常是学校教师——被动员监考大学修学能力试验（CSAT），该考试在韩语中称为“修能”。为执行一系列防作弊措施，他们需要检查考生的眼镜和服装。韩升淑在X上表示：“今年对考生和教师来说，修能考试都是一次陌生的经历。”“当教师检查学生的眼镜和服装时，他们很可能一直紧张到最后，担心是否遗漏了什么，同时又担心不必要的怀疑会伤害学生的感情。”“明年，当你们收到监考任务的分配通知时，我们希望你们能比今年更加安心。为此，我们将探索减轻监考人员职责的方法。”她说。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——中国消费者权益倡导者王海花了30年时间揭露假冒商品，并为购买者争取赔偿。近几个月来，他因担心成为当局打击目标而离开中国，如今却与家人滞留在韩国，并可能遭遣返回国。他说，即使身在中国境外，他也担心遭到中国当局逮捕，因此他和家人大部分时间都待在韩国的室内。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — Chinese consumer rights advocate Wang Hai has spent three decades exposing counterfeit goods and seeking compensation for buyers. In recent months, he left China fearing he was a target of the authorities, but now he is stranded in South Korea with his family, facing possible deportation home. Wang, a well-known campaigner against counterfeit goods, said China invalidated his passport and South Korean authorities rejected his asylum. The United States also revoked his tourist visa, narrowing his options for leaving South Korea and deepening his fears of being sent back to China. Wang said the arrests made him fear he could be next, prompting him to leave a country where official Chinese media had once praised him for his role as anti-counterfeiting activist. China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs told The Associated Press it was not aware of Wang’s case. The Ministry of Public Security did not respond to a request for comment. The quagmire in which Wang, 53, and his family have found themselves has drawn concerns from rights advocates over China’s efforts to target critics abroad and the narrowing options for people seeking refuge in the U.S. Wang spoke to the AP from South Korea about his situation and has appealed the rejection of his asylum application in that country. The activist fears he will end up in jail if deported to China The activist said that he arrived in South Korea in late September with his wife, 8-year-old daughter and infant son. Wang said he believed Chinese authorities were targeting him and that dozens of his staff members were arrested and questioned. Some remain in detention, he said. One staffer had his passport revoked while traveling from Thailand to Singapore last month, according to him. “The very same job has suddenly morphed from being praised into something associated with organized crime — it’s absolutely surreal," said Wang. A notice reviewed by AP showed South Korean immigration authorities rejected Wang's and his family's applications for refugee status. AP also reviewed the U.S. Embassy email that revoked his visa, in which U.S. authorities told Wang that new information made him inadmissible to the U.S. or ineligible for a U.S. visa but did not provide specific details. The U.S. State Department didn't immediately respond to the request for comment. Wang became a household name in China in the 1990s for exposing counterfeit goods, an increasingly widespread problem as the country’s market economy expanded rapidly and consumer protection oversight lagged. In 1998, Wang joined a roundtable discussion with then-U.S. President Bill Clinton during his visit to Shanghai. Wang told Clinton he had been viewed as “immoral” at home, according to a White House transcript. Chinese state media, however, largely portrayed him favorably, calling him “China’s No. 1 anti-counterfeiting activist.” Professional consumer advocates were compared to “woodpeckers,” rooting out problems in the marketplace. Wang ran a rights-protection company in Beijing for about 30 years and a testing laboratory supporting anti-counterfeiting work for five years. He said both were forced to close after many of his staff, including three lawyers, were arrested in September. The closure of his offices came after China launched its campaign against organized crime. Authorities said some people were using consumer complaints, lawsuits or threats of exposure to extort money from businesses through what officials called “malicious compensation claims.” Some lawyers say consumer rights advocates play a positive role by exposing illegal practices, pressing businesses to address problems and helping authorities enforce regulations. “The fact that some individuals engage in these activities as a profession or as a source of income does not invalidate the legitimacy of such social oversight itself,” said Zhang Yansheng, a Beijing-based lawyer. Wang’s consumer advocacy began more than three decades ago, when he suspected two pairs of Sony headphones he bought at a Beijing department store were counterfeit. He bought the remaining 10 pairs and secured compensation of twice the purchase price. It was widely celebrated on Chinese state media as a pioneering case of consumer activism. He went on to run his own company and testing lab, helping consumers seek compensation and pushing for stronger consumer protections. Wang and other advocates also pushed for a minimum compensation payment of 500 yuan ($75) for consumers, a proposal later incorporated into a revised consumer protection law in 2013. His most recent case involved helping cherry farmers in the northeastern city of Dalian get compensation after they bought fake pesticide. He said Dalian police later arrested and detained around four dozens of people including the cherry farmers, two lawyers who represented the farmers, and Wang's staff. After his U.S. visa was revoked, Wang is seeking resettlement in Canada with the help of a human rights organization. Fearing arrest by Chinese authorities even outside China, he said he and his family mostly stay indoors in South Korea. He said his bank accounts in China have been frozen, leaving the family in financial difficulty, and his 8-year-old daughter is struggling with her mental health because she cannot attend school
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 中国消费者权益倡导者滞留韩国，中国打击活动人士的行动波及韩国
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——中国消费者权益倡导者王海花了30年时间揭露假冒商品并为消费者争取赔偿。近几个月来，他因担心成为当局的目标而离开中国，但如今与家人困在韩国，可能被遣返回国。打击假冒商品活动的知名倡导者王海说，中国注销了他的护照，韩国当局拒绝了他的庇护申请。美国也撤销了他的旅游签证，使他离开韩国的选择进一步减少，也加深了他被送回中国的担忧。王海说，这些逮捕事件令他担心自己可能成为下一个目标，促使他离开这个中国官方媒体曾因其反假冒活动而赞扬他的国家。中国外交部告诉美联社称，不知道王海的案件。公安部没有回应置评请求。王海53岁，与家人陷入的这场困境引发了权益倡导者对以下问题的担忧：中国试图针对海外批评人士，以及寻求在美国避难者的选择越来越少。王海在韩国接受了美联社采访，介绍了自身处境，并已就该国拒绝其庇护申请提出申诉。这名活动人士担心，如果被遣返回中国，他最终会入狱。他说，自己是9月底与妻子、8岁女儿和年幼的儿子抵达韩国的。王海认为，中国当局正在针对他，他的数十名工作人员遭到逮捕和讯问。他说，其中一些人仍被拘押。据他所说，一名工作人员上个月从泰国前往新加坡期间，其护照被注销。王海说：“完全相同的工作突然从备受赞扬变成了与有组织犯罪有关的事情——这绝对荒诞不经。”美联社查阅的一份通知显示，韩国移民当局拒绝了王海及其家人的难民身份申请。美联社还查阅了美国驻韩国大使馆撤销其签证的邮件，美国当局在邮件中告诉王海，新信息使他不具备进入美国的资格或无法获得美国签证，但没有提供具体细节。美国国务院没有立即回应置评请求。20世纪90年代，随着中国市场经济迅速扩张而消费者保护监管滞后，假冒商品问题日益普遍，王海因揭露假冒商品而在中国家喻户晓。1998年，时任美国总统比尔·克林顿访问上海期间，王海参加了与克林顿的一场圆桌讨论。据白宫文字记录，王海告诉克林顿，自己在国内曾被视为“不道德”。然而，中国官方媒体总体上以正面形象描绘他，称他为“中国头号反假冒倡导者”。人们把职业消费者权益倡导者比作“啄木鸟”，负责找出市场中的问题。王海在北京经营一家权益保护公司约30年，还经营一家支持反假冒工作的检测实验室达5年。他说，9月包括3名律师在内的许多工作人员被捕后，两家机构被迫关闭。他的办公室关闭之前，中国发起了打击有组织犯罪的行动。当局称，有些人利用消费者投诉、诉讼或曝光威胁，通过官员所称的“恶意索赔”向企业勒索钱财。一些律师表示，消费者权益倡导者通过揭露违法行为、敦促企业解决问题并协助当局执行法规，发挥了积极作用。北京律师张彦生说：“某些人以这些活动为职业或收入来源，并不会使此类社会监督本身的正当性失效。”王海从事消费者权益倡导活动已有30多年。起点是他怀疑自己在北京一家百货商店购买的两副索尼耳机是假货。他买下余下10副耳机，并获得了相当于购买价两倍的赔偿。中国官方媒体广泛将此事报道为消费者行动的先驱案例。此后，他创办了自己的公司和检测实验室，帮助消费者争取赔偿，并推动加强消费者保护。王海和其他倡导者还主张，消费者至少应获得500元（75美元）的赔偿，该提案后来被纳入2013年修订的消费者权益保护法。他最近办理的一起案件，是帮助中国东北城市大连的樱桃种植户在买到假农药后获得赔偿。他说，大连警方随后逮捕并拘留了约40人，其中包括樱桃种植户、代表种植户的律师以及王海的工作人员。美国签证被撤销后，王海正在一家人权组织的帮助下寻求移居加拿大。他说，即使身在中国境外，也担心被中国当局逮捕，因此他和家人大多数时间待在室内。他说，自己在中国的银行账户已被冻结，令家庭陷入经济困境；8岁的女儿因无法上学而心理健康状况持续恶化

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Kookmin University co-hosts conference commemorating independence activist Scholars from Korea, China and Japan will gather Friday for an international academic conference commemorating Korean independence activist Ahn Jung-geun. The conference will be co-hosted by Kookmin University and the Korea-China Civilian Standing Committee for the Search for Ahn Jung-geun, with support from the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 国民大学联合主办纪念独立运动活动者的会议：来自韩国、中国和日本的学者将于周五举行一场国际学术会议，纪念韩国独立运动活动者安重根。此次会议由国民大学与韩中安重根查明真相和平民间联合委员会共同主办，并得到韩国祖国和退伍军人事务部的支持。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Kookmin University co-hosts conference commemorating independence activist Scholars from Korea, China and Japan will gather Friday for an international academic conference commemorating Korean independence activist Ahn Jung-geun. The conference will be co-hosted by Kookmin University and the Korea-China Civilian Standing Committee for the Search for Ahn Jung-geun, with support from the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs. The conference will open with an address by Chung Sye-kyun, chairman of the Ahn Jung-geun Memorial Association, followed by remarks from Jung Tae-ho, co-chair of the National Assembly Caucus for the Exhumation and Repatriation of Ahn Jung-geun’s Remains. Kwon Oh-eul, minister of patriots and veterans affairs, will deliver a welcoming speech, followed by opening remarks from Hwang Ki-chul, chairman of the civilian committee. “At this conference, we plan to compare and analyze the perspectives of Korea, China and Japan on Ahn Jung-geun’s martyrdom in 1910, drawing on contemporary sources to trace the historical development of commemorations honoring him,” said Hwang Sun-ik, a professor in Kookmin University’s Department of Korean History. “I hope the conference will help uncover clues that could lead to the exhumation and repatriation of Ahn’s remains,” added Hwang, who also heads the university’s Institute of Korean Studies. Ahn Jung-geun assassinated Ito Hirobumi, a former Japanese prime minister and resident-general of Korea, in Harbin, China, in 1909. He was later imprisoned and executed by Japanese authorities at Lushun Prison in 1910
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 来自3个国家的学者将讨论安重根的遗产及遗骸搜寻问题
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 国民大学共同主办纪念韩国独立运动活动人士的会议。来自韩国、中国和日本的学者将于周五齐聚一堂，参加纪念韩国独立运动人士安重根的国际学术会议。会议由国民大学与 searches for 安重根韩中民间协议会共同主办，并得到国家抚恤与退伍军人事务部的支持。会议将以安重根 Memorial Association 会长丁世均的致辞开幕，随后由韩国国会议员团安重根遗骨挖掘与归还共同主席郑泰浩发表讲话。国家抚恤与退伍军人事务部长权五日将发表欢迎辞，之后是民间委员会会长黄基哲的开幕致辞。国民大学韩国史系教授黄勋益说：“在这次会议上，我们计划借助当时的资料，追溯纪念安重根活动的历史发展，并比较、分析韩国、中国和日本对安重根于1910年殉难的看法。”他还说：“希望这次会议能发现有助于挖掘并迎回安重根遗骨的线索。”黄勋益同时担任该大学韩国研究所所长。1909年，安重根在中国哈尔滨刺杀了曾任日本首相、驻韩总督的伊藤博文。此后，他被日本当局关押，并于1910年在旅顺监狱被处决。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: FM nominee says Korea-US alliance 'strong enough to overcome any difficulty'

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul on Thursday called for efforts to ease tensions with Russia, after Russian warplanes flew into Korea's air defense zone and almost breached its territorial airspace earlier this week. Two Russian Tu-160 supersonic strategic bombers and two other fighter jets entered Korea's air defense identification zone (KADIZ) in the East Sea early Tuesday. They came within about 1 kilometer of the airspace over Ulleung Island off the east coast, prompting the Korean Air Force to scramble fighter jets in response. Seoul has lodged a strong protest with the Russians over their repeated unannounced and unauthorized entry into KADIZ. "I believe we need to make efforts to ease tensions at this point," Kang said during a parliamentary session. "While we maintain communication channels with Russia, I believe we should do more." Kang said Seoul clearly conveyed to the Russian side the need for an advance notice and coordination in case of flying any military plane near the Korean territory so as to avoid any accidental clash. "Issues such as entering KADIZ during drills must be thoroughly discussed beforehand. We plan to continue making efforts going forward," he said. Asked by a lawmaker if Russia's newest Su-57 stealth fighter was among the warplanes that flew into KADIZ on Tuesday, Kang confirmed it was not one of them. "It was unusual for (the aircraft) to come that close to our airspace, so we do not see it as an intentional act," he said. The defense ministry has called in Russia's military attache in Seoul and lodged a strong protest. The foreign ministry also reportedly called in a senior diplomat from the Russian Embassy to discuss the matter. At Thursday's session, the National Assembly's defense committee passed a motion to expand the operational scope of the Cheonghae anti-piracy unit, currently operating off the Somali coast, to south of Oman in the Arabian Sea, about 650 kilometers away from the Strait of Hormuz. The motion, which extends the existing deployment for another year through Dec. 31, 2027, carries a supplementary opinion stating that the naval unit will not get involved or intervene in any war or military operations between specific countries. "This makes it clear that the mission does not constitute entering a war," Rep. Kim Byung-joo of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea said. The supplementary opinion was attached amid concerns that the expanded mandate could draw the unit into the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, sparking backlash from the opposition that has branded it as a disguised troop deployment to the U.S.-Iran war. The added clause also pledges to prioritize troop safety, stipulating that the lives and safety of the service members must come first when conducting missions with newly added assets, which include unmanned mine-hunting vehicles. Additionally, the supplementary opinion states that the unit will use force strictly in self-defense and that the government will actively coordinate with relevant countries to avoid diplomatic friction. The motion is subject to final parliamentary approval at an upcoming plenary session
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 国防部长呼吁在防空区遭闯入后缓和与俄罗斯的紧张关系
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国国防部长姜信澈周四呼吁 efforts 缓解与俄罗斯的紧张关系。此前，本周早些时候，俄罗斯军机飞入韩国防空区，几乎侵犯其领空。周二凌晨，两架俄罗斯图-160超音速战略轰炸机和另外两架战斗机进入韩国在东海划设的防空识别区（KADIZ）。这些飞机一度距离郁陵岛上空领空约1公里，促使韩国空军紧急升空战斗机应对。首尔已就俄方屡次未经预告和未经许可进入KADIZ向俄罗斯提出强烈抗议。姜信澈在国会会议上说：“我认为，眼下我们需要努力缓解紧张局势。在与俄罗斯保持沟通渠道的同时，我认为我们还应做得更多。”姜信澈表示，首尔已明确告知俄方，若要在韩国领土附近飞行任何军机，须提前通知并做好协调，以避免任何意外冲突。他说：“诸如在演练期间进入KADIZ等议题，事先必须得到充分讨论。我们今后将继续努力。”当议员问及俄罗斯最新的苏-57隐身战斗机是否属于周二飞入KADIZ的军机时，姜信澈确认其中不包括苏-57。他说：“（这些飞机）如此接近我国领空并不寻常，因此我们不认为这是蓄意行为。”国防部已召见俄罗斯驻首尔军方联络官，并提出强烈抗议。据报道，外交部也召见了俄罗斯大使馆的一名高级外交官，讨论此事。周四的会议上，国会国防委员会通过一项决议，将目前部署在索马里海岸外的清海反海盗部队的行动范围扩大至阿曼以南的阿拉伯海域，距霍尔木兹海峡约650公里。该决议将现有部署延长至2027年12月31日，并附有补充意见，指出该海军部队不会介入或干预特定国家之间的任何战争或军事行动。执政的朝鲜民主党议员金炳周说：“这清楚表明，该任务不构成参战。”附加补充意见之际，外界担忧扩大授权可能将该部队卷入中东持续冲突，并引发反对党反弹；反对党将其称为向美伊战争变相派兵。新增条款还承诺把部队安全放在首位，规定使用新增装备执行任务时必须优先保障军人生命与安全；这些新增装备包括无人扫雷车。此外，补充意见规定，该部队仅在自卫时严格使用武力，政府将积极与相关国家协调，避免外交摩擦。该决议尚待即将举行的全体会议上获得国会最终批准

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Hong Ihk-pyo pledges continuity with Chung but signals practical adjustments Unification Minister nominee Hong Ihk-pyo said Thursday that Seoul should break the deadlock with Pyongyang through small, practical steps rather than a push for high-level talks. “Given the current state of inter-Korean relations and the situation on the Korean Peninsula, I think it might be better to start with smaller and more practical steps rather than pursue high-level talks,” Hong said during a doorstep interview in Seoul. Hong, a former presidential secretary and three-term lawmaker, was nominated Monday as part of President Lee Jae Myung's reshuffle of key security posts, a move widely read as an effort to steady ties with Washington after friction over intelligence sharing during Chung Dong-young's tenure. Hong said his focus would be on lowering hostility between the two Koreas. “I will focus on easing and ultimately ending hostility between the two Koreas. I will take small steps to build trust between the South and the North and earn public support by delivering concrete and practical results,” he said. “I will work to protect people’s lives and keep them safe by pursuing peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula. I believe securing peace on the peninsula is the most important task in advancing South Korea’s national interests and I will stay the course in working toward that goal … I won’t rush, but I won’t stop moving forward either.” “I would maintain the broad policy direction set by Unification Minister Chung Dong-young … But I plan to draw on that feedback to build public consensus and make practical policy adjustments where needed,” Hong said, without specifying details. Asked about interagency disagreements that have complicated Seoul's dealings with Washington, Hong said he would work to align the ministries. “What matters most is that we’re all in the same boat as members of the Lee Jae Myung administration. I will work to reconcile different views and weigh practical options to build consensus on the administration’s foreign, security and North Korea policy," he said. The remarks came amid a deadlock in inter-Korean relations following North Korea’s declaration of South Korea as the “most hostile country” and its pledge to treat the two Koreas as separate states, breaking with the previous framework for inter-Korean relations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国统一部长提名人主张先采取小幅措施，而非与朝鲜举行高层会谈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
统一部长提名人洪谟标承诺延续郑东瑛政策，但暗示将作出务实调整

韩国统一部长提名人洪谟标周四表示，首尔应通过小而务实的步骤打破与平壤的僵局，而不是推动举行高级别会谈。洪在首尔接受门外采访时说：“鉴于当前韩朝关系和朝鲜半岛局势，我认为与其推动高级别会谈，不如从规模更小、更务实的步骤入手。”洪曾任总统秘书，并连续三届担任议员；韩国总统李在明周一改组关键安全职位时提名他出任统一部长。此举被普遍解读为，在郑东瑛任内因情报共享问题与华盛顿发生摩擦后，政府试图稳住与美国的双边关系。

洪表示，他将重点关注降低两国之间的敌意。他说：“我将专注于缓和并最终终结两国之间的敌意。我将通过采取小步骤，在南方与北方之间建立信任，并以取得具体、务实的成果来赢得公众支持。我将通过推动朝鲜半岛和平共处，努力保护民众生命安全。我相信，维护半岛和平是推进韩国国家利益最重要的任务，我将坚持朝这一目标努力……我不会操之过急，但也不会停止前进。”

洪说：“我会维持统一部长郑东瑛所确立的总体政策方向……但我计划参考相关反馈，争取公众共识，并在必要时对政策作出务实调整。”他未说明具体调整内容。

谈及令首尔与华盛顿交涉复杂化的跨部门分歧，洪表示 he'll 致力于协调各部门。他说：“最重要的是，作为李在明政府的成员，我们都在同一条船上。我将努力协调不同意见，权衡可行方案，就政府的外交、安全和对朝政策形成共识。”

上述表态正值韩朝关系陷入僵局之际。朝鲜宣布韩国为“最敌对国家”，并承诺将两国视为彼此分离的国家，偏离了此前处理韩朝关系的框架。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 为展示韩国最著名的海藻产区的历史及其烹饪多样性，忠清南道洪成郡近期在首尔开设名为“洪成海鲜市场，你知道紫菜吗？”的快闪展览。展览重点介绍洪成郡广川镇，那里已有40多家企业生产数百种调味紫菜。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: As Korean food gains fans worldwide, "gim," or dried seaweed, has moved from everyday Korean tables to fine dining menus, becoming one of the country’s hottest exports. To highlight the history and culinary versatility behind one of the country’s most recognized seaweed-producing regions, Hongseong County in South Chungcheong Province recently opened a pop-up exhibition titled “Hongseong Seafood Market, Do You Know Gim?” in Seoul. The exhibition focuses on Gwangcheon, a town in Hongseong where more than 40 companies produce hundreds of varieties of seasoned gim. While “Gwangcheon gim” is widely known among consumers, organizers said many people mistakenly view it as a single commercial brand rather than a regional industry built over decades. "This exhibition focuses on gim produced in Gwangcheon to raise awareness of Hongseong’s rich local resources, showing that the region has much more to offer beyond well-known specialties like strawberries," an official from the event organizer said. Displays at the venue trace how Gwangcheon developed into a center for seaweed production despite having limited direct access to the open sea today. Rather than just showing finished packages, the exhibition walks visitors through how local workers turn raw ocean seaweed into seasoned sheets. Photos, maps and sample displays walk visitors through the production process from raw ocean seaweed to packaged sheets. Visitors can also listen to recordings of crispy seaweed, pick up recipe cards for dishes such as cold seaweed soup and seaweed pickles, and browse products from roughly 10 local brands alongside lifestyle goods designed by young creators based in Gwangcheon. The growing international familiarity with Korean seaweed was also visible among visitors browsing the space. A middle-aged couple visiting from the United States stopped to examine the different varieties on display. “We are visiting from the U.S., and we eat gim quite often back home,” the woman said, adding that the pair regularly enjoys dishes such as seaweed rice rolls and roasted seaweed with white rice. Alongside the exhibition and mini-market, the program includes tasting sessions and workshops led by chefs who appeared on the Netflix culinary competition series “Culinary Class Wars,” showcasing ways to incorporate gim into modern brunch and traditional Korean dishes. Local agricultural products from Hongseong, including organic rice, sesame oil and salted shrimp, are also featured at the venue. Organized by the Hongju Culture and Tourism Foundation and Hongseong County’s cultural city center, the event will be held through Sunday
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 首尔展览探讨光川“김”的文化根源
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 随着韩国食品在世界各地赢得粉丝，“gim”（即干海带）已从韩国普通家庭的餐桌走向高级餐厅菜单，成为该国最热门的出口产品之一。为介绍韩国最著名的海带产区的历史及其烹饪多样性，忠清南道洪城县近日在首尔举办了一场名为“洪城海鲜市场，你知道gim吗？”的快闪展览。展览重点介绍洪城县光川镇，当地有40多家企业生产数百种调味gim。尽管“光川gim”在消费者中广为人知，主办方表示，许多人误以为它是一个单一的商业品牌，而不是历经数十年发展起来的区域产业。活动主办方的一名官员说：“本次展览重点展示光川生产的gim，旨在提高人们对洪城丰富本地资源的认识，让人们看到，该地区除了草莓等知名特产之外，还有更多值得探索的特色。”展览现场的展示追溯了光川如何在如今缺乏直接通往外海通道的情况下，逐渐发展为海带生产中心。展览并未止步于展示成品包装，而是带领参观者了解当地工人如何把新鲜海带制成调味海带片。照片、地图和样品展示带领参观者了解从新鲜海带到包装海带片的生产流程。参观者还可以聆听酥脆海带的录音，领取冷海带汤和海带腌菜等菜肴的食谱卡，并浏览约10个本地品牌的产品，以及驻光川的年轻创作者设计的生活方式用品。韩国海带在国际上日益提升的知名度，也体现在到现场参观的人群中。一对从美国来访的中年夫妇停下来查看现场展示的不同品种。那名女子说：“我们从美国来这里，在家经常吃gim。”她还补充说，两人平时经常享用海带饭卷以及搭配白米饭的烤海带等菜肴。展览和迷你市集之外，整个活动还包括品鉴会和工作坊，由曾参加Netflix烹饪竞赛节目“料理大战”的厨师主持，展示如何将gim融入现代早午餐和传统韩国菜肴。现场还展出了来自洪城当地的农产品，包括有机大米、芝麻油和盐渍虾。活动由洪州文化观光财团和洪城县文化城市中心组织，将持续至星期日

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Two candidates were recommended by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and a minor opposition party Thursday to lead a special counsel probe into allegations of fabricated indictments against President Lee Jae Myung, while the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) refused to make a recommendation.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 星期四，执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）和一个小型反对党推荐了两名候选人，负责领导特别检察官调查针对李在明总统捏造起诉书指控一案，而主要反对党人民权力党（PPP）拒绝推荐人选。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Two candidates were recommended by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and a minor opposition party Thursday to lead a special counsel probe into allegations of fabricated indictments against President Lee Jae Myung, while the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) refused to make a recommendation. A special counsel bill was passed by the National Assembly earlier this month and approved by the Cabinet last week, calling for an independent counsel to investigate suspicions that the prosecution under former President Yoon Suk Yeol fabricated evidence or induced false testimonies to build cases against then opposition leader Lee and others. The new special prosecutor is to be chosen by President Lee from among three candidates recommended by the DPK, the PPP and the minor Rebuilding Korea Party. The PPP, however, refused to recommend a candidate, citing concerns over the president appointing a special counsel to investigate cases involving himself and accusing the DPK of seeking to ultimately cancel all indictments against Lee. "There is no reason for us to get involved in a rigged game where the outcome has already been decided," PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sig said during a meeting of the party's supreme council at the National Assembly. The DPK and the Rebuilding Korea Party recommended lawyers Lee Im-seong and Lee Jung-hoon, respectively. President Lee is required to appoint one of the two candidates as the special counsel within three days
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 巴基斯坦人民党拒绝推荐调查涉嫌捏造起诉书案件的特别检察官人选
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 朝鲜民主劳动党（DPK）和一个小反对党周四各推荐了两名候选人，牵头对针对总统李在明的虚假起诉指控展开特别检察官调查，而主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）拒绝推荐。本月早些时候，国会通过了特别检察官法案，内阁上周批准了该法案，要求由独立检察官调查前总统尹锡悦任内的检方是否捏造证据或诱导虚假证词，以针对时任反对党领袖李在明等人的案件。新任特别检察官将由李在明总统从朝鲜民主劳动党、国民力量党和小的重建韩国党各自推荐的3名候选人中选出一人。然而，国民力量党拒绝推荐候选人，理由是担心总统任命特别检察官调查涉及本人的案件，并指责朝鲜民主劳动党试图最终取消针对李在明的所有起诉。国民力量党院内代表郑olitics在国会举行的该党最高委员会会议上说：“我们没有理由参与一场结果早已注定的作弊游戏。”朝鲜民主劳动党和重建韩国党分别推荐了律师李镐成和李正勋。李在明总统须在3天内任命两人中的一人为特别检察官

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 尽管中央银行加息，韩国综合股价指数周四仍小幅上涨0.29%，芯片制造商领涨。韩国综合股价指数开盘上涨1.01%，报4,745.10点，收于4,711.21点。市场广泛预期的加息对投资者情绪似乎影响甚微。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The benchmark KOSPI edged up 0.29 percent Thursday despite the central bank’s rate hike, with chipmakers leading the rebound. The index recouped only a fraction of its loss of more than 6 percent in the previous session. The benchmark KOSPI closed at 4,711.21 after opening 1.01 percent higher at 4,745.10. The index briefly climbed above the 4,800-mark but gave up most of its gains toward the close. Institutional investors led the buying, purchasing a net 750.9 billion won ($560 million), while foreign investors and retail investors recorded net sales of 113.6 billion won and 1.04 trillion won, respectively. Samsung Electronics rose 0.35 percent to close at 171,300 won, while SK hynix gained 2.23 percent to finish at 1,053,000 won. The widely anticipated rate hike appeared to have little effect on investor sentiment. The Bank of Korea (BOK) raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage point to 3.25 percent, citing persistent inflationary pressures and stronger-than-expected economic growth driven by the semiconductor export boom. During a press conference following the rate-setting meeting, BOK Gov. Shin Hyun-song emphasized the importance of semiconductor prices rather than share prices in assessing the industry's outlook. He said that semiconductor companies were expected to generate about 700 trillion won in profits this year, while their combined market capitalization stood at around 2,000 trillion won, or roughly three times that amount. "It is difficult to explain why the market capitalization is only three times the amount of this year's profits," Shin said, adding that stock prices are heavily influenced by investor sentiment. He suggested that the stock market still had considerable room for growth, given the strength of the country's economy. The secondary bourse Kosdaq also gained 0.78 percent to close at 655.71. In the Seoul foreign exchange market, the won strengthened 0.5 won against the U.S. dollar, with the won-dollar exchange rate closing at 1,342.7 won
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 尽管韩国央行加息，韩国综合股价指数仍小幅上涨
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 尽管韩国央行加息，韩国综合股价指数周四仍小幅上涨0.29%，芯片制造商领涨。该指数仅收复了前一交易日逾6%跌幅的一小部分。韩国综合股价指数开盘上涨1.01%，报4,745.10点，收盘报4,711.21点。指数盘中一度升破4,800点，但临近收盘时回吐了大部分涨幅。机构投资者领衔买入，净买入750.9亿韩元（5.6亿美元）；外国投资者和散户分别净卖出113.6亿韩元和1.04万亿韩元。Samsung Electronics上涨0.35%，收于171,300韩元；SK hynix上涨2.23%，收于1,053,000韩元。此次 Widely anticipated 的加息对投资者情绪影响似乎甚微。韩国央行（BOK）将基准利率上调0.25个百分点至3.25%，理由是通胀压力持续，且半导体出口繁荣推动经济增长强于预期。韩国央行行长申铉松在利率决议会议后的新闻发布会上强调，评估该行业前景时应关注半导体价格，而非股票价格。他说，半导体企业今年预计将创造约700万亿韩元利润，而其总市值约为2,000万亿韩元，约为利润的3倍。申铉松表示：“很难解释为何市值仅为今年利润的3倍”，并指出股价深受投资者情绪影响。鉴于该国经济表现强劲，他建议认为股市仍有相当大的上涨空间。第二板市场KOSDAQ也上涨0.78%，收于655.71点。在首尔外汇市场，韩元兑美元升值0.5韩元，韩元兑美元汇率收于1,342.7韩元

A minister-counselor-level diplomat from the Russian Embassy visited the ministry's headquarters earlier in the day, where the two sides discussed the entry of Russian military aircraft into the Korea Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ) and other pending issues, according to the diplomatic sources.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 消息人士称，韩国外交部周四在首尔与俄罗斯大使馆官员举行会谈，讨论本周早些时候俄罗斯军机进入韩国防空区一事。据外交消息人士称，俄罗斯大使馆一名部长级外交官当天早些时候到访外交部大楼，双方讨论了俄罗斯军机进入韩国防空识别区（KADIZ）以及其他悬而未决的问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Korean foreign ministry held talks with a Russian Embassy official in Seoul on Thursday over the entry of Russian military aircraft into the country's air defense zone earlier this week, sources said. A minister-counselor-level diplomat from the Russian Embassy visited the ministry's headquarters earlier in the day, where the two sides discussed the entry of Russian military aircraft into the Korea Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ) and other pending issues, according to the diplomatic sources. On Tuesday, two Tu-160 strategic bombers, capable of carrying nuclear missiles, entered the KADIZ along with Su-35S and Su-30SM fighter jets, approaching to within 1 kilometer of the boundary of Korean airspace near Ulleung Island in the East Sea, according to military authorities here. The Air Force scrambled F-15K fighter jets and other aircraft in response, and the government issued an alert for residents of the eastern island. No airspace violation occurred. Details of Thursday's meeting were not immediately available, though Korea is believed to have reiterated its protest over the incident, following its earlier expression of regret and call for measures to prevent a recurrence. Ministry officials said Thursday's meeting was not a formal summoning, which involves calling in a foreign diplomat to lodge a protest, and more of a working-level consultation. Over the incident, the defense ministry on Tuesday summoned Col. Nikolai Marchenko, Russia's military attache in Seoul, to lodge a formal protest. The foreign ministry also conveyed its regret through diplomatic channels on the same day, stopping short of summoning a Russian diplomat. Russian military aircraft have entered the KADIZ five times so far this year. The latest incident marked the third such entry in a week, and the aircraft came closer to Korean airspace than in any previous incident this year. The KADIZ is not territorial airspace but a zone established to call on foreign aircraft to identify themselves to prevent accidental clashes
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 俄罗斯军机近距离接近后，韩国与俄罗斯讨论KADIZ问题
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 消息人士称，韩国外交部周四在首尔与俄罗斯大使馆官员举行会谈，讨论本周早些时候俄罗斯军机进入韩国防空识别区一事。外交消息人士称，俄罗斯大使馆一名参赞级外交官当天早些时候到访外交部大楼，双方讨论了俄罗斯军机进入韩国防空识别区（KADIZ）以及其他悬而未决的问题。据韩国军方当局消息，周二，两架可携带核导弹的Tu-160战略轰炸机与Su-35S和Su-30SM战斗机一同进入KADIZ，接近至距东海郁陵岛附近韩国领空边界1公里以内。韩国空军紧急升空F-15K战斗机和其他飞机应对，政府还向东部岛屿居民发布警报。此次事件未发生领空侵犯。周四会谈的详情暂未公布，但据信韩国在早前表达遗憾并呼吁采取措施防止事件重演后，再次就此事提出抗议。外交部官员称，周四的会谈并非正式召见。正式召见意味着要求外国外交官前来提出抗议，而此次会谈更接近工作层面的磋商。针对此事，国防部周二召见了俄罗斯驻首尔军事随员Nikolai Marchenko上校，向其正式提出抗议。外交部也在同一天通过外交渠道表达遗憾，但没有召见俄罗斯外交官。俄罗斯军机今年迄今已5次进入KADIZ。最新事件是一周内第三次进入，其军机接近韩国领空的程度超过了今年此前的任何一次。KADIZ并非领空，而是要求外国飞机表明身份以防止意外冲突的识别区

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: [COVER STORY] Gov't weighs banning part-time work for int'l students lacking Korean proficiency
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Foreign students fear financial strain, question Korea's appeal as study destination International students who fall short on Korean language requirements could face a complete ban on part-time work, even if when they were enrolled in English-taught programs. Under the latest draft, students who fail to meet Korean language requirements would lose the existing allowance of 10 hours of part-time work per week, while English proficiency would no longer qualify students for employment.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 外国学生担忧经济压力，并质疑韩国作为留学目的地的吸引力。未达到韩语语言要求的国际学生，即使就读的是英语授课项目，也可能被完全禁止从事兼职。根据最新草案，未能满足韩语语言要求的学生将失去目前每周兼职10小时的许可，英语能力也将不再使学生具备就业资格。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Foreign students fear financial strain, question Korea's appeal as study destination International students who fall short on Korean language requirements could face a complete ban on part-time work, even if when they were enrolled in English-taught programs. The Ministry of Justice is reviewing the measure, along with plans to shorten post-graduation stays for those with limited Korean proficiency. If implemented, the measures would make Korean language skills a key determinant of international students' ability to work and stay in the country. The proposed changes come as Korea reassesses its international student policy amid growing concerns that aggressive recruitment by universities — sometimes involving inducement of guaranteeing part-time work — may come at the expense of educational quality. The number of international students in Korea stood at 307,464 as of April, surpassing the government's 2027 target of 300,000 ahead of schedule. The figure rises to nearly 400,000 when including some 30,000 graduates seeking employment. Under the latest draft, students who fail to meet Korean language requirements would lose the existing allowance of 10 hours of part-time work per week, while English proficiency would no longer qualify students for employment. "We see the primary purpose of English-taught programs as earning a degree or pursuing further studies overseas. From that perspective, we see no need for these students to work part-time," Yong Chang-sig, deputy director of the ministry's visa and residence division, said Wednesday at a policy forum organized by the Korean Council for University Education. The proposal has yet to be finalized, with the ministry considering a grace period of two to three years before implementation. Korean proficiency could also become a key factor in determining the length of post-graduation stays under the D-10 job-seeking visa, which currently allows eligible graduates to remain in Korea for up to three years. "We would grant three years to those who can speak Korean and are capable of finding employment, but we would not guarantee three years to students who neither attend classes nor develop Korean language skills," Yong said. The ministry is also considering easing financial requirements for student visa applicants with stronger Korean language skills while tightening them for those with lower proficiency. The measures reflect the ministry's growing emphasis on international students in Korea's immigration policy. "In the past, our policies focused on managing a small number of students who caused problems," Yong said. "Now, we need to consider whom we should attract, how we should attract them and how we can live together with those who remain here." While the justice ministry is tightening its focus on language proficiency and employment, the Ministry of Education is seeking to hold universities more accountable for the quality of education they provide. Kim Tae-hun, senior deputy director of the international education planning bureau at the education ministry, cited cases of universities attracting international students by advertising programs that require only one day of classes per week, leaving the remaining days for part-time work. "We should be telling students about the quality of our education and what kind of future they can build after earning a bachelor's or master's degree," Kim said. "That is what we tell Korean students. Why are we telling international students something different?" The education ministry plans to unveil its proposed overhaul of the International Education Quality Assurance System between December and January. The system assesses universities' management of international students, with the results affecting visa issuance. The revised system, set to take effect in 2029, would prioritize academic standards, language proficiency and educational outcomes over numerical targets. The ministry is also considering linking the system to institutional accreditation and tightening visa screening for students applying to financially troubled universities. An immigration expert positively viewed the government's policy direction, citing the importance of Korean proficiency in retaining skilled foreign students after graduation. Kim Beom-su, an immigration attorney and affiliated professor at Hanyang University, said the proposed changes reflect Korea's broader immigration policy shift from temporary migration toward long-term settlement. "Given this shift, using Korean proficiency as a measure of immigrants' ability to integrate into Korean society is a reasonable approach," Kim said. He noted that students in English-taught programs and STEM fields have little incentive to learn Korean, with even graduates of leading Korean universities struggling to find jobs due to language barriers. Kim acknowledged that stricter language requirements could hamper STEM recruitment but said linking language skills to job-seeking visas could motivate students to learn Korean. "Students who fail to meet the Korean language requirements could instead turn to unauthorized employment, pushing such activities underground," he said. International students, meanwhile, concerned that the proposed changes could increase financial burdens and make Korea a less attractive study destination. Laylo Akmalova, an Uzbek student at Korea University, said the restrictions would particularly affect students without scholarships, suggesting that they instead be given access to jobs that do not require Korean proficiency. "If it becomes more difficult to work in Korea, some students may decide not to come here in the first place," she said. Adriana Kamarudin, a Malaysian student at Ewha Womans University, argued that language requirements should vary depending on the nature of the job. "Some level of Korean is necessary for jobs involving customer service or safety instructions, but banning all part-time work simply because someone fails to meet a certain standard seems too strict," she said. She added that part-time employment helps students cover tuition and living expenses while providing opportunities to practice Korean. Geoffrey Chen, a New Zealander studying at Korea University's Korean Language Center, called for greater flexibility and stronger language education rather than employment restrictions. "Korean proficiency is important, but the level required can vary depending on one's field of study and the type of work," Chen said, urging the government to consider students' diverse skills and potential when determining their post-graduation stays
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 【封面报道】政府考虑禁止韩语能力不足的国际学生从事兼职工作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 外国留学生担心经济压力，并质疑韩国作为留学目的地的吸引力。未达到韩语要求的国际学生，即使就读的是英语授课项目，也可能被完全禁止从事兼职工作。司法部正在审议这项措施，同时也在研究缩短韩语能力有限者毕业后停留期限的方案。如果这些措施得以实施，韩语能力将成为决定国际学生能否在该国工作和停留的关键因素。拟议中的调整出台之际，韩国正重新评估其国际学生政策；随着越来越多的人担忧，各大学有时以保证兼职工作为诱因 aggressively 招收国际学生，可能以牺牲教育质量为代价。截至4月，在韩国际学生人数为307,464人，提前超过政府2027年达到300,000人的目标。若计入约30,000名正在求职的毕业生，这一数字将升至近400,000人。根据最新草案，未能满足韩语要求的学生将失去现有的每周兼职工作10小时的许可，英语能力也不再使学生具备就业资格。韩国大学教育委员会举办的政策论坛上，该委员会签证与居留处副处长Yong Chang-sig周三表示：“我们认为英语授课项目的主要目的，是获得学位或赴海外继续深造。从这一角度看，我们认为这些学生没有兼职工作的必要。”该提案尚未最终敲定，司法部正在考虑在实施前设置两至三年的过渡期。在D-10求职签证下，韩语水平也可能成为决定毕业后停留期限的关键因素；该签证目前允许符合条件的毕业生在韩国停留最长三年。Yong说：“对于会说韩语且有能力找到工作的人，我们会给予三年停留期限；但对于既不参加课程，也不提升韩语能力的学生，我们不会保证三年停留期限。”司法部还在考虑放宽韩语能力较强者的学生签证财务要求，同时收紧能力较低者的财务要求。这些措施反映出司法部在韩国移民政策中日益重视国际学生。Yong说：“过去，我们的政策侧重于管理少数制造问题的学生。现在，我们需要考虑应该吸引什么样的人、应该如何吸引他们，以及如何与那些留在这里的人共同生活。”在司法部加强对语言能力和就业的管控之际，教育部则要求大学对其提供的教育质量承担更多责任。教育部国际教育规划局高级副处长Kim Tae-hun列举了一些大学招生案例：这些大学宣传每周只需上一节课的国际学生项目，把其余时间留给兼职工作。Kim说：“我们应当告诉学生我们的教育质量如何，以及他们在取得学士或硕士学位后能够开创怎样的未来。我们对韩国学生就是这么说的。为什么我们要对国际学生说不一样的话？”教育部计划在12月至次年1月间公布《国际教育质量保证制度》的改革方案。该制度评估大学对国际学生的管理情况，评估结果会影响签证签发。修订后的制度定于2029年生效，将优先考虑学术标准、语言能力和教育成果，而非数量指标。教育部还在考虑将该制度与院校认证相衔接，并加强对申请就读财务困难大学学生的签证审查。一位移民问题专家对政府的政策方向表示肯定，并提到韩语能力对于留住毕业后的高技能外国学生的重要性。Hanyang University移民事务律师兼兼职教授Kim Beom-su说，拟议中的调整反映了韩国移民政策从临时迁移转向长期定居的更广泛转变。Kim说：“鉴于这一转变，将韩语能力作为衡量移民融入韩国社会能力的一项指标，是合理的方法。”他指出，英语授课项目和STEM领域的学生几乎没有动力学习韩语，即使是韩国顶尖大学的毕业生，也可能因语言障碍而难以找到工作。Kim承认，更严格的语言要求可能妨碍STEM专业招生，但将语言能力与求职签证相联系，能够促使学生学习韩语。他说：“未达到韩语要求的学生可能转而从事未经许可的就业，从而迫使此类活动转入地下。”与此同时，国际学生担心拟议调整可能加重经济负担，并降低韩国作为留学目的地的吸引力。Korea University的乌兹别克斯坦学生Laylo Akmalova表示，这些限制尤其会影响没有奖学金的学生，并建议向这些学生开放不要求韩语能力的工作。她说：“如果在韩国工作变得更加困难，有些学生可能从一开始就决定不来韩国。”Ewha Womans University的马来西亚学生Adriana Kamarudin认为，语言要求应根据工作性质而有所不同。她说：“涉及客户服务或安全指导的工作需要一定程度的韩语能力，但仅仅因为有人未达到某一标准就禁止所有兼职工作，似乎过于严格。”她补充说，兼职就业可以帮助学生支付学费和生活开支，同时提供练习韩语的机会。在Korea University韩国语中心学习的新西兰学生Geoffrey Chen呼吁提高灵活性、加强语言教育，而不是限制就业。Chen说：“韩语能力很重要，但所需水平可以因专业领域和工作类型而异。”他敦促政府在决定学生毕业后停留期限时，考虑学生多样化的技能和潜力

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: North Korea's Kim stresses party discipline, loyalty in letter to grassroots leaders' conference
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un stressed the need to unify the ruling party's grassroots cells under a single ideology and will in a letter read at a meeting of cell secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), state media said Thursday. Jo Yong-won, a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, delivered Kim's letter to the Seventh Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩强调，有必要以单一意识形态统一执政党的基层细胞。朝鲜官媒周四称，金正恩在劳动党基层细胞书记会议上宣读的一封信中表达了这一意见。劳动党中央政治局委员、党中央组织指导部负责人赵勇现向劳动党第七次基层细胞书记会议递交了金正恩的信函。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un stressed the need to unify the ruling party's grassroots cells under a single ideology and will in a letter read at a meeting of cell secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), state media said Thursday. Kim "stressed the importance of consolidating all the Party cells into the ones of single ideology and will, steadfast in their revolutionary faith and obligation," according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). Party cells refer to the party's most elementary units, consisting of five to 30 members. Jo Yong-won, a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, delivered Kim's letter to the Seventh Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK. The conference took place Tuesday and Wednesday, aimed at discussing ways to carry out the policy goals set at a key party congress earlier this year. Kim "specified the tasks for strengthening all the Party cells into the powerful vanguard organizations unconditionally and perfectly implementing the Party decisions," the KCNA said. The gathering came as the North presses ahead with the five-year goals set at the ninth party congress in February, across sectors that include the economy and defense. It also reviewed the work of the cell secretaries over the past five years and discussed ways to strengthen the basic party organizations as required by the "new stage of the developing revolution," according to the KCNA. This year's event "serves as a significant political occasion" for strengthening the party's mass foundation and unity of ideology and will, and for implementing the decisions of the party congress, it added. North Korea revised the party rules at the eighth party congress in 2021 to convene a cell secretaries' meeting every five years. Kim attended all three previous conferences held under his rule but did not appear in person this time
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜金正恩在致基层干部会议的信中强调党的纪律和忠诚
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩强调，需要以单一意识形态和意志统一执政党的基层细胞；朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）周四表示，金正恩在一封将在朝鲜劳动党基层细胞书记会议上宣读的信中提出了这一要求。据朝鲜中央通讯社报道，金正恩“强调，要把所有党支部细胞整合为具有单一意识形态和意志、坚定秉持革命信仰与义务的细胞”。党支部细胞是党的最基本单位，由5至30名成员组成。朝鲜劳动党中央组织指导部委员长、预定委员会成员赵容元在劳动党第七次基层细胞书记会议上递交了金正恩的信函。会议于周二和周三举行，旨在讨论落实今年早些时候一次重要党代会所确定政策目标的途径。朝鲜中央通讯社称，金正恩“明确了加强所有党支部细胞，将其建设成为强大先锋组织并无条件、完完全全落实党的决定所必须完成的任务”。此次会议召开之际，朝鲜正全面推进今年2月第九次党代会确定的五年目标，相关工作涉及经济、国防等多个部门。据朝鲜中央通讯社报道，会议还回顾了基层细胞书记过去五年的工作，并讨论了如何按照“革命发展新阶段”的要求加强党的基层组织。朝鲜中央通讯社补充说，今年的活动“是一次重要的政治契机”，有利于加强党的群众基础、巩固意识形态和意志的统一，以及落实党代会的决定。朝鲜在2021年第八次党代会上修订了党规，规定每五年召开一次基层细胞书记会议。金正恩出席了他执政以来举行的此前全部三届会议，但这次没有亲自到场

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: New bills target stealth recording with AI glasses
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Makers would have to build in recording indicators that can't be disabled Lawmakers of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea have proposed bills to stop people from secretly filming others with artificial intelligence (AI)-powered smart glasses, amid growing concern that wearable cameras are making illegal filming harder to detect. It is one of two bills in what the lawmaker calls the “Smart Glasses Illegal Filming Prevention Act,” introduced earlier this week.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 制造商必须内置无法关闭的拍摄指示灯。朝鲜执政党民主党的议员提出多项法案，旨在阻止人们利用人工智能驱动的智能眼镜秘密拍摄他人；随着可穿戴摄像头让非法拍摄越来越难以被发现，相关担忧日益加剧。这是该议员所称《智能眼镜非法拍摄防止法》两项法案之一，于本周早些时候提出。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Makers would have to build in recording indicators that can't be disabled Lawmakers of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea have proposed bills to stop people from secretly filming others with artificial intelligence (AI)-powered smart glasses, amid growing concern that wearable cameras are making illegal filming harder to detect. Rep. Lee Ju-hee and 18 DPK colleagues have submitted an amendment to the Information and Communications Network Act to require makers and importers of wearable cameras to include a recording indicator that people nearby can easily recognize. It is one of two bills in what the lawmaker calls the “Smart Glasses Illegal Filming Prevention Act,” introduced earlier this week. The other bill would also require individuals who film others with such devices to signal that they are recording. Existing rules cover only the stage when footage is distributed, according to the lawmakers. Moreover, the Personal Information Protection Act's requirements apply only to operators who film for business purposes; they don’t apply when individuals wear a device and film for private reasons. The lawmakers add that no provisions regulate the manufacturing or design of such devices. “As wearable devices that make it hard for people nearby to tell whether they are filming spread rapidly, privacy violations such as illegal filming and cheating on exams are becoming a reality. Also, even when manufacturers equip devices with a recording indicator feature, items and programs designed to cover or disable it are in circulation, failing to ensure even that measure’s effectiveness,” the lawmakers said. Under the amendment, makers and importers of wearable video-recording devices would be required to equip them with a recording indicator and take technical measures to keep it from being disabled later. The bill also would prohibit making, importing and selling items or programs created to disable the indicator. Sellers would also have to inform buyers of relevant details. Violators would be subject to administrative fines under the Act's existing fine provisions, which cap penalties at 30 million won ($22,300) for manufacturers, importers and sellers of anti-indicator tools, and 10 million won for sellers who fail to inform buyers. “People should know right away that they are being filmed, and be able to say no if they do not want to be,” Lee said. “We will put standards in place that protect privacy from the filming stage, so that no one finds footage of themselves taken with smart glasses online after the fact.” This comes as the spread of AI smart devices, particularly glasses, is raising privacy concerns that people can be filmed without knowing it. Major makers such as Meta already fit their smart glasses with a light that shows when they are recording. Some lower-priced products reportedly lack the feature, or make it hard to tell from outside whether the camera is on. Samsung Electronics, which is expected to release its own smart glasses on Dec. 10, says its design already includes an indicator. A company official said the glasses have an LED on one side that blinks while the camera records. The camera also does not work when the glasses are not being worn. “Even before this became an issue in Korea, AI glasses had already sparked controversy in New York State ... So we gave a lot of thought to such concerns,” the official told The Korea Times on Thursday
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 新法案针对利用人工智能眼镜进行秘密录音
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 制造商必须为相关设备设置无法关闭的录像指示灯。朝鲜 ruling Democratic Party of Korea 的议员 amid 日益加剧的担忧——可穿戴摄像头正使非法拍摄更难被发现——提出法案，禁止人们利用人工智能驱动的智能眼镜暗中拍摄他人。执政党朝鲜民主劳动党的李珠姬议员与另外18名该党议员提交了《信息通信网络法》修正案，要求可穿戴摄像头的制造商和进口商安装录像指示灯，让附近的人能够轻松辨认。这是该议员本周早些时候提出的“《智能眼镜非法拍摄防止法》”两项法案之一，另一项法案还将要求使用此类设备拍摄他人的人发出正在录像的信号。议员们表示，现行规定只涵盖影像被传播的阶段。此外，《个人信息保护法》的相关要求仅适用于以商业目的进行拍摄的运营者，不适用于个人佩戴设备并出于私人原因拍摄的情形。议员们补充说，目前没有条款对这类设备的制造或设计作出规定。议员们说：“随着让附近的人难以判断是否正在拍摄的可穿戴设备迅速普及，非法拍摄、考试作弊等侵犯隐私的行为正成为现实。此外，即使制造商为设备配备录像指示灯功能，用于遮挡或停用该功能的物品和程序仍在流通，导致连这一措施也无法确保有效。”根据修正案，可穿戴录像设备的制造商和进口商将被要求配备录像指示灯，并采取技术措施，防止该功能日后被停用。法案还将禁止制造、进口和销售旨在停用指示灯的物品或程序。卖家还必须向买家告知相关信息。违反者将依据该法现有的罚则处以行政罚款；对制造、进口和销售反指示工具者，罚款上限为3000万韩元（$22,300），对未告知买家相关信息的卖家，罚款上限为1000万韩元。李说：“人们应当立即知道自己正在被拍摄，并且如果不愿意被拍摄，就能够说‘不’。我们将制定从拍摄阶段起保护隐私的标准，确保事后没有人会发现智能眼镜拍摄的自身影像出现在网上。”随着人工智能智能设备，尤其是智能眼镜的普及，人们担心自己在不知情的情况下被拍摄，由此引发的隐私问题日益突出。Meta等大型制造商已经在智能眼镜上安装显示录像状态的指示灯。据报道，一些价格较低的产品没有这一功能，或者让人难以从外部判断摄像头是否开启。预计于12月10日发布自有智能眼镜的Samsung Electronics表示，其设计已经包含指示灯。一名公司官员称，该眼镜一侧设有LED灯，摄像头录像时会闪烁；不佩戴眼镜时，摄像头也无法工作。这名官员周四对《韩国时报》表示：“即使这个问题尚未在韩国引发关注，纽约州的人工智能眼镜此前就已经引发了争议……因此，我们对这类问题进行了充分考虑。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Integrated LCC headquarters to be based in Busan
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: The headquarters of the integrated low-cost carrier (LCC) formed through the merger of Air Busan, Jin Air and Air Seoul will be based in Busan, the city government said Thursday. Busan Mayor Chun Jae-soo and Hanjin Group Chairman Cho Won-tae reached the agreement during a meeting in Busan, paving the way for the launch of the integrated airline in March next year. Under the broader restructuring, Korean Air's Jin Air will be integrated with Asiana Airlines' Air Busan and Air Seoul to form a single low-cost carrier.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 釜山市政府周四表示，由Air Busan、Jin Air和Air Seoul合并组建的廉价航空公司（LCC）总部将设在釜山。釜山市市长全在秀和韩进集团会长Cho Won-tae在釜山举行会议期间达成协议，为这家合并后的航空公司明年3月投入运营铺平道路。根据更广泛的重组计划，大韩航空旗下Jin Air将与韩亚航空旗下Air Busan和Air Seoul整合，组建一家统一的廉价航空公司。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: The headquarters of the integrated low-cost carrier (LCC) formed through the merger of Air Busan, Jin Air and Air Seoul will be based in Busan, the city government said Thursday. Busan Mayor Chun Jae-soo and Hanjin Group Chairman Cho Won-tae reached the agreement during a meeting in Busan, paving the way for the launch of the integrated airline in March next year. The agreement follows close consultations between the city and Korean Air, with Hanjin Group making the decision in consideration of Busan's growth potential and the importance of balanced national development, according to the city government. The integration follows Korean Air's acquisition of Asiana Airlines, scheduled to be completed on Dec. 17. Under the broader restructuring, Korean Air's Jin Air will be integrated with Asiana Airlines' Air Busan and Air Seoul to form a single low-cost carrier. The integrated LCC will operate a fleet of 60 aircraft, comprising 33 from Jin Air, 21 from Air Busan and six from Air Seoul, all under the Jin Air brand. It will have approximately 4,200 employees and is projected to generate around 3 trillion won ($2.23 billion) in revenue in its first year. The three carriers transported a combined 15 million passengers from January to September this year, positioning the new airline to launch as one of Korea's largest LCCs. "Confirming Busan as the headquarters of the integrated LCC will create a pathway for the city to expand its global reach. We will strengthen the global competitiveness of Hanjin Group and Busan's economy and industries," Chun said in a briefing
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 综合长途通信线路控制中心总部将设在釜山
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 釜山市政府周四表示，由Air Busan、Jin Air和Air Seoul合并成立的综合低成本航空公司（LCC）总部将设在釜山。釜山市市长全在秀与韩进集团会长赵万达在釜山举行会议期间达成协议，为这家综合航空公司明年3月投入运营铺平了道路。釜山市政府称，此次协议是釜山市与Korean Air密切磋商的结果；韩进集团在作出决定时考虑了釜山的发展潜力以及实现国家均衡发展的重要性。Korean Air收购Asiana Airlines的交易计划于12月17日完成。此次整合是在Korean Air收购Asiana Airlines之后进行的。根据更广泛的重组方案，Korean Air旗下的Jin Air将与Asiana Airlines旗下的Air Busan和Air Seoul合并，成立一家统一的低成本航空公司。这家综合LCC将运营一支由60架飞机组成的机队，其中包括Jin Air的33架、Air Busan的21架和Air Seoul的6架，全部使用Jin Air品牌。公司将拥有约4,200名员工，预计首个年收入约为3万亿韩元（$2.23 billion）。今年1月至9月，三家航空公司共运送了1,500万名乘客，这使新航空公司有望以韩国最大的低成本航空公司之一的身份投入运营。全在秀在记者会上表示：“确认将釜山设为综合低成本航空公司的总部，将为该市拓展全球业务铺平道路。我们将增强韩进集团以及釜山经济和产业的全球竞争力。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Law banning foreigners' political activity ruled unconstitutional
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Constitutional Court ruled Thursday that a provision of the Immigration Act imposing a general ban on political activity by foreign residents does not conform to the Constitution, with six of the nine judges agreeing. They filed a constitutional complaint that July after learning the law barred them from political activity.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 宪法法院星期四裁定，《移民法》中对外国居民政治活动实施全面禁令的规定不符合宪法，9名大法官中有6人同意这一裁决。他们在7月得知该法律禁止其从事政治活动后，提起了宪法申诉。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Constitutional Court ruled Thursday that a provision of the Immigration Act imposing a general ban on political activity by foreign residents does not conform to the Constitution, with six of the nine judges agreeing. To prevent a legal vacuum, however, the court kept the clause in effect until it can be revised, no later than Dec. 31, 2028. The provision was introduced in 1977. A 2005 amendment added an exception for political activities permitted under other laws, but the general ban stayed in place. Violators can be ordered to halt the activity or leave the country and those without permanent resident status may face deportation. In 2021, two Mongolian international students planned to request preliminary candidates in the 20th presidential election present policies to address discrimination against foreign nationals living in Korea. They filed a constitutional complaint that July after learning the law barred them from political activity. The court found that freedom of expression, unlike voting and other political rights, is a constitutional right that applies to both citizens and foreign nationals. It said restricting political activity to protect national security and the sovereignty of the Korean people is a legitimate legislative goal, but the law failed to define the scope of banned activities. The court noted that separate laws restrict election campaigning, party membership and political donations by foreign nationals. Other provisions of the Immigration Act can also regulate activities that threaten the country's security or public order, it said. The court said Germany's approach of generally allowing political activity by foreign nationals while listing prohibited acts in law is another option. It also took into account that the United States and Japan have no separate provision in their immigration laws broadly banning such activity
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 禁止外国人从事政治活动的法律被裁定违宪
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 宪法法院星期四裁定，《移民法》中禁止外国居民从事政治活动的一般性条款不符合宪法，9名法官中有6人同意这一裁决。不过，为避免出现法律真空，法院决定在该条款完成修订前维持其效力，修订期限最迟不得晚于2028年12月31日。该条款于1977年引入。2005年的修正案增加了例外，规定其他法律允许的政治活动不受禁止，但一般性禁令仍然保留。违规者可被责令停止有关活动或离境，不具有永久居民身份者还可能被驱逐出境。2021年，两名蒙古国际学生计划请第20届总统选举的初步候选人介绍应对在韩外国公民所受歧视的政策。他们在获知该法律禁止其从事政治活动后，于当年7月提起宪法诉讼。法院认为，言论自由与投票权及其他政治权利不同，是一项同时适用于公民和外国公民的宪法权利。法院指出，为保护国家安全和韩国人民主权而限制政治活动，是正当的立法目的，但该法律未能界定禁止活动的范围。法院同时提到，其他单独法律对外国公民的竞选活动、政党成员资格和政治捐款作出限制。《移民法》的其他条款也可对威胁国家安全或公共秩序的活动加以规制。法院称，德国的做法也是一种选择，即原则上允许外国公民从事政治活动，同时在法律中列出禁止行为。法院还考虑到，美国和日本的移民法均未设有广泛禁止此类活动的单独条款……
