Prime Minister Narendra Modi used to say in all his speeches, wherever he went, ‘Abki Baar, 400 Paar’ (this time, more than 400 seats). But did the BJP cross 400 seats? The people sent you (BJP) packing. The people of Uttar Pradesh brought you to your knees. It is because of Uttar Pradesh that Modi is sitting quietly today,” Mr. Kharge said. Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday (November 26, 2026), led the nation, in greeting all fellow citizens on the occasion of Constitution Day and said the Constitution is a priceless heritage of Indian democracy, one that will continue to guide in realising the resolve of a developed India. Constitution Day, also known as ‘Samvidhan Divas’, is celebrated in the country on November 26 every year to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India. On November 26, 1949, the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution of India, which came into effect from January 26, 1950. The Modi government in 2015 notified its decision to celebrate November 26 every year as Constitution Day to promote the values of the foundational document among citizens. Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan called for respecting all languages and cautioned against looking down upon other people’s mother tongues, saying that respect for one’s own language must go hand in hand with respect for the languages of others. “If I don’t respect the sentiments of others, then I don’t deserve that my sentiments will be respected by others,” Mr. Radhakrishnan said, stressing that linguistic diversity should be a source of mutual respect and national unity. Addressing an event organised by the Union Law Ministry to mark the 77th anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution, he released its updated versions in all 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule. Describing the initiative as a celebration of India’s linguistic diversity and democratic inclusiveness, the Vice-President said making the Constitution available in different languages would bring governance closer to the people and enable citizens to understand the country’s foundational document in their mother tongues. “Our Constitution is our pride and our duty,” he said, adding that the availability of the document in multiple languages reflected the spirit of Jan Bhagidari and the collective responsibility of citizens in upholding constitutional values. He also cautioned against equating knowledge with proficiency in English, saying it was just another language like any Indian mother tongue. “Never think that speaking in English is knowledge. English is also one of the languages like our mother tongue. It’s nothing more,” he said. “If our nation is not protected, none of our languages will be protected,” he said, urging citizens to work with the spirit of ‘Rashtra Pratham’ (Nation First). — PTI Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath accused Opposition parties on Thursday (November 26, 2026) of weakening the Constitution and democratic institutions, saying those who had attempted to “strangle the Constitution” when in power were now carrying a red book to mislead people. He criticised Congress for “disrespecting Ambedkar”, and alleged that the party did not confer the Bharat Ratna on him and conspired to prevent him from entering Parliament. Addressing a Constitution Day programme at the Lok Bhavan auditorium in Lucknow, Mr. Adityanath said India’s sovereignty did not belong to any individual, family or particular caste but rested with the common citizens of the country. “Those who tried to strangle the Constitution when they had the opportunity are today carrying a red book and misleading the people,” he said in an apparent attack on Congress. The chief minister also launched beautification works at 3,955 sites housing statues of Dr B R Ambedkar and other social reformers under the Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme. He administered a collective oath on the Preamble of the Constitution along with Deputy Chief Ministers and other dignitaries. Adityanath said 4,030 sites associated with Ambedkar and other champions of social justice had been identified across the state, of which work would begin at 3,955 locations. The sites would be equipped with facilities such as canopies, boundary walls, CCTV cameras, security arrangements and gardens, depending on requirements, the chief minister said. -- PTI The Union Health Ministry on Thursday (November 26, 2026) observed Constitution Day with its officers collectively reading the Preamble to the Constitution and reaffirming their commitment to its values and ideals. The programme was held at the Kartavya Bhawan here, with senior officers, including additional secretaries, joint secretaries, directors and deputy secretaries of the Department of Health and Family Welfare, participating. Officials from the National AIDS Control Organisation, National Health Authority and National Medical Commission, among others, joined the programme through video conferencing, the ministry said in a statement. The observance provided an opportunity for officials to reaffirm their collective commitment to the constitutional values that guide India’s democratic framework and governance, it said. -- PTI Manipur Chief Minister Y Khemchand Singh on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said the state is inhabited by 36 communities, and that all communities should work collectively to strengthen the bonds of love and unity, as enshrined in the Constitution. Speaking at a function organised on the occasion of the Samvidhan Diwas at the Civil Secretariat in Mantripukhri area in Imphal, the Chief Minsiter said every person residing in the state must identify themselves “first as an Indian and secondly as a Manipuri”. He also urged the people to collectively resolve to uphold the spirit of the Preamble of the Constitution and work towards a “society based on justice, liberty, equality and fraternity”. “Manipur is inhabited by 36 communities, and all communities should work collectively to further strengthen the bonds of love and unity, as enshrined in the Preamble to the Constitution. Every individual residing in the state must identify themselves, first as an Indian and secondly as a Manipuri,” Mr. Singh said. -- PTI Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Thursday (November 26, 2026) said the people of Uttar Pradesh had taught the BJP a lesson in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, forcing Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ‘400 paar’ slogan into silence. Addressing a ‘Samvidhan Raksha Sammelan’ at the Congress office in Lucknow, he also alleged that inflation, unemployment, prices of LPG, and food items were rising, while the BJP’s coffers were filling up. Mr. Kharge thanked the people of Uttar Pradesh for checking the BJP’s electoral ambitions and said Modi, who had repeatedly invoked the ‘400 paar’ slogan during the campaign, was now “sitting quietly”. “I thank the people of Uttar Pradesh. Prime Minister Narendra Modi used to say in all his speeches, wherever he went, ‘Abki Baar, 400 Paar’ (this time, more than 400 seats). But did the BJP cross 400 seats? The people sent you (BJP) packing. The people of Uttar Pradesh brought you to your knees. It is because of Uttar Pradesh that Modi is sitting quietly today,” Mr. Kharge said. The BJP-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) had won 36 of Uttar Pradesh’s 80 Lok Sabha seats in the 2024 general elections. Taking a veiled jibe at Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Kharge said another leader in Lucknow also had his eyes on the prime minister’s chair. -- PTI The Odisha Assembly observed Constitution Day, with Speaker Surama Padhy administering a pledge to members, including Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, to uphold the values enshrined in the Constitution. Legislators gathered at the main entrance of the Assembly Hall, where Padhy read the Preamble, which the others collectively followed. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said political agendas of lawyers must not be masqueraded as professional duties, nor should judicial platforms be targeted for personal gains. “Disagreement is not a weakness of constitutional democracy. A strong Bar must be able to question, challenge and disagree. Equally, a confident institution must have the capacity to engage with criticism without treating every disagreement as a challenge to its authority. What matters is that such engagement must remain guided by reason, professional integrity and respect for constitutional processes,” CJI Surya Kant said in his address at the Constitutional Day celebrations organised by the Supreme Court Bar Association. “If political agendas are masqueraded as professional duty or judicial platforms are targeted for personal gains – there stands the professional integrity impaired,” he added. Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urged people to uphold the core values of the Constitution, including justice, liberty, equality and fraternity, saying it is not merely the foundation of the country’s governance system but also the guardian of every citizen’s rights, duties and dignity. In a post on X on the occasion of Constitution Day, Mr. Choudhary said the Constitution strengthens India’s democratic traditions and inspires the nation to preserve its unity and integrity. “Our Constitution, based on the fundamental ideals of justice, liberty, equality and fraternity, is not merely the foundation of the country’s system of governance, but also the guardian of every citizen’s rights, duties and dignity,” the CM said. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Thursday (November 26, 2026) announced the launch of beautification works under the ‘Dr B R Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme’ on Constitution Day and said the initiative reflected his government’s commitment to the ideals of the architect of the Constitution. In a post on X, Mr. Adityanath said, “On the auspicious occasion of Constitution Day, beautification works are going to be launched today under the Dr B R Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme. This initiative symbolises our government’s unwavering commitment to the thoughts, ideals and social justice envisioned by Bharat Ratna Baba Saheb Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar.” He said a true tribute to Ambedkar would be to imbibe his values and work towards building the egalitarian society he had envisioned. “With this ideological commitment, and under the guidance of the prime minister, the double-engine government is making the basic spirit of the Constitution the foundation of governance and giving priority to the deprived,” Adityanath said. “Ensuring dignity, equal opportunities and the benefits of development for the person standing at the last rung of society is our government’s resolve,” he added. -- PTI Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Thursday (November 26, 2026) hailed the Constitution as the soul of India and pledged to defend it under all circumstances. In a post on X on Constitution Day, the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha (LoP) said it is the foundation of our democracy and a weapon against injustice. “India’s Constitution is not just a book; it is the soul of the nation.

国大党主席马利卡朱恩·卡尔吉周四（2026年11月26日）表示，北方邦人民在2024年人民院选举中给人民党上了一课，使总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的“400 paar”口号归于沉寂。卡尔吉在勒克瑙的国大党办公室出席“Samvidhan Raksha Sammelan”会议时还指控，通货膨胀、失业率、液化石油气和食品价格上涨，而人民党的金库却在不断充盈。卡尔吉感谢北方邦人民遏制了人民党的选举野心，并说竞选期间多次援引“400 paar”口号的莫迪如今正“安静地坐着”。卡尔吉说：“我感谢北方邦人民。总理纳伦德拉·莫迪过去无论走到哪里、在所有演讲中都会说‘Abki Baar, 400 Paar’（这一次，超过400个席位）。但人民党跨过400席了吗？人民把你们（人民党）扫地出门了。北方邦人民让你们跪地认输。正是因为北方邦，莫迪今天才安静地坐着。”

总理纳伦德拉·莫迪周四（2026年11月26日）带头向全体同胞致以宪法日祝福，并表示，宪法是印度民主无价的遗产，将继续指引印度实现发展中国家的愿景。宪法日又称“Samvidhan Divas”，印度每年11月26日庆祝这一节日，以纪念印度宪法获通过。1949年11月26日，制宪会议通过印度宪法，该宪法于1950年1月26日生效。莫迪政府于2015年决定每年11月26日庆祝宪法日，以向公民宣传这一根本性文件的价值观。副总统C.P.拉达克里希南呼吁尊重所有语言，并提醒人们不要轻视他人的母语，称尊重自己的语言必须与尊重他人的语言同步进行。拉达克里希南说：“如果我不尊重他人的情感，那么我也不配期望他人尊重我的情感。”他强调，语言多样性应成为相互尊重和国家团结的源泉。在联邦法律部举办、纪念宪法通过77周年的活动上，他发布了以《第八附表》所列全部22种语言编制的最新版宪法。他称，这项举措是在庆祝印度的语言多样性和民主包容性；副总统表示，以不同语言提供宪法，将让治理更贴近民众，并使公民能够用母语理解国家的根本性文件。他说：“我们的宪法是我们的骄傲，也是我们的责任。”他补充称，以多种语言提供该文件体现了Jan Bhagidari精神和公民共同维护宪法价值观的责任。他还提醒，不要把知识等同于精通英语，称英语与任何一种印度母语一样，只是另一种语言。他说：“绝不要以为会说英语就是有知识。英语也和我们母语一样，只是其中一种语言而已。”“如果我们的国家得不到保护，我们的任何语言都不会得到保护。”他敦促公民本着“Rashtra Pratham”（国家优先）精神开展工作。—— PTI

北方邦首席部长约吉·阿迪蒂亚纳特周四（2026年11月26日）指控反对党削弱宪法和民主制度，称那些掌权时企图“扼杀宪法”的人如今手持红皮书，误导民众。他批评国大党“不尊重安贝德卡尔”，并指称该党没有授予他“印度之矛”勋章，还密谋阻止他进入议会。阿迪蒂亚纳特在勒克瑙Lok Bhavan礼堂出席宪法日活动时说，印度主权不属于任何个人、家族或特定种姓，而是属于全国普通公民。他说：“那些在有机会时试图扼杀宪法的人，如今正手持红皮书误导民众。”这显然是在影射国大党。首席部长还启动了Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme下3,955个场所的美化工程，这些场所设有B R安贝德卡尔博士及其他社会改革家的雕像。他与副首席部长及其他政要一道宣誓遵守宪法序言。阿迪蒂亚纳特说，全州已确定4,030个与安贝德卡尔及其他社会正义倡导者有关的场所，其中3,955个地点将开始施工。根据需要，这些场所将配备凉棚、围墙、闭路电视摄像头、安保设施和花园等。—— PTI

联邦卫生部周四（2026年11月26日）庆祝宪法日，全体官员集体朗读宪法序言，重申对宪法价值观和理想的承诺。活动在当地的Kartavya Bhawan举行，卫生与家庭福利部常务秘书、联合秘书、主任和副秘书等高级官员参加。卫生部在声明中称，国家艾滋病控制组织、国家卫生管理局和国家医学委员会等机构的官员也通过视频连线参加活动。声明说，此次活动让官员有机会重申共同致力于维护指导印度民主框架和治理的宪法价值观。—— PTI

曼尼普尔邦首席部长Y Khemchand Singh周四（2026年11月26日）表示，该邦有36个社群，所有社群都应依照宪法共同加强爱与团结的联系。他在因帕尔Mantripukhri地区民政秘书处举行的Samvidhan Diwas活动上说，居住在邦内的每个人都必须首先认同自己是印度人，其次认同自己是曼尼普尔人。他还敦促民众共同决心维护宪法序言精神，努力建设“建立在正义、自由、平等和博爱基础上的社会”。辛格说：“曼尼普尔有36个社群，所有社群都应共同进一步加强爱与团结的联系，正如宪法序言所规定的那样。居住在邦内的每个人都必须首先认同自己是印度人，其次认同自己是曼尼普尔人。”—— PTI

国大党主席马利卡朱恩·卡尔吉周四（2026年11月26日）表示，北方邦人民在2024年人民院选举中给人民党上了一课，使总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的“400 paar”口号归于沉寂。卡尔吉在勒克瑙的国大党办公室出席“Samvidhan Raksha Sammelan”会议时还指控，通货膨胀、失业率、液化石油气和食品价格上涨，而人民党的金库却在不断充盈。卡尔吉感谢北方邦人民遏制了人民党的选举野心，并说竞选期间多次援引“400 paar”口号的莫迪如今正“安静地坐着”。卡尔吉说：“我感谢北方邦人民。总理纳伦德拉·莫迪过去无论走到哪里、在所有演讲中都会说‘Abki Baar, 400 Paar’（这一次，超过400个席位）。但人民党跨过400席了吗？人民把你们（人民党）扫地出门了。北方邦人民让你们跪地认输。正是因为北方邦，莫迪今天才安静地坐着。”

由人民党主导的全国民主联盟在2024年大选中赢得北方邦80个人民院席位中的36席。卡尔吉含蓄地讽刺北方邦首席部长约吉·阿迪蒂亚纳特，称勒克瑙的另一位领导人同样觊觎总理职位。—— PTI

奥迪沙邦议会纪念宪法日，议长苏拉玛·帕迪向议员宣誓，包括首席部长莫汉·查兰·马吉在内的议员承诺维护宪法所载价值观。议员们聚集在议会大厅正门，帕迪宣读宪法序言，其他人齐声跟读。

印度首席大法官苏里耶·坎特表示，律师的政治议程不得伪装成职业职责，司法平台也不应成为谋取个人利益的工具。最高法院律师协会举办宪法日庆祝活动，坎特在致辞中说：“分歧不是宪政民主的弱点。强大的律师界必须能够质疑、挑战并持不同意见。同样，自信的机构也必须有能力接纳批评，而不是把每一处分歧都视为对其权威的挑战。关键在于，这种交流必须始终以理性、职业操守以及对宪法程序的尊重为指导。”他补充道：“如果政治议程被伪装成职业职责，或司法平台被当作谋取个人利益的工具，那么职业操守就受到了损害。”

比哈尔邦首席部长萨姆拉特·乔达里敦促人民维护宪法的核心价值观，包括正义、自由、平等和博爱，称宪法不仅是国家治理体系的基础，也是每位公民权利、义务和尊严的保护者。宪法日当天，乔达里在X上发帖称，宪法加强了印度的民主传统，并激励国家维护团结与完整。首席部长说：“我们的宪法建立在正义、自由、平等和博爱的基本理想之上，不仅是国家治理体系的基础，也是每位公民权利、义务和尊严的保护者。”

北方邦首席部长约吉·阿迪蒂亚纳特周四（2026年11月26日）宣布在宪法日启动“Dr B R Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme”下的美化工程，并称该举措体现了其政府对宪法缔造者理念的承诺。阿迪蒂亚纳特在X上发帖称：“在宪法日这一吉祥日子，我们今天将启动Dr B R Ambedkar Statue Development Scheme下的美化工程。这项举措象征着我们的政府坚定不移地致力于宝拉·萨赫布·Bhimrao安贝德卡尔博士所设想的思想、理念和社会正义。”他说，向安贝德卡尔致敬的真正方式，是汲取其价值观，并努力建设他所设想的社会。阿迪蒂亚纳特说：“凭借这一思想承诺，在总理指导下，双引擎政府正把宪法的基本精神作为治理的基础，并优先关注弱势群体。”“确保处于社会最底层的人享有尊严、平等机会和发展红利，是我国政府的决心。”他补充道。—— PTI

国大党领导人拉胡尔·甘地周四（2026年11月26日）盛赞宪法是印度的灵魂，并承诺在任何情况下都捍卫宪法。宪法日当天，人民院反对党领袖在X上发帖称，宪法是民主的根基，也是对抗不公的武器。“印度宪法不仅是一本书；它是这个国家的灵魂。

Unlock these with Subscription The rupee settled 24 paise lower at 92.44 (provisional) against the U.S. dollar on Thursday (November 26, 2026), facing resistance due to higher crude oil prices and fear of additional U.S. tariffs. Forex traders said foreign fund inflows favoured the Indian currency, even though crude oil prices reversed easing trend, hovering near the $95-per-barrel level. They also said the Donald Trump administration's latest proposal to escalate the trade war with major trading partners raised inflation fears. The US on Wednesday proposed 25% tariffs on imports from India, with a provision to cap them at 17% if the two countries agree to a bilateral trade deal, giving it a slight edge over Asian competitors. The proposed tariffs followed investigations by the U.S. Trade Representative into 16 economic jurisdictions. The USTR investigation report accused India of engaging in a range of acts, policies, and practices that create, maintain, or contribute to structural excess capacity and production. India rejected the allegation and said the country is committed to working closely with the U.S. for an early conclusion of a bilateral trade agreement. In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 92.50 and moved between the range of 92.31 and 92.66 against the greenback during the session. The unit finally settled at 92.44 (provisional) against the dollar, registering a loss of 24 paise from its previous close. On Wednesday, the rupee jumped 65 paise to settle at 92.20, the highest level this fiscal year so far. The level was compared to the closing mark of 92.28 against the greenback recorded on March 16. The Indian currency has recovered nearly 5% compared to its lowest-ever closing mark of 96.88 versus the U.S. dollar seen on October 8. Commenting on Thursday's (November 26, 2026) fall, Rajeev Sharan, Head of Research, Brickwork Ratings, said, "Two pressures surfaced together: Brent crude climbed back above $95 a barrel, and Washington proposed tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods. The fine print is less severe than the headline. A bilateral trade deal capping duties at 17% would still give India a slight edge over Asian competitors. The mild reaction suggests the market sees the proposal as an opening position in talks." Sharan added that a slight pullback in the rupee provides a natural cushion for exporters who are facing both a firmer currency and tariff risk. Meanwhile, the dollar index, which gauges the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, was at 103.70, higher by 0.09 per cent. Unlock these with Subscription In a bid to boost connectivity and bilateral ties with Nepal, the Ministry of Railways has launched Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham weekly express . Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah virtually flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, connecting Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh to Janakpur in Nepal, from Delhi on Monday (November 23, 2026). The weekly train will establish a crucial rail link between two pilgrimage sites, namely Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya, believed to be the birthplace of Sita and Ram. Further, the initiative is expected to enhance trade and cultural ties between both countries. The train will cover a distance of approximately 604 kilometres in 19 hours, passing through several important towns in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh . The weekly train will commence its journey from Janakpur Dham on Saturday, and from Ayodhya Cantt on Monday. The express train will commence regular service from November 28. The originating train (15596) from India is scheduled to depart from its station at Ayodhya Cantt. at 5:50 p.m every Monday, and reach the final destination at Janakpur at 12:40 p.m. (Nepali time) next day. On its return journey, the train will leave Janakpur Dham at 1.10 pm (Nepali time) every Saturday and reach Ayodhya Cantt at 8.10 am on Sundays. The train is scheduled to halt at 10 stations as part of its itinerary. Here is the list of stations where the train will have stoppages besides its terminal stations. The Saryu-Kamala Express will be operated using modern 17-coach LHB (Linke Hofmann Busch) rakes. The train configuration includes eight air-conditioned coaches, seven sleeper-class coaches, one LSLRD (LHB Second Class, Luggage, Brake, and Disabled-friendly) coach, and one LWLRRM (LHB Power Car/Generator-cum-Luggage-cum-Brake Van) coach. The ticket prices for the Ayodhya Cantt-Janakpur Dham weekly express are yet to be announced on the IRCTC website. Indian citizens going to Nepal don’t need a visa if they have a valid passport. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/a.body_zh: 订阅还可享受《Premium Stories》《Editorials》《Opinies》等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。为加强与尼泊尔的互联互通和双边关系，印度铁道部推出了阿约提亚坎特至贾纳克普尔达姆的每周特快列车。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿于2026年11月23日星期一在德里共同为萨里尤—卡马拉特快列车线上发车。该列车将北方邦的阿约提亚与尼泊尔的贾纳克普尔连接起来。每周列车将在两处重要朝圣地之间建立关键铁路通道，即贾纳克普尔达姆和阿约提亚；人们相信，后者是悉多和罗摩的诞生地。预计这一举措还将加强两国之间的贸易和文化联系。列车全程约604公里，耗时19小时，途经比哈尔邦和北方邦的多个重要城镇。每周列车将于星期六从贾纳克普尔达姆出发，并于星期一从阿约提亚坎特出发。该特快列车将于11月28日开始正式运营。由印度始发的15596次列车计划于每周一下午5:50从阿约提亚坎特车站发车，并于次日下午12:40（尼泊尔时间）抵达贾纳克普尔最终目的地。返程列车将于每周六下午1:10（尼泊尔时间）从贾纳克普尔达姆出发，并于星期日早上8:10抵达阿约提亚坎特。根据行程安排，列车计划停靠10个车站。以下是除始发站和终点站外，列车停靠站名单。萨里尤—卡马拉特快列车将采用现代化的17节LHB（Linke Hofmann Busch）车厢编组运行。列车编组包括8节空调车厢、7节卧铺车厢、1节LSLRD（LHB二等座、行李、制动及无障碍友好型）车厢，以及1节LWLRRM（LHB动力车／发电兼行李兼制动车厢）车厢。阿约提亚坎特至贾纳克普尔达姆每周特快列车的票价尚未在IRCTC网站上公布。持有效护照前往尼泊尔的印度公民无需签证。印度开往孟加拉国和尼泊尔等邻国的列车服务正常运营。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们文章的互动。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可在Vuukle上查看以前的评论。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112618.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 이지헌 기자 = 인공지능(AI) 인프라 투자 붐으로 메모리 반도체가 극심한 공급난을 겪으면서 글로벌 전자 업계가 메모리 칩 확보 쟁탈전을 벌이고 있다고 미 월스트리트저널(WSJ)이 25일(현지시간) 조명했다. 이 신문은 스페이스X와 테슬라를 이끄는 일론 머스크 최고경영자(CEO)조차 삼성전자에 장기 구매계약을 제안했다가 이재용 회장에게서 거듭 '더 해줄 게 있느냐'는 반문을 듣고 진땀을 뺀 적이 있었다고 전했다. 보도에 따르면 자산운용사 캐피털그룹의 칼 카와자 포트폴리오 매니저는 지난 6월 열린 한 콘퍼런스에서 과거 자신이 테슬라의 메모리 칩 문제를 두고 머스크와 대화를 나눈 적이 있었다며 머스크가 겪었다는 일화를 소개했다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112618.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 이지헌 기자 = 인공지능(AI) 인프라 투자 붐으로 메모리 반도체가 극심한 공급난을 겪으면서 글로벌 전자 업계가 메모리 칩 확보 쟁탈전을 벌이고 있다고 미 월스트리트저널(WSJ)이 25일(현지시간) 조명했다. 이 신문은 스페이스X와 테슬라를 이끄는 일론 머스크 최고경영자(CEO)조차 삼성전자에 장기 구매계약을 제안했다가 이재용 회장에게서 거듭 '더 해줄 게 있느냐'는 반문을 듣고 진땀을 뺀 적이 있었다고 전했다. 보도에 따르면 자산운용사 캐피털그룹의 칼 카와자 포트폴리오 매니저는 지난 6월 열린 한 콘퍼런스에서 과거 자신이 테슬라의 메모리 칩 문제를 두고 머스크와 대화를 나눈 적이 있었다며 머스크가 겪었다는 일화를 소개했다. 당시 대화에서 머스크는 삼성전자에 장기 칩 구매계약을 제안했다가 이재용 회장으로부터 '남들도 다 그런 제안을 하는데, 뭘 더 해줄 수 있느냐'는 반문을 들었다고 했다. 이에 머스크가 삼성전자의 신규 반도체 공장 건설 프로젝트에 금융보증을 제공하겠다고 말하자, 이 회장은 또다시 '다들 그런 제안을 하는데, 뭘 더 해줄 수 있느냐'라고 답했다고 했다. 씨티그룹의 피터 리 반도체 애널리스트는 메모리 칩 공급난이 지속되면서 공급사와 고객사 모두 최장 5년의 구속력 있는 장기 계약을 원하고 있으며, 고객사들은 구매대금의 25∼30%를 선지급해야 하거나 신규 공장 투자비를 분담하기도 한다고 설명했다. 반도체 구매 기업들은 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스에게 구애하기 위해 아예 한국에 담당 직원을 보내 진을 치고 있다고 WSJ은 기술업계 임원들을 인용해 전했다. 특히 일부 거대 AI 기업은 삼성전자 반도체 공장 바로 앞에 숙소를 잡아 상주하게 하고, 매일 상황을 체크하며 납기 일정을 챙기고 있다. 미국의 자동차 업체 카르마 오토모티브의 마르케스 매캐먼 CEO는 한국의 반도체 공급사를 만나기 위해 최근 6개월 사이 한국을 네 차례 찾아야 했다. 그는 서울을 자주 방문하다 보니 단골 고깃집까지 생겼다고 WSJ은 전했다. WSJ은 "AI 붐을 뒷받침하는 데이터센터가 폭발적으로 늘어나면서 메모리 반도체가 한 세대에 한 번 있을 법한 공급난을 겪고 있다"며 "공급 부족으로 모두가 부품 확보를 위해 쟁탈전을 벌이고 있다"라고 설명했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/26 19:20 송고 2026년11월26일 19시20분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112618.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者李智贤＝美国《华尔街日报》25日（当地时间）报道，随着人工智能基础设施投资热潮令存储芯片陷入严重供应短缺，全球电子行业正展开争夺存储芯片的竞赛。该报称，就连带领SpaceX和特斯拉的首席执行官埃隆·马斯克，也曾向三星电子提出签订长期采购合同，却遭到李在镕董事长反复反问“还能再给点什么”，为此捏了一把汗。据报道，资产管理公司Capital Group的卡尔·卡瓦贾是投资组合经理。他在6月举行的一场会议上介绍过自己过去曾就特斯拉的存储芯片问题与马斯克交谈，并分享了马斯克经历的一段轶事。当时在交谈中，马斯克向三星电子提出签订长期芯片采购合同，却从李在镕董事长那里听到“别人也都提出这样的要求，你还能多给点什么”的反问。随后马斯克表示愿意为三星电子新建半导体工厂项目提供融资担保，这位董事长再次回答“大家都提出这样的要求，你还能多给点什么”。花旗集团半导体分析师彼得·李解释说，随着存储芯片供应短缺持续，供应商和客户都希望签订最长5年、具有约束力的长期合同，客户甚至需要预付25%至30%的货款，或者分摊新工厂的投资费用。报道援引科技行业高管的话称，半导体采购企业为了讨好三星电子和SK海力士，甚至派驻工作人员常驻韩国，大力维系关系。尤其是一些大型人工智能企业直接在三星电子半导体工厂附近安排员工住宿并常驻，每天查看情况、掌握交货日期。美国汽车企业Karma Automotive首席执行官马克斯·麦卡蒙最近6个月内为会见韩国半导体供应商四次赴韩。《华尔街日报》称，由于他经常造访首尔，甚至在那里有了一家常去的烤肉店。《华尔街日报》解释道：“随着支撑人工智能热潮的数据中心呈爆发式增长，存储半导体正经历一代人难遇一次的供应短缺；所有人都因供应不足而展开争夺，确保获得零部件。”本报通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送给版权方(c)韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月26日19时20分发稿，2026年11月26日19时20分发稿

https://leadership.ng/inec-no-political-.body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has assured Nigerians that the ballot papers to be used for Saturday’s nationwide mock accreditation exercise will not bear the names of any registered political parties. INEC Chairman, Prof. Joash Amupitan, gave the assurance on Wednesday during the commission’s meeting with Resident Electoral Commissioners (RECs) from the 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory in Abuja. Amupitan said the ballot papers would be pseudo-ballot papers designed solely for the simulation, dismissing concerns that the exercise could provide an opportunity for electoral manipulation ahead of the 2027 general elections. “The ballot papers to be used are pseudo-ballot papers and not containing the name of the registered political parties,” he said. He added that the absence of political party names would be visible to participants and members of the public. According to the INEC chairman, the mock accreditation will be conducted in two polling units per ward nationwide and will serve as an operational test of the commission’s electoral infrastructure and processes. He said the exercise would particularly assess the upgraded Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS), logistics arrangements and the INEC Result Viewing Portal (IReV). Amupitan explained that the simulation would test the transmission and verification of election results, alongside measures introduced to strengthen the credibility of the result management process. He disclosed that under the commission’s improved IReV protocol, figures entered by presiding officers on Form EC8A would undergo automated arithmetic consistency and over-voting checks before being uploaded to the portal. He said the measure was designed to ensure that results transmitted from polling units were accurate and verified by stakeholders present before upload, thereby reducing ambiguities associated with manual collation. The INEC chairman directed the RECs to ensure effective supervision of the exercise, disclosing that national commissioners had been instructed to return to their respective zones to monitor the process. He added that he would personally monitor the exercise in the field, while all RECs were expected to oversee preparations in their respective states and submit comprehensive technical audit reports by Monday. On preparations for the 2027 general elections, Amupitan charged the RECs to ensure the effective implementation of the commission’s plans, warning that the electoral timetable left little room for delays or prolonged deliberations. He described the RECs as the commission’s chief operational officers at the grassroots, stressing that the credibility and public acceptance of the 2027 elections would depend largely on their vigilance, neutrality and administrative efficiency. Amupitan urged them to build on lessons from recent off-cycle elections and the commission’s zonal readiness assessment meetings, noting that the general elections would involve significantly greater operational demands. He said INEC was managing a verified register of more than 100 million voters and would deploy BVAS devices alongside over 1.4 million ad-hoc personnel across the country. According to him, the exercise would cover diverse locations, including densely populated urban centres, remote riverine communities, insurgency-affected areas and locations hosting internally displaced persons. He warned that even minor administrative failures in any state could attract nationwide attention and undermine public confidence in the commission’s preparedness. The INEC chairman also disclosed that the commission had commenced the distribution of sensitive and non-sensitive election materials to states. https://leadership.ng/inec-no-political-.title_zh: INEC：周六模拟选民登记所用选票上没有政党名称
https://leadership.ng/inec-no-political-.body_zh: 尼日利亚独立国家选举委员会（INEC）向尼日利亚公民保证，用于周六全国模拟身份核验演练的选票不会印有任何注册政党的名称。INEC主席乔阿什·阿穆皮坦教授于周三在委员会与来自36个州及联邦首都阿布贾的常驻选举委员会（REC）举行的会议上作出这一保证。阿穆皮坦表示，选票将是专为此次模拟演练设计的模拟选票；他不认为该演练会为2027年大选前的选举操纵提供机会。他说：“所使用的选票是模拟选票，不包含注册政党的名称。”他补充说，参与人员和公众都能看到选票上没有政党名称。阿穆皮坦表示，全国模拟身份核验将在每个选区设立两个投票站，并将作为对委员会选举基础设施和流程的 operational 测试。他说，此次演练尤其将评估升级后的双模式选民身份核验系统（BVAS）、后勤安排以及INEC结果查阅门户（IReV）。阿穆皮坦解释道，此次模拟将测试选举结果的传输和核验，以及为加强结果管理流程可信度而推出的各项措施。他透露，根据委员会改进后的IReV协议，主管选举人员在EC8A表格中录入的数据，在上传至门户前将接受自动算术一致性检查和超额投票检查。他说，此举旨在确保投票站传输的结果准确，并在上传前由在场利益相关方核验，从而减少与人工汇总有关的歧义。INEC主席要求各REC对演练进行有效监督，并透露已指示全国委员返回各自负责区域监督流程。他补充说，他将亲自到现场监督演练，而所有REC均应监督各自州内的准备工作，并在周日前提交全面的技术审计报告。在筹备2027年大选方面，阿穆皮坦要求各REC确保委员会各项计划得到有效落实，并警告说，选举时间表几乎不容延误或长时间讨论。他称各REC是委员会在基层的主要执行官员，强调2027年大选的公信力和公众认可度将在很大程度上取决于他们的警觉性、中立性和行政效率。阿穆皮坦敦促他们总结近期非定期选举及委员会区域准备情况评估会议的经验，指出大选将带来显著更高的执行要求。他说，INEC正在管理一份经核实、包含逾1亿名选民的选民名册，并将在全国部署BVAS设备以及逾140万名临时工作人员。据他介绍，此次演练将覆盖多种不同地点，包括人口密集的城市中心、偏远的河流沿岸社区、受叛乱影响的地区以及境内流离失所者安置地点。他警告称，任何州出现哪怕轻微的行政失误，都可能引发全国关注，并削弱公众对委员会准备工作的信心。INEC主席还透露，委员会已开始向各州分发敏感和非敏感选举物资。因此，他敦促各REC解决近期非定期选举复盘中发现的操作难题、沟通缺口和后勤困难。阿穆皮坦进一步强调，为加强公众对2027年大选的信心，应优先确保选举流程的包容性并妥善记录相关程序。我们掌握最新动态。实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump fired a new tariff salvo on Wednesday on 14 major trading partners including China, Japan and the European Union, undeterred in his protectionist push by the losses his Republican Party suffered in U.S. midterm elections. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三向包括中国、日本和欧盟在内的14个主要贸易伙伴发动新一轮关税攻势。尽管其共和党在美国中期选举中失利，他仍决心推进保护主义政策。他的政府提议将最高潜在税率提高至20%至40%，以应对其所称这些国家正在推动的工业产能过剩。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump fired a new tariff salvo on Wednesday on 14 major trading partners including China, Japan and the European Union, undeterred in his protectionist push by the losses his Republican Party suffered in U.S. midterm elections. His administration proposed new maximum potential rates of 20 percent to 40 percent to counter excess industrial capacity that it says these countries are promoting. But the U.S. Trade Representative's office said it intends to cap new tariffs at lower levels agreed under trade deals that are completed or still under negotiation. In unveiling the results of an eight-month unfair trade practices investigation into excess industrial capacity, USTR aims to more fully rebuild Trump's tariff leverage after the Supreme Court in February struck down his broad global duties under a national emergencies law. The effort also seeks to put Trump's tariffs and associated trade agreements on more solid legal and political grounds by backing them with a court-tested trade law, Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, and addressing foreign subsidies and industrial policies that are viewed as major trade problems by both Republicans and Democrats. Separately, USTR proposed a new 10 percent tariff on imports of Brazil's finished Embraer commercial aircraft, and an increase in duties on imports of Brazilian sugar that exceed quotas as part of an effort to push Brasilia to rectify alleged unfair trade practices. The products were previously exempted from Trump's 25 percent tariffs on Brazilian goods that were imposed in July under a separate Section 301 investigation. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said he decided to propose the tariff increases after months of talks between the U.S. and Brazil made "no meaningful progress." Under the excess factory capacity probe, USTR said China would face the highest capped rate of 20 percent, which would be added to duties of roughly 25 percent imposed during Trump's first term. That rate would comply with a U.S.-China trade truce that expires on January 10. But if the truce unravels, China's rate would rise to 40 percent, the USTR said. Vietnam would face a capped tariff rate of 20 percent if it reaches a trade agreement with Washington, rising to 35 percent if negotiations fail. Greer said the tariffs, which would not take effect until after a January 25 public hearing, were intended to counteract "industrial strategies built on targeting manufacturing, wage and labor suppression, financial and other support, non-market economy inputs, and other market-distorting practices" that undermine the U.S. manufacturing base. The duties would not stack on top of prior tariffs of 10 percent or 12.5 percent imposed under a separate U.S. probe into lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws in 60 economies, nor would they add to sectoral national security duties on steel, aluminum, autos and other goods. Greer said the proposed tariffs also would not apply to about $30 billion of Chinese imports under consideration for tariff reductions through a bilateral mechanism known as the Board of Trade. Washington has long accused China of subsidizing industry and flooding global markets with low-cost exports ranging from steel to electric vehicles and solar products. A spokesperson for China's embassy in Washington rejected allegations that China is a source of excess capacity, but stopped short of threatening retaliation. "The so-called issue of 'industrial overcapacity' does not really exist and should not be used as a pretext for political manipulation," the spokesperson said, urging the two sides to jointly deliver on agreements between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The USTR also proposed capped tariff rates of 18 percent for imported goods from Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Bangladesh, and 15 percent, including existing "Most Favored Nation" duties, for Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the EU and Switzerland. India, which has yet to reach a trade deal with the Trump administration, would face a 17 percent tariff rate if an agreement is finalized and a 25 percent rate if talks fail, the USTR said. Singapore would receive a capped tariff rate of 10 percent. Greer told CNBC the proposed caps were consistent with trade agreements reached over the past year that also lowered barriers to U.S. exports. "We're sticking to that in terms of our proposals because we think a lot of these deals we made actually solve a lot of the problems we see in excess capacity or can go toward it," Greer said, adding that the capped rates are no surprise to trading partners. Mexico and Norway were excluded from the proposals because investigations into their trade practices remain under way, Greer said. Even so, the prospect of new trade barriers weighed on stock markets on Wednesday amid a renewed selloff in tech stocks. Major U.S. indexes opened down more than 1 percent, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite down more than 3 percent. "It is another reminder that while the legal justification for tariffs keeps changing, U.S. protectionism is becoming increasingly difficult to unwind," ING analysts wrote. U.S. Senator Ron Wyden, an Oregon Democrat who is expected to chair the Senate Finance Committee when the new Congress begins in January, said: "Not even a month after voters rejected his disastrous trade agenda, Trump has decided to yet again increase prices for Americans. As Finance Committee Chair, I will use every tool at my disposal to end Trump's disastrous tariffs." But that won't be easy, because there is bipartisan support in Congress for countering excess capacity largely centered in China, said Nathaniel Halvorson, a former USTR official who is now a trade partner at Baker Mckenzie. Undoing the tariffs also could cause some trade deals to collapse, Halvorson said, and Democrats "would have to consider whether they want to undo a settlement that might be working for U.S. interests to some extent."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国提议对产能过剩商品征收关税，并维持对韩国、日本和欧盟的15%上限
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三向包括中国、日本和欧盟在内的14个主要贸易伙伴发动新一轮关税攻势。尽管共和党在美国中期选举中遭遇惨败，他仍未因此放弃贸易保护主义主张。他的政府提议将最高潜在税率设定为20%至40%，以对抗其所称这些国家正在助长的工业产能过剩。但美国贸易代表办公室表示，拟将新关税上限维持在较低水平，即已完成或仍在谈判中的贸易协议所约定的水平。美国贸易代表办公室公布了对工业产能过剩开展8个月不公平贸易行为调查的结果，旨在最高法院2月依据《国家紧急状态法》推翻其广泛全球性关税后，更充分地重建特朗普的关税筹码。这项努力还试图通过经法院检验的《1974年贸易法》第301条，为特朗普的关税及相关贸易协议提供更坚实的法律和政治依据，并处理被共和党和民主党都视为重大贸易问题的外国补贴和产业政策。作为另一项举措，美国贸易代表办公室提议对进口自巴西的已完成型Embraer商用飞机征收10%的新关税，并提高超出配额的巴西进口糖的税率，以推动巴西利亚纠正所谓不公平贸易行为。此前依据另一项第301条调查于7月对巴西商品征收的25%特朗普关税，对这些产品予以豁免。美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔说，在美国与巴西进行了数月谈判却“没有取得实质性进展”后，他决定提议提高关税。根据工厂产能过剩调查，美国贸易代表办公室表示，中国将面临最高的20%上限税率，这是在特朗普第一任期内征收的约25%关税基础上叠加。该税率将符合将于1月10日到期的中美贸易休战安排。但如果休战破裂，中国税率将升至40%，美国贸易代表办公室称。如果越南与华盛顿达成贸易协议，其面临的关税上限税率将为20%；如果谈判失败，则将升至35%。格里尔说，这些关税要到1月25日公开听证会后才生效，旨在抵消“针对制造业、压低工资和劳工成本、发放金融及其他支持、使用非市场经济投入品以及其他扭曲市场行为而建立的产业战略”，因为这些做法削弱了美国制造业基础。这些关税不会叠加美国针对60个经济体在反强迫劳动法执行不力问题上另行调查所征收的10%或12.5%既有关税，也不会叠加针对钢铁、铝、汽车及其他商品征收的行业性国家安全关税。格里尔说，拟议关税也不适用于正通过一种名为贸易委员会的双边机制审议是否降低关税的约300亿美元中国进口商品。美国长期以来指控中国补贴工业，并以低成本出口商品充斥全球市场，商品从钢铁到电动汽车和太阳能产品不等。中国驻华盛顿大使馆发言人否认了中国是产能过剩来源的说法，但没有威胁进行报复。该发言人说：“所谓‘工业产能过剩’问题实际上并不存在，不应被用作政治操弄的借口。”他敦促双方共同落实唐纳德·特朗普与中国国家主席习近平达成的协议。美国贸易代表办公室还提议，对来自柬埔寨、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、泰国和孟加拉国的进口商品设置18%的关税上限税率；对日本、韩国、台湾、欧盟和瑞士设置15%的关税上限税率，其中包括现行“最惠国”关税。美国贸易代表办公室称，印度尚未与特朗普政府达成贸易协议，如果最终达成协议，其面临的关税税率将为17%；如果谈判失败，则为25%。新加坡将适用10%的关税上限税率。格里尔告诉CNBC，拟议的税率上限符合过去一年达成的贸易协议，这些协议也降低了美国出口商品面临的壁垒。格里尔说：“在提议方面，我们坚持这一点，是因为我们认为，我们达成的许多协议实际上解决了我们在产能过剩问题中看到的许多问题，或者有助于解决这些问题。”他补充说，关税上限对贸易伙伴而言并不意外。格里尔说，墨西哥和挪威未被列入提议范围，因为针对其贸易行为的调查仍在进行。即便如此，在科技股再次遭遇抛售之际，新贸易壁垒的前景仍对周三的股市造成压力。美国主要股指开盘跌幅均超过1%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数跌幅超过3%。ING分析师写道：“这再次提醒人们，尽管对征收关税的法律依据不断变化，但美国的贸易保护主义正变得越来越难以撤回。”预计将在新一届国会于1月开幕时出任参议院财政委员会主席的俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登说：“选民否决他灾难性的贸易议程还不到一个月，特朗普就决定再次提高美国人的物价。作为财政委员会主席，我将利用手中的一切工具，终结特朗普灾难性的关税。”但这并不容易，因为美国国会两党都支持应对产能过剩问题，且该问题主要集中在中国。曾在美国贸易代表办公室任职、现任Baker Mckenzie贸易合伙人纳撒尼尔·哈尔沃森说，撤销关税也可能导致一些贸易协议破裂，民主党“将不得不考虑，他们是否愿意推翻一项在一定程度上可能符合美国利益的和解方案。”

https://punchng.com/equities-extend-loss.body: Equities on the Nigerian Exchange Limited extended their losing streak on Wednesday, with market capitalisation slipping to N158.42tn and the All-Share Index dropping to 243,995.29 points. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 华盛顿消息——美国于周三提议，以韩国商品存在所谓过剩制造产能为由，在考虑双边贸易协定和现行关税后，对韩国商品加征最高15%的关税。美国贸易代表办公室提议，对所有韩国商品加征最高15%的关税，税额应扣除最惠国（MFN）关税率和现行第301条关税，但部分商品可获豁免。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — The United States proposed Wednesday imposing tariffs of up to 15 percent on Korean goods over alleged excess manufacturing capacity, taking into account a bilateral trade agreement and existing tariffs. The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) announced the proposed measures as it determined that the acts, policies and practices of Korea and 13 other economies, including China, Japan and the European Union (EU), relating to structural excess capacity and production in manufacturing sectors were unreasonable and burdened or restricted U.S. commerce. The USTR proposed applying tariffs of up to 15 percent on all Korean goods, net of most-favored-nation (MFN) tariff rates and existing Section 301 tariffs, with exemptions for certain goods. The proposal also accounts for existing Section 232 tariffs, ongoing consultations with Korea and commitments under the bilateral strategic trade and investment deal, the USTR said. In March, the Trump administration launched two separate Section 301 investigations, including a probe into 60 economies over forced labor concerns, as it sought to roll out new levies to replace country-specific "reciprocal" tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court in February. In July, the USTR announced new tariffs of up to 12.5 percent on Korea and other countries following the forced labor investigation. The latest proposal would effectively raise tariffs by up to 2.5 percentage points on Korean goods already subject to the 12.5 percent forced labor tariff, keeping the combined rate within the agreed 15 percent ceiling. In October last year, Seoul and Washington reached an agreement on Korea's $350 billion investment pledge made in exchange for Washington lowering tariffs on Korean goods from 25 percent to 15 percent. The USTR also proposed tariff rates within a 15 percent ceiling for Japan, Taiwan, Switzerland and the EU, taking into account existing trade agreements and tariffs. In its investigation into Korea, the USTR cited industrial and sectoral plans aimed at maintaining and expanding manufacturing, preferential lending through state-owned banks and a failure to address global excess capacity and production, including through imports and foreign direct investment from non-market economies. It claimed that such practices had reduced commercial opportunities for U.S. producers and exporters, harmed the U.S. manufacturing sector and increased economic security risks for the U.S., particularly in the automotive, semiconductor and petrochemical sectors. "For decades, many of our trading partners have adopted industrial strategies built on targeting manufacturing, wage and labor suppression, financial and other support, non-market economy inputs, and other market distorting practices that tilt the trade balance in their favor while eroding America's manufacturing base," U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said in a press release. The USTR will accept written comments on the proposed measures through Jan. 5 and hold public hearings starting Jan. 25. The Trump administration has been doubling down on its tariff policy as part of efforts to reduce America's trade deficits, bolster domestic manufacturing and foreign investments, and increase federal revenue, despite lingering concerns over its potential economic impact
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国提议在商定的15%上限内对韩国商品征收产能过剩关税
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国政府周三提议对韩国商品加征最高15%的关税，理由是韩国存在所谓的过剩制造业产能，并将考虑双边贸易协定和现行关税。美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）宣布了这些拟议措施。该办公室认定，韩国以及包括中国、日本和欧盟（EU）在内的其他13个经济体在制造业部门结构性产能过剩和产量方面的行为、政策与做法不合理，对美国商业造成负担或限制。USTR提议对所有韩国商品加征最高15%的关税，扣除最惠国（MFN）税率和现行“301条款”关税后计算，并对某些商品予以豁免。USTR表示，该提案还考虑了现行“232条款”关税、与韩国正在进行的磋商，以及双方双边战略贸易与投资协议中的承诺。今年3月，特朗普政府启动了两项单独的“301条款”调查，其中包括对60个经济体因强迫劳动问题展开的调查，以推出新税项取代最高法院今年2月推翻的国别“对等”关税。今年7月，USTR在完成强迫劳动调查后，宣布对韩国及其他国家加征最高12.5%的新关税。最新提案将实际把已适用12.5%强迫劳动关税的韩国商品的税率提高最多2.5个百分点，使合并税率维持在双方商定的15%上限以内。去年10月，首尔与华盛顿就韩国承诺投资3500亿美元达成协议，作为交换，美国将韩国商品关税从25%降至15%。USTR还提议对日本、台湾、瑞士和欧盟适用不超过15%上限的关税税率，并考虑现有贸易协定和关税。USTR在对韩国的调查指出，韩国制定了旨在维持和扩大制造业的产业和行业计划，通过国有银行提供优惠贷款，并且未能解决全球产能过剩和产量问题，包括来自非市场经济体的进口和外国直接投资。USTR称，此类做法减少了美国生产商和出口商的商业机会，损害了美国制造业，并增加了美国的经济安全风险，尤其是在汽车、半导体和石化行业。美国贸易代表Jamieson Greer在一份新闻稿中表示：“几十年来，我们的许多贸易伙伴一直采用以制造业、工资和劳动抑制、金融及其他支持、非市场经济体投入品以及其他扭曲市场的做法为基础的产业战略。这些做法使贸易天平向其有利方向倾斜，同时侵蚀了美国的制造业基础。”USTR将接受针对拟议措施的书面意见，提交期限截至1月5日，并从1月25日起举行公开听证会。特朗普政府正在加倍推行关税政策，作为减少美国贸易逆差、支持国内制造业和外国投资以及增加联邦收入努力的一部分，但其可能产生的经济影响仍引发担忧……

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112604.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 박상돈 기자 = 미국이 한국을 비롯한 14개 경제주체에 '과잉생산 관세'를 예고하며 중국에 기존과 비슷한 상한선을 적용하기로 한 것은 미중 무역전쟁이 다시 격화하는 것을 원하지 않기 때문이다. 중국은 첨단기술 분야에 꼭 필요한 핵심 광물인 희토류를 장악하고 있기 때문에 관세를 무기로 사용할 경우 보복이 불가피하다는 점을 인식하고 있는 것이다. 블룸버그 통신의 앤디 무커지 칼럼니스트는 26일(현지시간) '반도체와 희토류가 미중 간 휴전을 위태롭게 만든다'는 제목의 칼럼에서 "미국은 중국과의 광범위한 무역·기술 패권 경쟁에서 물러서고 있지 않지만, 어느 쪽도 자국에 피해를 주지 않고서는 이러한 경쟁을 지나치게 밀어붙일 수 없을 것"이라고 진단했다. 미 무역대표부(USTR)는 25일(현지시간) 한국과 중국, 일본, 유럽연합(EU) 등 14개 경제주체를 상대로 무역법 301조 조사 결과에 따른 과잉생산 관세를 제시했다. 이를 두고 미중 양국이 상대방에게 막대한 경제적 고통을 안겨줄 수 있는 능력을 갖추고 있고 이런 힘을 전면 행사할 경우 상대방의 보복을 불러올 수 있다는 사실을 잘 알기 때문이라는 분석이 나온다. 미국은 첨단 반도체 설계 분야에서 강력한 지배력을 행사하고 있고 중국은 첨단기술과 방위산업에 필수적인 갈륨과 게르마늄 등 핵심 광물 가공 분야를 장악하고 있다. 중국은 미중 무역전쟁 속에서 미국의 첨단 반도체 수출통제에 맞서 희토류와 핵심 광물을 무기화해 지난해 10월 말 부산에서 열린 미중 정상회담 이후 해당 조치를 오는 27일까지 1년간 유예했다. 이처럼 미중 간에 서로 취약한 부분이 있기 때문에 앞으로 수년 동안은 반복적인 갈등과 충돌이 발생하기 쉬운 '불안정한 안정' 상태가 지속될 수 있다는 전망이 나온다. 냉전 시대 개념인 '상호확증파괴'(Mutually Assured Destruction)'처럼 미중 양국이 서로에 치명적인 타격을 줄 수 있지만 그럴 경우 자국도 큰 피해를 볼 수 있기 때문에 자제한다는 것이다. 하지만 중국을 비롯한 수출국들이 미국 소비자에게 상품을 판매해 벌어들이는 무역흑자가 줄어들면 이들이 미국 금융자산에 재투자할 수 있는 달러는 줄어들게 된다. 이는 미국 연방정부의 재정적자 조달 비용도 높일 수 있고 막대한 인공지능(AI) 설비투자 때도 자금조달 비용 상승이라는 부담을 안길 수 있다. 반면 중국은 실물 상품의 국제 교역이 자유롭게 이뤄지기를 바라지만 자국 금융시스템을 보호하기 위해 자본계정은 폐쇄적으로 유지하려 한다. 그러나 완전한 자본 자유화가 이루어지지 않으면 중국과 직접적인 경제적 이해관계를 맺고 있지 않은 국가들은 위안화를 보유하는 데 소극적일 수밖에 없다. 결국 이러한 구조적 제약은 위안화가 달러에 맞서려는 야심에 한계를 부과하고 중국이 더욱 강경한 금융 보복 수단을 쓰도록 만들 수 있다. 무커지는 "기업들로서는 미중의 기술·무역 경쟁이 아무리 제한적인 수준으로 확대돼도 위험한 상황이 될 수 있다"며 "양국 모두 경제적 분리가 얼마나 막대한 비용을 초래하는지 이해하고 있다"고 분석했다. 그는 "이 때문에 관세 상한선이 유지되고 있고 중국의 핵심 광물도 현재까지는 계속 공급되는 것"이라며 "트럼프 대통령과 시진핑 주석이 지금 아슬아슬한 외줄타기를 하고 있다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/26 09:36 송고 2026년11월26일 09시36분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112604.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者朴相敦报道：美国预告将对包括韩国在内的14个经济体征收“过剩产能关税”，并拟对中国实施与现行措施类似的上限，是因为美国不希望中美贸易战再度升级。中国掌握着先进技术领域不可或缺的核心矿产——稀土，因此意识到一旦将关税作为工具使用，就难免招致报复。彭博社专栏作家安迪·穆凯吉26日（当地时间）以《半导体与稀土使中美停战变得不稳》为题发表评论并指出：“美国并未在与中国的广泛贸易和技术霸权竞争中退让，但任何一方都无法在不使本国遭受损害的情况下，把这种竞争推进到过度激烈的程度。”美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）25日（当地时间）向韩国、中国、日本、欧盟（EU）等14个经济体提出依据《贸易法》第301条调查结果征收的过剩产能关税。由此出现一种分析认为，中美两国都清楚彼此具备给对方造成巨大经济痛苦的能力，也深知若全面动用这种力量，将招致对方报复。美国在先进半导体设计领域拥有强大的主导地位，而中国则掌控着先进技术和国防工业必需的镓、锗等核心矿产加工领域。在中美贸易战中，中国为应对美国对先进半导体的出口管制，将稀土和核心矿产武器化，并在去年10月底于釜山举行的中美首脑会谈后，将相关措施推迟至27日，为期一年。由于中美双方在彼此领域都存在脆弱环节，未来数年可能持续一种容易反复出现摩擦和冲突的“不稳定的稳定”局面。就像冷战时代的“相互确保毁灭”（Mutually Assured Destruction）概念一样，中美双方虽然能够给对方造成致命打击，但一旦如此，本国也会遭受巨大损失，因此会保持克制。然而，如果包括中国在内的出口国因向美国消费者销售商品而获得的贸易顺差减少，它们能够用于再投资美国金融资产的美元也会随之减少。这可能推高美国联邦政府的财政赤字融资成本，也会在大规模投资人工智能（AI）基础设施时增加融资成本压力。另一方面，中国希望实物商品国际贸易能够自由进行，但为保护本国金融体系，仍倾向维持资本账户的封闭状态。然而，如果未实现完全资本自由化，与中国没有直接经济利害关系的国家将只能对持有人民币保持消极态度。归根结底，这些结构性限制可能限制人民币挑战美元的雄心，并促使中国采取更为强硬的金融报复手段。穆凯吉分析称：“对企业而言，中美技术与贸易竞争即使扩大到有限程度，也可能造成危险局面。两国都明白，经济脱钩将带来多么巨大的成本。”他表示：“正因如此，关税上限一直得以维持，中国的核心矿产目前也仍在继续供应。”他还说：“特朗普总统和习近平主席眼下正走在一根岌岌可危的钢丝上。”本报通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送给读者。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月26日09:36发稿，2026年11月26日09时36分发稿

https://punchng.com/2027-court-upholds-n.body: The Federal High Court in Benin City has declared Charity Aiguobarueghian as the Nigerian Democratic Congress House of Representatives Candidate for the Ovia Federal Constituency of Edo State. The court dismissed Edwin Omoregie’s challenge to Aiguobarueghian’s nomination as the party’s candidate. The presiding judge, Justice B. O. Quadri, also upheld as authentic the primary election result presented by Aiguobarueghian, leaving his candidacy for the House of Representatives intact. At issue in Suit No. FHC/B/CS/68/2026 was whose name the party should submit to the Independent National Electoral Commission for the forthcoming general election. Omoregie claimed that he had won the Ovia primary and asked the court to compel the party to forward his name to the commission. The party and the commission were joined as the second and third defendants respectively. Politics of blood: Rising violence threatens 2027 elections Naira weakens to N1,455/$ as reserves shed $108m Delta killings: NDC gov candidate suspends campaign for seven days Aiguobarueghian, the first defendant, defended both the conduct of the primary and its outcome. He maintained that the contest had been free, fair and credible, and that the result reflected the will of the people of Ovia. He urged the court to dismiss Omoregie’s claim. In his ruling, Justice Quadri said, “Omoregie had commenced proceedings outside the period prescribed by section 285 of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and that his originating summons was therefore statute-barred.” The judge also examined the rival results, rejected those tendered by Omoregie and accepted Aiguobarueghian’s as the authentic record of the primary. The court dismissed the suit in its entirety and directed each party to bear its own costs. Adeyinka Adedipe

https://punchng.com/2027-court-upholds-n.body_zh: 贝宁城联邦高等法院裁定，Charity Aiguobarueghian成为尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）民主众议院在埃多州Ovia联邦选区的众议院候选人。法院驳回了Edwin Omoregie针对Aiguobarueghian获该党候选人提名的异议。首席法官B. O. Quadri法官还确认Aiguobarueghian提交的初选结果真实有效，使其众议院候选人的资格继续有效。FHC/B/CS/68/2026号诉讼案的争议焦点是，该党应将谁的姓名提交给独立国家选举委员会参加即将举行的全国大选。Omoregie声称自己赢得了Ovia初选，并请求法院强制该党将他的姓名提交给委员会。该党和委员会分别作为第二和第三被告加入诉讼。血腥政治：暴力事件增多威胁2027年选举奈拉兑美元跌至1,455，外汇储备减少1.08亿美元三角洲地区杀戮：NDC政府候选人暂停竞选七天作为第一被告的Aiguobarueghian为初选过程及其结果进行了辩护。他坚称竞选自由、公平且可信，结果反映了Ovia民众的意愿。他敦促法院驳回Omoregie的主张。Quadri法官在裁决中表示：“Omoregie是在《尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法》第285条规定的期限之外提起诉讼的，因此他的启动传票受法律时效限制。”法官还审查了双方提交的初选结果，驳回Omoregie提交的结果，并采纳Aiguobarueghian提交的结果，将其认定为初选的真实记录。法院驳回该诉讼的全部请求，并命令各方各自承担诉讼费用。Adeyinka Adedipe

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: Share via Copy link The US has deported 1,700 Indian nationals since the start of this year, and the Indian side is firmly opposed to illegal immigration and is cooperating with American authorities on all matters related to migration and mobility, the external affairs ministry said on Wednesday. “Since the beginning of this year, we’ve had 1,700 Indian nationals deported from [the US],” external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said in response to a question on the matter at a regular media briefing. “We have ongoing cooperation with the US on migration and mobility and India is firmly against illegal immigration. On deportation matters, we have cooperation with the US,” he said. Once the Indian side receives information about a person who is to be deported, it verifies their nationality and then agrees to take them back, Jaiswal said while explaining the deportation process. These 1,700 Indians were deported “for one reason or the other”, he said without going into details. The external affairs ministry had said in July that the US had deported more than 4,800 Indian nationals since 2025. The US administration stepped up the deportation of illegal migrants from across the world as part of a crackdown that began soon after President Donald Trump took office last year. The number of Indians deported from the US in 2025 – 3,567 – was the highest in the past 16 years, according to figures provided by the government in Parliament. External affairs minister S Jaishankar told Parliament in December last year that the government had engaged US authorities to ensure Indian nationals being deported were not ill-treated, and that women and children were not restrained on deportation flights with handcuffs and chains. The maltreatment of 73-year-old Harjit Kaur during her deportation last year and the shackling of women and children on a deportation flight in February 2025 triggered a controversy, and India formally protested over these incidents. https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The discussions, believed to have lasted more than a week, were the second round of such talks in the Arunachal Pradesh sector since September. They were held following reports of aggressive posturing by Chinese troops along the Line of Actual Control (LAC), especially in the Upper Subansiri region. “A meeting of the senior, highest military commanders was held in the eastern sector recently. Discussions between the two sides focused on improving border management, as also addressing outstanding issues along the LAC,” external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal told a regular media briefing when he was asked about the talks. “Such interactions are aimed at maintaining peace and tranquillity in the border areas and preventing any escalation,” he said. India and China regularly engage through diplomatic and military mechanisms, he added. Lt Gen Girish Kalia, General Officer Commanding of the Indian Army’s 3 Corps based near Dimapur in Nagaland, led the Indian side at the talks held in the second week of November, while the Chinese side was headed by his counterpart. In September, Kalia and a Chinese military commander held flag talks in two sessions on either side of the LAC in the Arunachal Pradesh sector. Tensions erupted between the Indian Army and the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) at Taksing, a remote area of Upper Subansiri district, in July and August. The Indian side said at the time that the two sides had agreed to use diplomatic and military mechanisms to “avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation” along the border. A similar mechanism for talks between military commanders already exists in the western sector, which includes Ladakh, the scene of a military face-off in 2020 that dragged on for more than four years and took bilateral relations to a six-decade low. The Indian side has maintained that the state of the border will determine the overall course of the relationship with China. During the military and diplomatic talks, India has stressed to the Chinese side the importance of maintaining peace and tranquillity in the border areas for the continued development of bilateral ties. The two sides have taken a series of measures to rebuild their ties since October 2024, when they reached an understanding on disengaging frontline forces at several “friction points” along the LAC in the Ladakh sector. At the same time, the Indian side has bolstered military preparedness and infrastructure along the LAC in the Arunachal Pradesh sector. At a meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the margins of the Brics summit in New Delhi in September, Prime Minister Narendra Modi stressed that both sides must show sensitivity to each other’s core issues and that bilateral relations should be guided by the “three mutuals” – mutual respect, mutual sensitivity and mutual interest. Rezaul Hasan Laskar is Foreign Editor with the Hindustan Times, which he joined in 2015. He began as a journalist in his hometown of Shillong in northeast India and has worked in newspapers and wire services over the years. He moved to New Delhi in 1997 and initially focused on defence, national security, Jammu and Kashmir and the northeast, while also working of foreign policy and international relations. He has been part of the media delegation accompanying PMs on foreign visits and has reported from destinations ranging from Tibet to Ukraine. Between 2007 and 2013, he was the Press Trust of India correspondent in Pakistan, one of only two Indian journalists allowed to report from the country. He extensively covered Pakistan’s domestic politics and the life of the common people, as well as the fallout of the 2008 Mumbai attacks on India-Pakistan relations and the subsequent trial in Pakistan of the suspects involved in the attack. As part of his reportage in Pakistan, he travelled the breadth of the country, from the Swat Valley to Balochistan. Reza’s first gig in journalism was writing a weekly music column, and music – especially classic rock – remains a keen interest. He is also a movie buff and a keen photographer

https://www.inquirer.net/496735/ph-boost.body: The three-day summit, held in Manila from Nov. 15 to 17, ended without the breakthrough President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. had hoped to achieve, with negotiations on the COC remaining 80% complete. Chester Cabalza, president of the think tank International Development and Security Cooperation, said the West Philippine Sea, which the Philippines claims based on provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, became a central focus of the negotiations. Marcos wanted the COC completed as the country hosted the 49th Asean Summit, with Palace Press Office spokesperson Claire Castro saying the President hoped an agreement would be reached before the Philippines turned over the Asean chairmanship to Singapore. READ: Marcos wants South China Sea code of conduct finalized during Asean Cabalza told the Inquirer that while the Philippines attempted to balance diplomatic conciliation with China on paper, “unresolved debates over the COC’s legally binding nature, geographic scope, and the inclusion of the 2016 arbitral award” prevented Manila from sealing the deal. The Philippines, which has faced direct confrontations with China over the West Philippine Sea in recent years, had pushed for a legally binding agreement that would establish clear rules of conduct in the South China Sea and prevent maritime incidents from escalating into armed confrontations. The COC was 50% complete when the country assumed the chairmanship this year, the Department of Foreign Affairs said. The department highlighted the “substantial completion of the negotiations” on the document, with Asean and China reaching a “provisional agreement on about 80% of the paragraphs.” READ: Marcos thanks Asean, China for remaining committed to finishing COC READ: Failure to finalize South China Sea code was expected – expert Cabalza said the negotiations were constrained by Asean’s consensus-based and noninterference decision-making system, which allows individual member states to influence or prevent the adoption of agreements. He cited Laos as an example of a country that could exercise considerable leverage under the consensus rule. This, he said, could potentially affect the strength of the final document and result in language more favorable to China. Cabalza also stressed that Singapore’s 2027 chairmanship was not guaranteed to prioritize maritime security, saying it could instead focus on other regional initiatives that may be easier to advance, including climate-related cooperation and environmental agreements concerning the high seas. The unresolved issues raise questions about whether the momentum generated during the Philippines’ chairmanship can be sustained or whether negotiations will face further delays next year or beyond, given Asean’s consensus-based decision-making process and the differing political and economic interests of its member states. Despite failing to meet the deadline, the Philippines offset the lack of a binding Asean-China agreement on conduct in the South China Sea by securing bilateral security commitments on the sidelines of the summit, including a new defense agreement with Australia. The agreement provides a framework for deeper cooperation in maritime domain awareness, littoral operations, logistics and sustainment, cyber defense, secure communications, joint operations planning, force protection and defense infrastructure development. Japan also emerged as an important security partner during the Philippines’ Asean chairmanship, with discussions focusing on strengthening defense cooperation and improving the country’s maritime capabilities. During the summit, Japan indicated that it was seeking to accelerate negotiations on the possible transfer of destroyers to the Philippine Navy. The Philippines’ security discussions during the summit also coincided with the visit of U.S. President Donald Trump, who met with Marcos in Malacañang on Nov. 18. The two leaders reaffirmed the longstanding alliance between Manila and Washington, anchored in the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty. During their meeting, Trump was asked about his level of concern over tensions in the West Philippine Sea and the readiness of the United States should the Philippines invoke the defense agreement. https://www.inquirer.net/496735/ph-boost.body_zh: 这场于11月15日至17日在马尼拉举行的三天峰会结束时，并未实现菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯二世所期望的突破，有关《行为准则》的谈判仍有80%尚未完成。智库International Development and Security Cooperation主席切斯特·卡巴尔萨表示，菲律宾依据《联合国海洋法公约》相关条款提出主权主张的西菲律宾海，成为谈判的核心焦点。马科斯希望在该国主办第49届东盟峰会期间完成《行为准则》。总统府新闻办公室发言人克莱尔·卡斯特罗表示，总统希望菲律宾在将东盟主席国职位移交给新加坡之前达成协议。阅读：马科斯希望在东盟任内敲定南海行为准则。卡巴尔萨告诉《菲律宾询问者报》，虽然菲律宾试图在书面上平衡与中国的外交和解，但“围绕《行为准则》是否具有法律约束力、适用地理范围以及是否纳入2016年仲裁裁决的未决争论”，使马尼拉无法敲定协议。近年来，菲律宾因西菲律宾海问题多次与中国发生直接对峙，并一直推动达成具有法律约束力的协议，以确立南海明确的行为规则，防止海上事件升级为武装冲突。菲律宾外交部表示，该国今年接任东盟主席国时，《行为准则》的完成度为50%。该部门强调，菲律宾和中国已就文件中的“约80%的段落达成临时协议”，表明谈判已“取得实质性进展”。阅读：马科斯感谢东盟和中国继续致力于完成《行为准则》。阅读：专家称，南海行为准则未能如期敲定在意料之中。卡巴尔萨说，谈判受到东盟以共识为基础且不干涉内政的决策体系制约，该体系允许个别成员国影响或阻止协议的通过。他以老挝为例，说明成员国在共识规则下能够发挥相当大的影响力。他说，这可能影响最终文件的力度，并导致其中出现更有利于中国的措辞。卡巴尔萨还强调，新加坡2027年担任东盟主席国时未必会把海上安全列为优先事项，而可能侧重于更容易推进的其他区域倡议，包括气候相关合作以及涉及公海的环境协议。鉴于东盟以共识为基础的决策程序，以及成员国之间不同的政治和经济利益，上述未决问题引发了人们对菲律宾任主席国期间所积累势头能否延续的疑问，也不禁令人担忧谈判明年或更长时间之后是否还会进一步延误。尽管未能如期完成具有约束力的东盟—中国南海行为准则，菲律宾仍在峰会期间通过争取双边安全承诺，弥补缺乏东盟—中国约束性协议所留下的缺口，其中包括与澳大利亚达成的一项新防务协议。该协议为双方在海上态势感知、沿岸行动、后勤保障、网络防御、安全通信、联合行动规划、部队防护和防务基础设施开发等方面深化合作提供了框架。在菲律宾担任东盟主席国期间，日本也成为重要的安全伙伴，双方讨论重点是加强防务合作以及提升菲律宾的海上能力。峰会上，日本表示正寻求加快可能向菲律宾海军转让驱逐舰的谈判。菲律宾在峰会期间展开的安全讨论，还与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的到访同步进行。特朗普于11月18日在马拉卡尼昂宫与马科斯会面。两位领导人重申了马尼拉与华盛顿之间以1951年《共同防御条约》为基础的长期同盟关系。会谈期间，有人询问特朗普对西菲律宾海紧张局势的关注程度，以及在菲律宾启动防务协议时美国是否准备采取行动。他的回答很简短：“我完全不担心。我对此毫不担心。那会得到处理的。”/dm 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海专题页面。阅读文章、视频和专家观点，持续了解最新动态。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has dismissed reports alleging that $2.04 billion realised from crude oil cargoes lifted by Duke Oil Company Incorporated, now NNPC Trading S.A., was unaccounted for, insisting that all transactions were fully reconciled. In a statement by its Chief Corporate Communications Officer, Andy Odeh, NNPC said the absence of separate dollar receipts for some cargoes did not indicate missing funds.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）驳斥了有关 Duke Oil Company Incorporated（现为 NNPC Trading S.A.）承运的原油货物实现收入20.4亿美元去向不明的报道，坚称所有交易均已完全核对。NNPC首席企业传播官 Andy Odeh 在声明中表示，部分货物缺少单独的美元收款凭据，并不意味着资金失踪。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has dismissed reports alleging that $2.04 billion realised from crude oil cargoes lifted by Duke Oil Company Incorporated, now NNPC Trading S.A., was unaccounted for, insisting that all transactions were fully reconciled. The company said the $2.04 billion represented the gross value of 29 cargoes whose proceeds were set off against the cost of refined petroleum products supplied to Nigeria under the Direct Sale Direct Purchase (DSDP) programme. In a statement by its Chief Corporate Communications Officer, Andy Odeh, NNPC said the absence of separate dollar receipts for some cargoes did not indicate missing funds. “No separate receipt appears because the crude sale proceeds were set off against the product purchase price, as the contracts provide,” it stated. Under the DSDP programme, participating traders lifted crude oil in exchange for refined petroleum products, including petrol, for the Nigerian market. NNPC explained that while crude was priced in dollars, products supplied were sold in naira, with transactions reconciled and captured in the audited financial statements of the relevant entities. The company said all 59 cargoes referenced in the reports were accounted for, adding that 30 were paid for in dollars, while proceeds from 28 cargoes, valued at approximately $1.96 billion, were remitted in naira to the NNPC Group Treasury or NNPC Upstream Investment Management Services accounts. The remaining cargo, a February 2023 Bonga tax-oil lifting valued at about $75.9 million, was paid into the then designated Federal Inland Revenue Service dollar account. On Duke Oil’s ownership, NNPC said it was incorporated in 1989 as its wholly owned trading subsidiary, adding that the relationship was documented in its corporate history, audited financial statements and NEITI’s 2023 industry report. It maintained that transactions between the company and its subsidiaries were disclosed as related-party transactions under International Financial Reporting Standards. NNPC reaffirmed its commitment to transparency and accountability, but warned that it reserved the right to take legal action against publications it considered false or misleading. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.title_zh: 20.4亿美元Duke Oil原油货物不存在资金短缺问题
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）否认了有关Duke Oil Company Incorporated（现为NNPC Trading S.A.）提取的原油货物所得20.4亿美元去向不明的说法，并坚称所有交易均已完全核对。公司表示，这20.4亿美元是29船原油货物的总值，其收益已抵扣根据直接销售直接购买（DSDP）计划向尼日利亚供应的精炼石油产品成本。公司首席企业传播官Andy Odeh在声明中表示，NNPC称，部分原油货物没有单独的美元收款，并不意味着资金失踪。“没有单独的收款凭证，是因为原油销售收益按照合同规定抵扣了产品购买价款，”他指出。根据DSDP计划，参与贸易商以提取原油换取面向尼日利亚市场的精炼石油产品，包括汽油。NNPC解释称，原油以美元定价，而供应的石油产品则以奈拉出售，相关交易经过核对，并列入相关实体的经审计财务报表。公司表示，报道提及的全部59船货物均已有着落，其中30船以美元付款，另外28船货物的收益约为19.6亿美元，已以奈拉汇入NNPC集团资金部门或NNPC上游投资管理服务的账户。剩余的一船货物是2023年2月提取的Bonga税油，价值约7590万美元，款项已汇入当时指定的联邦内陆税务局美元账户。关于Duke Oil的所有权，NNPC表示，该公司于1989年成立，是其全资贸易子公司，双方关系记录在公司的企业历史、经审计财务报表以及NEITI的2023年行业报告中。NNPC坚持，公司与其子公司之间的交易已依据国际财务报告准则披露为关联方交易。NNPC重申致力于保持透明和问责，同时警告将保留对其所认为虚假或误导性的出版物采取法律行动的权利。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的意见

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Samsung SDI said Wednesday that its Ulsan plant has won the Grand Prize at the 2026 Green Management Awards, organized by the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Korea Environmental Industry & Technology Institute (KEITI). The plant received the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment Award in the Excellent Green Company category, which recognizes companies demonstrating outstanding environmental management in areas such as carbon neutrality and resource conservation. The Green Management Awards recognize exemplary achievements in environmental management, environmental information disclosure and environmental, social and governance (ESG) practices. Samsung SDI's Ulsan plant became the first battery industry facility in Korea to receive Green Company designation in 1999 and has maintained the status for 27 consecutive years, reflecting its long-standing commitment to environmentally responsible operations. In April, the plant became the first private-sector facility to be recognized as a high-performing site under the ministry's water conservation program. It reuses 90 percent of its wastewater and has cut annual municipal water consumption by approximately 74,000 cubic meters. The plant is also pursuing carbon neutrality by operating solar power facilities and introducing energy-efficient equipment, reducing its annual greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 5,000 metric tons. In addition, it has earned Platinum certification, the highest level under UL Solutions' Zero Waste to Landfill program, while maintaining a waste recycling rate of more than 99.9 percent. Samsung SDI has also received broader recognition for its ESG performance, including a record 21 inclusions in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class index and an AA rating from MSCI ESG Ratings. “This award recognizes the Ulsan plant's longstanding efforts to improve its environmental performance,” a Samsung SDI official said. “We will continue to advance our environmental management efforts to support sustainable growth and create lasting value for society.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Samsung SDI蔚山工厂荣获绿色管理最高奖项
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Samsung SDI周三表示，其蔚山工厂获得了由气候、能源和环境部与韩国环境产业技术研究院（KEITI）组织的2026年绿色管理大奖最高奖。该工厂荣获气候、能源和环境部部长奖“优秀绿色企业”类别大奖，表彰那些在碳中和、资源保护等领域展现出卓越环境管理能力的企业。绿色管理大奖旨在认可环境管理、环境信息披露以及环境、社会和治理（ESG）实践方面的卓越成就。Samsung SDI蔚山工厂于1999年成为韩国首家获得“绿色企业”称号的电池行业设施，并连续27年保持这一资格，体现了其长期致力于环境责任运营的承诺。今年4月，该工厂成为该部节水计划下首个获认定为高绩效场所的私营部门设施。工厂重复利用了90%的废水，每年减少市政用水约74,000立方米。该工厂还通过运营太阳能发电设施和引进节能设备来追求碳中和，每年减少温室气体排放约5,000公吨。此外，该工厂还获得了UL Solutions“零废弃物填埋”计划的最高等级——铂金级认证，同时保持超过99.9%的废弃物回收率。Samsung SDI的ESG表现也获得了更广泛认可，其中包括创纪录地21次入选道琼斯最佳管理指数，并获得MSCI ESG评级的AA评级。Samsung SDI一名官员表示：“此次奖项认可了蔚山工厂为改善环境绩效所作的长期努力。我们将继续推进环境管理工作，支持可持续增长并为社会创造持久价值。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: An event aimed at helping Korean companies connect with overseas procurement markets kicked off its two-day run in Seoul on Wednesday, the Public Procurement Service (PPS) said. The Global Public Procurement Marketplace 2026, co-hosted by the PPS, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency and KEPCO KPS, brings together over 110 prospective buyers and more than 330 local companies, the PPS said. This year, PPS has placed particular emphasis on expanding opportunities for domestic companies to enter new overseas public procurement markets, including those of international organizations, and supporting export market diversification. As part of such an initiative, the agency has invited representatives from major UN procurement organizations, including the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR). They are scheduled to hold in-depth, one-on-one consultations with local companies, the state agency explained. The justice ministry has also participated for the first time this year to offer legal consultations related to export contracts. On the sidelines of the event, a showcase of outstanding Korean products will be held until Thursday to promote advanced technologies and products from local firms to overseas procuring entities, the agency added. "As a trusted partner in overseas public procurement, PPS will continue to provide strong support for Korean companies seeking to expand their export reach," Baek Seung-bo, the administrator of the PPS, said. The event is part of the procurement agency's long standing effort to support local small and medium-sized enterprises in gaining access to overseas markets, and is aimed at sustaining Korea's export growth following its historic achievement of reaching $1 trillion in exports early this month, he added

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国公共采购服务机构（PPS）表示，一项旨在帮助韩国企业对接海外采购市场的活动于周三在首尔开幕，为期两天。由PPS、韩国外交部、韩国贸易投资促进机构和KEPCO KPS共同主办的“2026全球公共采购市场”汇聚了110多名潜在买家和330多家韩国本地企业。PPS表示，今年尤其重视为韩国企业拓展新的海外公共采购市场，包括国际组织的采购市场，并支持出口市场多元化。作为相关举措的一部分，该机构邀请了联合国开发计划署（UNDP）、联合国难民署（UNHCR）等联合国主要采购机构的代表。他们预计将与韩国本地企业进行深入的一对一 consultations。该国家机构解释道，韩国司法部今年也首次参与活动，为出口合同相关事宜提供法律咨询。该机构补充称，活动期间还将举行优秀韩国产品展示活动，持续至周四，以向海外采购实体推介韩国企业的先进技术和产品。PPS负责人白承模说：“作为海外公共采购领域值得信赖的合作伙伴，PPS将继续大力支持寻求扩大出口覆盖范围的韩国企业。”他补充说，这项活动是采购机构长期以来帮助韩国本地中小企业进入海外市场 efforts 的一部分，旨在延续韩国出口增长势头；韩国本月早些时候实现了出口额达到1万亿美元的历史性突破。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Ministry of Justice has significantly accelerated the nationality reinstatement process for ethnic Koreans living abroad, cutting the average review time by four months — from 13 months down to nine. For applicants experiencing the fastest processing, wait times have been reduced by as much as seven months, offering swift relief to thousands eager to formally reconnect with their homeland. The breakthrough stems from an intensive, three-month processing campaign conducted between August and October, according to the ministry. Facing a growing backlog fueled by a steady rise in applications from ethnic Koreans living abroad, the ministry overhauled its operational capacity. Previously, a single dedicated officer handled the workload, processing an average of roughly 220 cases per month. By deploying four additional specialists to the team, the ministry dramatically scaled up its output, resolving a total of 4,664 cases over the three-month period. This boosted the monthly average to 1,555 cases — more than seven times the previous pace. For overseas Koreans seeking to restore their citizenship — often retirees returning home or individuals looking to reunite with family and establish long-term roots — lengthy administrative delays have historically created significant uncertainty regarding healthcare, residency, and daily life. By trimming the review period to nine months or less, the government aims to ease the psychological and practical burdens of prolonged waiting, helping returning compatriots settle stably into Korean society. Beyond clearing the immediate backlog, the justice ministry said it is also modernizing how applicants track their cases. Beginning in December, individuals applying for naturalization or nationality reinstatement will be able to check their specific, estimated completion dates directly through the status inquiry portal on HiKorea , the government’s official immigration website. This upgrade eliminates the guesswork that previously left applicants in the dark during months of processing. Acting Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo emphasized the human impact of the administrative overhaul. "Reducing the nationality reinstatement review period is deeply meaningful because it provides practical support for our compatriots starting a new chapter as citizens of the Republic of Korea," Lee said. He added that the ministry remains committed to expanding its review workforce and strengthening its administrative capabilities to ensure future evaluations are both prompt and thorough. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国将居住在国外的朝鲜族恢复国籍的等待时间缩短至9个月
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 司法部大幅加快了居住在海外的朝鲜族恢复国籍的办理进程，将平均审查时间缩短了四个月，从13个月降至9个月。对于办理速度最快的申请人，等待时间最多缩短了七个月，使数千名渴望正式与祖国重新建立联系的人士迅速获得便利。司法部表示，这一突破得益于8月至10月开展的为期三个月的集中办理行动。面对海外朝鲜族申请数量持续增长所导致的积压案件不断加剧，司法部对自身办案能力进行了全面调整。此前，只有一名专职官员负责相关工作，平均每月处理约220件案件。司法部向团队增派四名专业人员后，处理能力显著提升，在三个月内共办结4,664件案件，使月均处理量增至1,555件，是此前速度的七倍以上。对于希望恢复公民身份的海外朝鲜族人士而言——他们通常是返乡养老的退休人员，或是希望与家人团聚并在当地长期生活的人士——冗长的行政审批延误历来使其在医疗、居留和日常生活方面面临诸多不确定性。通过将审查期缩短至九个月以内，政府旨在减轻长期等待带来的心理和实际负担，帮助返乡同胞稳妥融入韩国社会。司法部表示，除清理当前积压案件外，该部还在现代化申请进度查询方式。自12月起，申请入籍或恢复国籍的人士将可通过韩国政府官方移民网站HiKorea的状态查询门户，直接查询个案预计完成日期。此次升级消除了以往数月办理期间申请人无法了解进度的情况。代理司法部长李进秀强调了行政审批改革对民众生活的意义。李进秀说：“缩短恢复国籍的审查期具有重大意义，因为这为以大韩民国公民身份开启人生新篇章的同胞提供了实际支持。”他还表示，司法部仍致力于扩大审查人员队伍、强化行政能力，确保今后的审查既及时又周全。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korean shares extended their losses late Wednesday morning, reversing the previous session's rally, as investors tracked overnight losses in technology stocks on Wall Street. After opening a sharp 3.94 percent lower, the benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) extended its losses, shedding 277.22 points, or 5.54 percent, to 4,728.81 as of 11:20 a.m., and falling below the psychologically important 5,000 mark. As the market lost ground, the Korea Exchange activated a sell-side sidecar at 9:09 a.m., suspending buy orders in program trading for KOSPI-listed shares for five minutes. On Tuesday, the KOSPI rebounded more than 6 percent as chipmakers rallied amid a global wave of optimism sparked by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to the spotlight. Overnight, U.S. stocks closed mixed as Nvidia gave back part of its historic gains from the previous day and concerns over fresh U.S. tariffs weighed on the tech sector. Market bellwether Samsung Electronics dropped 9.03 percent, while its chipmaking rival SK hynix surrendered 8.55 percent. Among other index heavyweights, SK Square, the parent of SK hynix, fell 10.77, while power equipment manufacturer Samsung Electro-Mechanics shed 9.44 percent. The Korean won was quoted at 1,342.9 won against the U.S. dollar as of 11:20 a.m., up 0.1 won from the previous session's close
