https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国股市周三上午延续跌势，推翻了前一交易日反弹的成果，投资者关注着华尔街科技股隔夜遭遇的损失。基准指数韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）开盘即大幅下挫3.94%，随后跌幅扩大，截至上午11时20分下跌277.22点，跌幅达5.54%，报4,728.81点，并跌破具有重要心理意义的5,000点关口。随着市场走弱，韩国交易所于上午9时09分启动卖出侧边车机制，暂停对KOSPI上市股票的程序化交易买单5分钟。周二，Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋重返公众视野，引发全球乐观情绪热潮，芯片制造商随之上涨，KOSPI反弹逾6%。隔夜，美股收盘涨跌互现，Nvidia吐回前一日创下的部分历史涨幅，而市场对美国新关税的担忧则拖累科技板块。市场风向标Samsung Electronics下跌9.03%，其芯片制造竞争对手SK hynix下跌8.55%。其他指数权重股中，SK hynix母公司SK Square下跌10.77%，电力设备制造商Samsung Electro-Mechanics下跌9.44%。截至上午11时20分，韩元兑美元报1,342.9韩元，较前一交易日收盘价上涨0.1韩元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei is guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets, US jury finds
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: NEW YORK — A U.S. jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies on Tuesday of conspiring to steal trade secrets and defrauding banks as it grew into one of the world’s biggest suppliers of gear for wireless telecommunications networks.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 纽约——美国陪审团周二裁定，中国科技巨头Huawei Technologies犯有共谋窃取商业秘密和欺诈银行罪；随着其发展成为全球最大的无线电信网络设备供应商之一。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — A U.S. jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies on Tuesday of conspiring to steal trade secrets and defrauding banks as it grew into one of the world’s biggest suppliers of gear for wireless telecommunications networks. But jurors acquitted Huawei of the most serious charge: engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy, a result that the company's lawyer said was a “profound rejection” of the government's narrative that it was corrupt from top to bottom and had a corporate culture of cheating, stealing and lying. Prosecutors had used the charge, commonly found in organized crime and drug cases, to accuse Huawei of operating illicitly to poach intellectual property and technological secrets from competitors and partners. The convictions covered allegations that the company did business in countries subject to U.S. sanctions — including Iran and North Korea — and made false statements to U.S. government officials and banks as part of an effort to hide its misdeeds. In all, Huawei was convicted on 10 of 12 counts. The case in Brooklyn federal court involved no human defendants, but the company could be made to pay billions of dollars in penalties when it is sentenced next September. “Few crimes are as serious as Huawei’s decades-long pattern of endangering U.S. national security, violating the sanctity of U.S. commerce, and impeding the enforcement of U.S. laws,” Brooklyn U.S. Attorney Joseph Nocella Jr. said in a statement. “No person or company is above the law,” Attorney General Todd Blanche said. Huawei’s lawyers said U.S. investigators had used isolated episodes of wrongdoing by a few of the company’s more than 200,000 employees to spin a false narrative about a grand conspiracy that didn’t actually exist. Huawei lawyer Brian Heberlig said the company would appeal the convictions but was heartened by the acquittals on racketeering conspiracy and another charge, conspiracy to obstruct justice. He called those not guilty verdicts “a vindication of the company and its good-faith compliance culture.” “The allegations that the government made in this case overreached and simply weren’t consistent with the successful, innovative and hardworking company that we came to know and deeply respect,” Heberlig said outside the courthouse. It's unclear what effect the verdict might have on Huawei's global fortunes. The company hasn't been allowed to sell equipment to U.S. carriers for years because of security concerns. It has also been blacklisted by other Western allies, including Canada and Britain. That hasn't stopped the company from doing a robust business elsewhere. Its smartphones and other telecom equipment are sold globally. More recently, it has expanded into chipmaking as the boom in artificial intelligence fuels demand for microprocessors, becoming an important alternative in China to chips made by companies such as Nvidia. “Huawei has always adhered to integrity in business, upheld business ethics, respected intellectual property, and remained committed to complying with all applicable laws and regulations,” the company said in a statement. “We remain focused on serving our customers and partners and ensuring continuous and stable business operations," the statement said. The U.S. announced its criminal charges against Huawei in early 2019 and later expanded the allegations . The lengthy trial began in September. Chinese officials said the U.S. has engaged in “economic bullying” and improperly used national security as a pretext for oppressing Chinese companies. The US alleged a pattern of theft reaching all the way to the top The indictment against Huawei accused it of a long pattern of outright technology thefts. Huawei, prosecutors said, once sold internet routers containing source code copied from a competitor. In another episode, a person working for Huawei slipped into a competitor's booth at a Chicago trade show to surreptitiously photograph the circuits inside another company's networking device, the indictment said. Prosecutors said that on another occasion, a Huawei worker removed a robotic arm from a competitor's lab so it could be photographed and measured. The victim companies included Cisco Systems, Motorola Solutions, T-Mobile, Quintel USA and Fujitsu, according to court records. “The tone was set at the top by Huawei leaders and executives who themselves engaged in criminal conduct, like lying to Congress, lying to banks, violating U.S. sanctions and trying to interfere with the very criminal investigation that led to this case,” prosecutor Meredith Arfa told the jury at the trial. In its statement, Huawei referred to those matters as “trade secret-related disputes” that were the subject of civil litigation that was resolved over the past two decades. “No court ever found Huawei liable for willful intellectual property misappropriation, and the company was never ordered to pay damages for trade secret misappropriation,” the company said. Huawei says it isn’t defined by isolated allegations of wrongdoing In his closing argument to jurors, Huawei's lawyer said prosecutors leaned on “innuendo and facts ripped out of context,” and testimony from ex-employees “with a bone to pick,” to pursue a company that had relied on “hard work, innovation and competition” to succeed. “Huawei didn’t steal its way to success,” Heberlig said, noting that much of the material the U.S. alleges was stolen was already public. He said Huawei paid billions of dollars in licensing fees over the years, with 75% of that money going to U.S. companies, and had reprimanded or fired employees found to have engaged in wrongdoing. Heberlig noted that lines of Cisco source code turned up in Huawei software more than two decades ago. He said when the source-code copying was discovered, Huawei recalled routers sold in the U.S. and offered to replace them with Cisco routers and created a “compliance culture that permeates Huawei today.” No individual executives or employees faced trial, although prosecutors at one point also brought criminal charges against Huawei's chief financial officer, Meng Wanzhou . They accused her of misleading HSBC bank about the company’s business dealings in Iran. Meng, the daughter of Huawei’s founder, was arrested in Canada in 2018, but ultimately was allowed to return to China in 2021 in a prisoner swap that freed two Canadians held by China. As part of the deal, the U.S. dropped its case against Meng. The trial in New York overlapped with a summit between President Donald Trump , China’s Xi Jinping and Russia’s Vladimir Putin in the technology-centric city of Shenzhen, China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国陪审团裁定，中国科技巨头华为犯有窃取商业秘密的共谋罪
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约——一个美国陪审团周二裁定，中国科技巨头Huawei Technologies犯有共谋窃取商业秘密和欺诈银行的罪名；随着该公司成长为全球最大的无线电信网络设备供应商之一，这些指控随之而来。但陪审员免除了华为最严重的罪名，即参与犯罪性敲诈勒索共谋。华为的律师称，这一结果是对政府所谓“华为从上到下都腐败不堪、形成了欺骗、偷窃和撒谎的企业文化”这一叙事的“深度否定”。检方曾利用这一常见于有组织犯罪和毒品案件的指控，指控华为违法经营，以窃取竞争对手和合作伙伴的知识产权及技术秘密。这些定罪涉及的指控包括：华为与受美国制裁的国家开展业务，包括伊朗和朝鲜；并向美国政府官员和银行作出虚假陈述，以掩盖其不当行为。华为在12项指控中的10项上被判有罪。布鲁克林联邦法院审理的此案没有人类被告，但明年9月宣判时，华为可能被处以数十亿美元罚款。布鲁克林联邦检察官Joseph Nocella Jr.在一份声明中说：“很少有罪行像华为长达数十年的行为模式一样严重，这些行为危及美国国家安全、破坏美国商业的尊严并妨碍美国法律的执行。”司法部长Todd Blanche说：“任何个人或公司都不凌驾于法律之上。”华为的律师说，美国调查人员利用公司20多万名员工中少数人的零散不当行为，炮制了一套并不存在的宏大阴谋叙事。华为律师Brian Heberlig说，公司将对定罪提出上诉，但对敲诈勒索共谋以及另一项妨碍司法共谋指控获判无罪感到欣慰。他称，这些无罪裁决证明“公司和其诚信合规文化获得了正名”。Heberlig在法院外说：“政府在本案中提出的指控越了界，也与我们逐步认识并深切尊重的这家成功、创新和勤奋的公司根本不符。”目前尚不清楚这一裁决会对华为的全球发展产生何种影响。多年来，由于安全方面的担忧，华为一直无法向美国运营商销售设备。它也遭到包括加拿大和英国在内的其他西方盟友列入黑名单。但这并未妨碍该公司在其他地方蓬勃开展业务。其智能手机和其他电信设备在全球销售。最近，随着人工智能热潮推动微处理器需求，华为还扩展到芯片制造领域，成为中国市场上一款可替代Nvidia等公司芯片的重要选择。华为在一份声明中说：“华为始终恪守商业诚信，坚守商业道德，尊重知识产权，并始终致力于遵守所有适用的法律法规。”声明说：“我们将继续专注于服务客户和合作伙伴，确保业务持续稳定运营。”美国于2019年初宣布对华为提出刑事指控，后来又扩大了指控范围。这场漫长的审判于9月开始。中国官员称，美国搞“经济霸凌”，并不当利用国家安全作为压迫中国企业的借口。美国指控存在一路延伸至高层的盗窃行为模式。对华为的起诉书指控其长期赤裸裸地窃取技术。检方称，华为曾销售过含有从竞争对手复制的源代码的互联网路由器。起诉书说，另一次事件中，一名华为工作人员潜入竞争对手在芝加哥贸易展会上设立的展台，秘密拍摄另一家公司网络设备内部的电路。检方说，还有一次，一名华为工作人员从竞争对手的实验室搬走一条机器人手臂，以便对其拍照和测量。根据法院记录，受害公司包括Cisco Systems、Motorola Solutions、T-Mobile、Quintel USA和Fujitsu。检察官Meredith Arfa在庭审中告诉陪审员：“基调是由华为的高层领导和高管定下的，他们本人也参与刑事犯罪活动，比如向国会撒谎、向银行撒谎、违反美国制裁，并试图干扰最终促成此案的刑事调查。”华为在声明中把这些事件称为“与商业秘密有关的纠纷”，相关民事诉讼已在此前20年间得到解决。公司说：“从没有任何法院认定华为对故意侵占知识产权负有责任，也从未命令公司就商业秘密侵占行为支付赔偿金。”华为表示，零散的不当行为指控并不能定义公司。在向陪审团作结案陈词时，华为的律师说，检方依赖“含沙射影和断章取义的事实”，以及与华为“有过节”的前员工的证词，妄图追究一家依靠“努力、创新和竞争”取得成功的公司。“华为没有靠偷窃走向成功，”Heberlig说，并指出美国所称许多被盗材料早已公开。他说，华为多年来支付了数十亿美元许可费，其中75%的资金流向美国公司；公司还曾对被发现从事不当行为的员工进行训诫或解雇。Heberlig指出，20多年前，Cisco的源代码曾出现在华为软件中。他说，源代码复制行为被发现后，华为召回了在美国销售的路由器，并提出用Cisco路由器予以更换，还建立了“贯穿华为今天的合规文化”。没有个别高管或员工出庭受审，不过检方一度也对华为首席财务官Meng Wanzhou提出刑事指控。他们指控她在公司对伊朗的业务往来方面误导HSBC银行。Meng是华为创始人的女儿，2018年在加拿大被捕，但最终于2021年获准返回中国；当时双方达成换俘协议，中国释放了两名被扣押的加拿大公民。作为协议的一部分，美国撤销了对Meng的案件。纽约这场审判与一场峰会时间重叠；美国总统Donald Trump、中国国家主席Xi Jinping和俄罗斯总统Vladimir Putin在中国以科技闻名的城市深圳举行了会晤。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korea's Yongbyon nuclear complex expansion may boost weapons-grade uranium production, says US science institute
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: WASHINGTON — North Korea's latest expansion of a uranium enrichment facility at its Yongbyon nuclear complex may be aimed at increasing its production of weapons-grade uranium, a U.S. research institute assessed Tuesday. The Washington-based Institute for Science and International Security (ISIS) made the assessment in a report based on satellite imagery of the facility, located some 100 kilometers north of Pyongyang, whose rapid expansion has drawn concern from the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — North Korea's latest expansion of a uranium enrichment facility at its Yongbyon nuclear complex may be aimed at increasing its production of weapons-grade uranium, a U.S. research institute assessed Tuesday. The Washington-based Institute for Science and International Security (ISIS) made the assessment in a report based on satellite imagery of the facility, located some 100 kilometers north of Pyongyang, whose rapid expansion has drawn concern from the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). The institute said satellite imagery of the newly built extension indicated that it consists primarily of a large hall without internal dividing walls, raising the possibility that it could accommodate additional uranium enrichment equipment. "Another possibility is that the added hall is designed specifically to make weapon-grade uranium (WGU)," the report said. Other possible purposes include increasing low-enriched uranium production, expanding operational support for existing enrichment facilities or accommodating research and development activities, according to the report. Satellite imagery showed that construction of the extension began in September and progressed rapidly, the institute said. North Korea has previously expanded its original uranium enrichment plant at Yongbyon twice, with the first expansion taking place in 2013 and the second beginning in the 2021-22 period, according to the institute. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi raised concern over the rapidly built extension on Nov. 18, although the U.N. nuclear watchdog did not provide an assessment of its intended purpose
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国科学研究所称，朝鲜龙川核设施扩建可能提高武器级铀产量
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——一家美国研究机构周二评估称，朝鲜最近扩建位于甏普 nuclear complex的浓缩铀设施，可能旨在增加武器级铀的产量。位于华盛顿的科学与国际安全研究所（ISIS）在一份报告中作出了这一评估。该报告以该设施的卫星图像为依据。设施位于平壤以北约100公里处，其快速扩建已引起国际原子能机构（IAEA）的关注。研究所称，新建扩建部分的卫星图像显示，它主要由一座没有内部隔墙的大型厂房构成，因此可能容纳更多浓缩铀设备。报告称：“另一种可能是，新增厂房专门用于制造武器级铀（WGU）。”据报告称，其他可能的用途包括增加低浓缩铀产量、为现有浓缩设施扩大运行支持，或容纳研究与开发活动。研究所称，卫星图像显示，扩建工程于9月开工并迅速推进。据该研究所介绍，朝鲜此前曾两次扩建位于甏普的原有浓缩铀厂，第一次扩建发生在2013年，第二次始于2021年至2022年期间。国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·格罗西于11月18日对这项迅速建成的扩建工程表示担忧，但这家联合国核监督机构没有就其预期用途作出评估

Through conversations with founders and senior executives, the series examines their market-entry strategies, local challenges and ambitions to build global brands that resonate with consumers beyond China.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 这是探讨中国消费品牌如何拓展韩国市场的六篇访谈系列第一篇。韩国是亚洲竞争最激烈的市场之一。通过与创始人及高级管理人员对话，本系列考察他们进入市场的策略、面临的本地挑战，以及打造能够吸引中国以外消费者的全球品牌的雄心。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: This is the first in a six-part interview series exploring how Chinese consumer brands are expanding into Korea, one of Asia’s most competitive markets. Through conversations with founders and senior executives, the series examines their market-entry strategies, local challenges and ambitions to build global brands that resonate with consumers beyond China. At around 7 p.m. on a recent Monday, more than half of the dozen or so tables were occupied at a Yangguofu Malatang restaurant in Yeoksam, an office-packed area in Seoul's Gangnam District. Vegetables, fish balls, rice cakes and instant noodles lined a refrigerated self-service topping bar, while pickled radish, peanuts and dipping sauces were available nearby. Two employees juggled cooking, payments, serving and clearing tables in the orange-hued restaurant. Yangguofu Group, one of China's largest malatang chains with nearly 7,000 outlets worldwide, has grown its overseas network from just over 20 in early 2023 to more than 200 across 30 countries and territories, as it steps up its global expansion. Yet the company is a much smaller player in Korea, where malatang — which literally translates to “numbing, spicy, scalding-hot” — found a receptive audience in a country fond of spicy food and hot soups. The dish has become popular enough to be proposed for inclusion in the country’s consumer price index basket. Yangguofu entered the Korean market in 2019 and now has 10 outlets, all franchised, according to its website - less than half its peak store count. Zhu Hongzhen, its global chief supervisor and head of the brand centre, described the contraction as a strategic choice from adding stores to improving their performance. "Opening more stores is not our primary goal," he said. "What matters is the quality and making sure franchisees can make profits." The efforts include upgrading outlets to the latest orange-colored interior — the “sixth-generation design” as the company puts it — to diversifying soup options and adding dishes such as fried rice and guobaorou, a Chinese sweet-and-sour pork dish to suit local tastes. Prospective franchisees are assessed on restaurant experience, financial resources and location. Zhu estimated that a Korean outlet could recoup its initial investment in about a year, depending on operating condition. Zhu said Yangguofu would prioritize quality over scale in Korea, resuming expansion only once the malatang market showed signs of recovery and its localization efforts met internal targets. The company also faces competition from established chains, including Tanghuo Kungfu and Chunli, as well as numerous independent operators. Facing these challenges, Yangguofu sees "consistency of flavour" as its competitive edge. Its signature herbal bone broth base is made at a company-owned factory in Chengdu, Sichuan province, while franchisees source most fresh ingredients locally. The company provides training and operational guidance ahead of store openings. The model, combining standardized production with local execution, underpins its wider overseas plan. "In the past, Chinese food largely followed migrants overseas, who opened restaurants to make a living," Zhu said. "Now, chains are expanding systematically," drawing on regional teams, supply chains, research and development, and marketing expertise. The push has also gained government backing. In 2024, Beijing issued guidelines encouraging restaurant operators to expand overseas. Shanghai, where Yangguofu is headquartered, has since introduced initiatives offering overseas market guidance, regulatory assistance and supply-chain support. Yangguofu is focusing on Britain, France and Germany, the eastern United States and Asian markets including Japan, Korea, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. It has established six overseas warehouses and plans regional "central kitchens" once local store networks reach sufficient scale, allowing fresh and frozen ingredients to be centrally prepared and distributed. The company is also tailoring its offerings, from curry-flavored broth in the U.S. to tom yum in Europe, while developing halal-compliant production capacity for certain markets. Company-operated outlets also serve as showcases. At its London Chinatown flagship, a basement entertainment space has hosted stand-up comedy, part of an effort to turn restaurants into social destinations. After years of investment in infrastructure building and branding, Zhu said the overseas business could break even this year. But the ambition extends beyond selling more bowls of malatang. Yangguofu hopes to introduce Chinese concepts of food as nourishment, herbal ingredients and cultural symbolism to overseas consumers, while becoming part of their everyday dining habits. How much of that culture can travel with the food remains "an open question," Zhu acknowledged. Wency Chen is a reporter with the South China Morning Post. Currently away from her home base in Shanghai, she is based in Seoul, reporting for both The Korea Times and the SCMP as part of an exchange program
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 从本地暖心美食到全球连锁：麻辣烫巨头在韩国的考验
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 这是六篇系列访谈的第一篇 explores 中国消费品牌如何拓展亚洲最具竞争力的市场之一——韩国。通过与创始人及高级管理人员对话，本系列考察他们进入市场的策略、面临的本地挑战，以及打造能赢得中国以外消费者青睐的全球品牌的雄心。前不久一个星期晚上7点左右，首尔江南区办公楼密集的猎鹰洞一家杨国福麻辣烫餐厅里，十几张餐桌中已有过半座满。冷藏自助配料台上摆着蔬菜、鱼丸、米糕和方便面，旁边还有腌萝卜、花生和蘸料。两名员工在这家橙色调餐厅里同时忙于烹饪、收银、上菜和收拾餐桌。杨国福集团是中国规模最大的麻辣烫连锁品牌之一，在全球拥有近7000家门店。随着公司加快全球扩张，其海外门店网络已从2023年初的20多家增至30个国家和地区的200多家。然而，在韩国，杨国福仍是一家规模小得多的经营者。麻辣烫字面意思是“麻辣、滚烫”，在这个喜爱辣食和热汤的国家找到了乐于接受的受众。这道菜已广受欢迎，以至于有人提议将其纳入该国消费者价格指数的篮子。杨国福于2019年进入韩国市场，如今有10家门店，且全部采取加盟模式 according to its website——不到其门店数量峰值的一半。其全球 chief supervisor 兼品牌中心负责人朱鸿真将这一收缩描述为一项战略选择：从增加门店转向改善门店表现。“开设更多门店不是我们的首要目标，”他说，“重要的是品质，并确保加盟商能够盈利。”这些工作包括将门店升级为最新的橙色内装——公司称之为“第六代设计”——丰富汤底选择，并加入炒饭和锅包肉等菜品，以迎合当地口味。公司会从餐厅体验、财务资源和选址等方面评估潜在加盟商。朱估计，视经营状况而定，一家韩国门店大约一年即可收回初始投资。朱表示，杨国福在韩国将把品质置于规模之上，只有在麻辣烫市场显现复苏迹象、且本地化工作达到内部目标后，才会重启扩张。公司还面临来自唐火功夫、春丽等成熟连锁品牌以及众多独立经营者的竞争。面对这些挑战，杨国福将“口味一致性”视为其竞争优势。其标志性的草本骨汤底料在四川省成都市一家公司自有工厂生产，而加盟商则从当地采购大部分新鲜食材。公司会在门店开业前提供培训和运营指导。这种将标准化生产与本地执行相结合的模式，支撑着其更广泛的海外计划。“过去，中国餐饮主要是跟着出海的移民走，他们开餐厅谋生，”朱说，“如今，连锁品牌正在系统性扩张”，并借鉴区域团队、供应链、研发和营销方面的经验。这项推进还获得了政府支持。2024年，北京发布指导意见，鼓励餐饮企业向海外扩张。杨国福总部所在的上海此后推出了多项举措，为企业提供海外市场指导、监管协助和供应链支持。杨国福正重点关注英国、法国、德国、美国东部，以及包括日本、韩国、新加坡、马来西亚和泰国在内的亚洲市场。公司已设立6座海外仓库，并计划在当地门店网络达到一定规模后设立区域“中央厨房”，集中制作和配送新鲜及冷冻食材。公司还在调整产品，例如在美国提供咖喱风味汤底，在欧洲提供冬阴功汤，同时为某些市场开发符合清真要求的产能。公司直营门店也充当展示窗口。在其伦敦唐人街旗舰店里，地下娱乐空间已举办过单口喜剧表演，这是公司将餐厅打造为社交场所的一部分努力。朱表示，在多年投入基础设施建设和品牌建设之后，海外业务今年可能实现收支平衡。但其目标不止于卖出更多麻辣烫。杨国福希望向海外消费者介绍中国以食养生的理念、草本食材和文化寓意，同时成为他们日常饮食的一部分。朱承认，有多少文化能随食物一同传播，仍是“一个悬而未决的问题”。Wency Chen 是《南华早报》记者。她目前离开上海驻地，常驻首尔，作为交流项目的一部分同时为《韩国时报》和《南华早报》撰稿。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. State Department on Tuesday stressed the importance of close cooperation with South Korea following President Lee Jae Myung's nomination of new officials to lead the country's foreign policy, intelligence and inter-Korean affairs. On Monday, Lee nominated Lim Woong-soon, currently the second deputy national security adviser, as foreign minister; former Justice Minister Kang Kum-sil as director of the National Intelligence Service (NIS); and former lawmaker Hong Ihk-pyo as unification minister. "The United States values the importance of close cooperation in the U.S.-ROK Alliance," a State Department spokesman said in response to a query from Yonhap News Agency regarding the nominations of new Cabinet members and a new spy chief. ROK stands for the Republic of Korea, South Korea's official name. "We continue to advance U.S. and mutual interests with our ally the ROK," the spokesman said. The nominees are subject to parliamentary confirmation hearings before their formal appointments. The nominations came amid concerns over friction in bilateral intelligence cooperation following Unification Minister Chung Dong-young's disclosure in March of North Korea's Kusong region as one of the sites housing a uranium enrichment facility. The disclosure, made during a parliamentary session, reportedly prompted Washington to restrict Seoul's access to some intelligence on North Korea. In October, the NIS acknowledged that it had been excluded from a June trilateral meeting with the United States and Japan on North Korean cyber threats. The agency, however, maintained that intelligence sharing between Seoul and Washington remained active across a wide range of areas and that the overall volume of intelligence provided by the U.S. had not declined

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国国务院周二强调，在韩国总统李在明提名新官员负责该国外交、情报及韩朝事务后，与韩国密切合作的重要性。周一，李提名现任第二副国家安全顾问林戊勋担任外交部长，前司法部长姜根实担任国家情报院（NIS）院长，前议员洪锡镛担任统一部长。美国国务院发言人在回答韩联社关于新内阁成员及新情报机构负责人提名的提问时说：“美国重视美韩同盟密切合作的重要性。”ROK是韩国的官方名称大韩民国。该发言人说：“我们继续与作为盟友的韩国推进美国和双方的共同利益。”这些提名人选须接受议会确认听证，之后才能正式获任。上述提名出台之际，双边情报合作出现摩擦引发担忧。此前，统一部长郑东永于3月披露，朝鲜龟城地区是铀浓缩设施所在地之一。据报道，这一披露是在一次议会会议上作出的，促使华盛顿限制首尔获取部分有关朝鲜的情报。今年10月，NIS承认，该机构未获准参加6月举行的一次有关朝鲜网络威胁的美日韩三方会议。不过，该机构坚持称，首尔与华盛顿之间的情报交流仍在广泛领域保持活跃，美国提供的情报总量也未减少

Unlock these with Subscription The Trump administration is poised to imminently release the findings of a probe aimed at countering alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 major U.S. trading partners, three people with knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), with new import duties on a wide range of goods expected. The results of the investigation are expected as soon, these people said. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term. It is unclear what tariff rates would be proposed. One of the people said that the duties would be specifically tailored to each country, with goods from Mexico and Norway unlikely to see any immediate levies. USTR has been investigating most of the US’s largest trading partners under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 over what it called evidence of excess industrial capacity. The White House is expected to honor capped tariff rates that were included in finalized US trade deals with partner countries, this person said. These include duty caps of 15% on goods from the EU, Japan and South Korea and 19% for Malaysia. The U.S. also is expected to honor the 20% cap on Trump’s second-term tariffs on goods from China, as long as a trade truce due to expire on January 10 is extended. If it expires, the Chinese excess capacity rate would rise to a higher level. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the White House did not respond to Reuters queries about the pending announcement. Ryan Majerus, a former senior Commerce Department trade official, said he expects a lengthy report that could include differentiated tariff remedies for each of the 16 trading partners. Majerus, a partner with King & Spalding, said the administration could propose high tariff rates of 15% to 25% on imports from countries deemed to have excess capacity in various sectors. Those levies would stack on top of existing tariffs of 10% or 12.5% imposed under a separate investigation into lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws. However, he said the administration could also propose lower tariff rates with escalation clauses that would ratchet rates higher over time unless countries take steps to reduce excess production capacity. The countries included in the probe are China, India, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Vietnam, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Switzerland, Norway, Singapore, Bangladesh and Cambodia, along with the European Union. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that the probe’s results could be unveiled as soon as this week. USTR launched the excess capacity probe in March, along with a separate probe into weak or lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws in 59 countries and the European Union. Together, the duties are meant to rebuild Trump’s global “Liberation Day” tariffs that were struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February. The Trump administration has singled out China as the biggest source of excess industrial capacity, which it says is flooding global markets with steel, aluminum, electric vehicles, appliances, solar products and other goods. China has rejected the accusations, saying its exports reflect competitive advantages. The probe is also partly directed at Chinese investment into countries in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Indonesia and Cambodia, to manufacture goods for the US market and avoid prior US tariffs. Under a U.S.-China trade truce due to expire on January 10, the Trump administration has capped second-term tariffs on Chinese goods at 20%, in addition to duties of about 25% imposed during Mr. Trump’s first term. The US has already imposed a 12.5% anti-forced labor duty on all Chinese imports, leaving only 7.5% to reach the 20% cap. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A senior North Korean official has held talks with China's top envoy to Pyongyang and reiterated her country's commitment to cementing relations with Beijing, the Chinese Embassy in the North said Tuesday. Ryu Un-hae, vice minister at the Ministry of External Economic Relations, met Chinese Ambassador Wang Yajun at the embassy in Pyongyang on Monday, taking stock of progress in bilateral ties following the summits between North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and Chinese President Xi Jinping in September 2025 and again in June, according to the embassy. Ryu said that under the "strategic" guidance of the two countries' leaders, bilateral relations have entered a "new phase," while pointing to "positive progress" in bilateral cooperation in various fields, according to the embassy. "North Korea's Ministry of External Economic Relations is willing to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with relevant departments, such as the Chinese Embassy and China's Ministry of Commerce, to contribute greatly to pushing for the development of North Korea-China relations," Ryu was quoted as saying. He also reaffirmed Beijing's "firm" and "unwavering" position about maintaining and solidifying its traditional relations with Pyongyang. "The Chinese Embassy is willing to work with the Ministry of External Economic Relations to better implement important agreements reached by the top leaders of the countries and further deepen practical cooperation in the economy, trade and other fields to benefit the people of both nations," the ambassador was quoted as saying. Relations between North Korea and China have recently improved following high-level exchanges and reciprocal visits by the two countries' leaders. In July, Ryu accompanied North Korean Premier Pak Thae-song during Pak's trip to China to attend events marking the 65th anniversary of the signing of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Riot Games, the U.S. developer behind global hit games, including League of Legends and Valorant, will fund the conservation of a rare 14th-century Korean Buddhist painting held by the Asian Art Museum in San Francisco, the company said Tuesday. The painting, "The Buddha Amitabha with the Eight Great Bodhisattvas," dates from the Goryeo Kingdom, which ruled the Korean Peninsula from 918 to 1392. Amitabha, the Buddha who presides over the Pure Land paradise, sits cross-legged on a high pedestal. Below him stand eight bodhisattvas, enlightened beings who help others reach salvation, four on each side. Only about 10 paintings of this type survive worldwide, including works at the National Museum of Korea and a temple in Japan. The San Francisco painting was collected by Avery Brundage, a former president of the International Olympic Committee, who donated it to the museum in 1972. The painting has been brought to Korea for the work, which is expected to take about two years. When it is finished in 2028, the painting will go on public display in exhibitions in Korea and abroad. The project is part of an overseas heritage conservation program run by the Overseas Korean Cultural Heritage Foundation, an affiliate of the Korea Heritage Service. It is the first time private donations have paid for the conservation of a Goryeo Buddhist painting held overseas. Most of Riot's past heritage projects involved artifacts from the later 1392-1910 Joseon Kingdom, which are far more plentiful than surviving Goryeo paintings. The U.S.-based games developer has worked with the heritage agency since 2012. It has helped bring cultural artifacts back to Korea from abroad seven times. It has also paid to conserve Joseon royal ceremonial objects and Joseon-era flags held by a University of Pennsylvania museum. Last year, it became the first private company to pass 10 billion won ($7 million) in total heritage donations. "Players' love for games has transcended hundreds of years to breathe new life into a beautiful 14th-century heritage," said Jo Hyuk-jin, Riot Games Korea's chief executive. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Riot Games资助保护收藏于美国的珍贵高丽佛教画作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 美国游戏开发商 Riot Games 是《英雄联盟》和《Valorant》等全球热门游戏的开发公司。该公司周二表示，将出资保护旧金山亚洲艺术博物馆收藏的一幅罕见的14世纪朝鲜佛教画作。这幅名为《阿弥陀佛与八大菩萨》的画作创作于高丽王朝时期，高丽王朝于918年至1392年统治朝鲜半岛。主管西方极乐世界的佛陀阿弥陀佛盘腿坐在高高的基座上，下方站着八大菩萨。菩萨是帮助他人获得救度的觉者，左右两边各有4位。全世界仅存约10幅此类画作，其中包括韩国国立博物馆收藏的作品以及日本一座寺庙中的作品。旧金山这幅画由国际奥委会前主席艾弗里·布伦达格收藏，他于1972年将其捐赠给亚洲艺术博物馆。为开展修复工作，这幅画已运往韩国，预计修复将耗时约两年。修复工作预计于2028年完成，届时这幅画将在韩国及海外的展览中公开展出。该项目是韩国文化遗产振兴院旗下海外文化遗产保护计划的一部分。韩国文化遗产振兴院隶属于韩国国家文化遗产管理局。这是首次由私人捐款支付海外收藏的高丽佛教画作的保护费用。Riot Games以往参与的大多数文化遗产项目涉及较晚的1392年至1910年朝鲜王朝时期文物，因为这类文物远多于现存的 고丽时期画作。这家总部位于美国的游戏开发商自2012年以来一直与韩国文化遗产机构合作，曾帮助将海外文化文物迎回韩国7次。他还出资保护宾夕法尼亚大学一家博物馆收藏的朝鲜王朝王室礼仪用品和朝鲜王朝时期旗帜。去年，Riot Games成为首家累计文化遗产捐款突破100亿韩元（700万美元）的民营企业。Riot Games韩国公司首席执行官赵赫真表示：“玩家对游戏的喜爱跨越了数百个年头，为美丽的14世纪文化遗产注入新的生命。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: HONG KONG — Asian stocks advanced after a rally on Wall Street as Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia’s CEO, while U.S. futures edged higher and oil prices fell. Taiwan’s Taiex led gains in Asian markets, climbing more than 9 percent, driven by gains of nearly 10 percent for chip-related stocks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp. and Mediatek. The Kospi in Seoul advanced 6.5 percent to 5,014.41 as Samsung Electronics rose 7.5 percent and SK Hynix gained 8.6 percent. Japan’s benchmark Nikkei 225 rose 3.9 percent to 58,654.40. Computer chip equipment maker Tokyo Electron climbed 10.5 percent and testing equipment maker Advantest surged 14.1 percent. “We are seeing a reaction to the rally in US tech stocks overnight on the announcement that Jensen Huang is returning to NVIDIA as the CEO,” said Neil Newman, managing director and head of strategy at Astris Advisory Japan. “It is obviously a big surprise and a knock-on effect will be through Asia,” Newman said. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng edged 0.2 percent higher to 22,432.45, while the Shanghai Composite index was up 0.7 percent to 3,563.58. Nvidia led a thunderous rally Monday on Wall Street, where the S&P 500 surged 4.7 percent and recovered just over half its brutal loss from last week, one of the worst since the 2008 financial crisis . The Nasdaq composite jumped 6.5 percent, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up nearly 3 percent. Even before Wall Street opened for the day, trading in the futures market suggested U.S. stocks were set to halt the seven-day losing streak that had dragged the S&P 500 more than 10 percent below its all-time high set last month. Then came the bombshell about Huang’s return to Nvidia, even though its board is still investigating whether he was the target of a foreign spy and created any national-security concerns. Nvidia’s stock surged 31.5 percent and finished just shy of its best day since 2000, close to when the dot-com bubble peaked. That followed its plunge of nearly 23 percent last week. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 香港——随着黄仁勋重返Nvidia担任首席执行官，华尔街股市反弹带动亚洲股市走高，美国股指期货小幅上涨，油价则下跌。台湾加权指数领涨亚洲市场，涨幅超过9%，其中芯片相关股票Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp.和联发科上涨近10%。首尔韩国综合指数上涨6.5%，报5,014.41点；Samsung Electronics上涨7.5%，SK Hynix上涨8.6%。日本基准日经225指数上涨3.9%，报58,654.40点。电脑芯片设备制造商Tokyo Electron上涨10.5%，测试设备制造商Advantest飙升14.1%。Astris Advisory Japan董事总经理兼首席策略师Neil Newman表示：“在黄仁勋宣布重返NVIDIA担任首席执行官后，我们看到市场对 overnight 美股科技股反弹作出了反应。这显然是一个大意外，而且这一冲击也会波及亚洲。”Newman说。香港恒生指数小幅上涨0.2%，报22,432.45点；上证综合指数上涨0.7%，报3,563.58点。Nvidia带动华尔街周一强劲反弹，标普500指数飙升4.7%，收复了上周惨烈跌幅的一半多一点；上周是自2008年金融危机以来最糟糕的单周跌幅之一。纳斯达克综合指数跃升6.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨近3%。甚至在华尔街开盘前，期货市场交易就显示，美国股市有望结束连续七天的下跌；此前这轮跌势已令标普500指数较上月创下的历史高点下跌逾10%。随后，黄仁勋重返Nvidia的重磅消息传来，尽管Nvidia董事会仍在调查他是否为外国间谍的针对对象，以及此事是否引发任何国家安全担忧。Nvidia股价飙升31.5%，收盘时略低于2000年以来最佳单日表现，接近互联网泡沫达到顶峰的时期。此前一周，该股暴跌近23%。人工智能相关股票的走势对 workers 的401(k)账户至关重要，因为Nvidia和其他芯片股已成长为华尔街规模最大、影响力最强的一些股票。黄仁勋周一接受CNBC采访时表示：“我相信，我的干预对于说服Nvidia董事会让其联合创始人复职非常重要。”不到一周前，Nvidia还拒绝了黄仁勋提出的重返首席执行官职位的请求。Trump表示，他的政府已向Nvidia保证，黄仁勋回归不会引发国家安全担忧。债券市场上，10年期美国国债收益率从周五晚间的4.92%小幅升至4.93%。随着投资者认为没有必要再集中涌向被视为更安全的投资，收益率受到上行推动。布伦特原油价格下跌3.6%，报每桶$86.68。自美国和以色列于2月袭击伊朗以来，布伦特原油一直在$72至$114之间上下波动。周二早间的其他交易中，作为国际基准的布伦特原油价格下跌0.5%，报每桶$86.27。美国基准原油价格下跌0.3%，报每桶$79.90。美元兑日元从158.98日元降至158.92日元。欧元从$1.0911升至$1.0913

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: Governor Umo Eno of Akwa Ibom State has publicly acknowledged concerns about the performance of Clement Jimbo, the member representing Abak/Etim Ekpo/Ika Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives, but appealed to voters to re-elect him. Mr Eno made the appeal on Monday during the flag-off of the All Progressives Congress (APC) campaign in Ika Local Government Area of Akwa Ibom, where he called on the electorate to support Mr Jimbo despite what he described as concerns about the lawmaker’s performance. In an unusually candid appeal, the governor said he had been told that Mr Jimbo was “not doing well” but asked the people to vote for him, invoking their respect for political leaders and elders. “I learnt you (Clement Jimbo) are not doing well. But Ika people, please vote for him. What we have done today, let it cover him. Show the respect you people have for elders,” Mr Eno told the crowd. The governor’s intervention appeared to point to the political difficulty facing the lawmaker as he seeks a second term ahead of the 2027 general elections. Mr Eno first asked Mr Jimbo to come forward, saying he had heard complaints about his performance. He then handed the lawmaker over to Senate President Godswill Akpabio to raise his hand, before also presenting him to the Minister of State for Petroleum Resources (Gas), Ekperikpe Ekpo. The governor then explained why he believed the electorate should not reject the lawmaker, suggesting that Mr Jimbo had sought the backing of powerful political figures to secure his political future. “Vote for Clement Jimbo. We are saying someone used to hide under someone’s back and stand out. He has run and hidden behind the Senate president and the governor. He has run to embrace someone. He has run to embrace the minister,” he said. Using an illustration from childhood, Mr Eno likened the lawmaker’s political manoeuvring to a child seeking protection from another adult to escape punishment from his father. He argued that rejecting Mr Jimbo would embarrass the influential leaders whose support the lawmaker had sought. “He has run to hide behind the Senate president; will you disgrace the Senate president? He has run to hold the governor; will you disgrace your governor? He has run to hide behind the minister; will you disgrace the minister?” he asked. Mr Eno further told the gathering that he and other political leaders had intervened to address issues the lawmaker could not resolve on his own. “Ironing out issues is good. Now, what he cannot do, we have done,” he said. The governor’s appeal comes amid questions about Mr Jimbo’s representation and whether his record in the House of Representatives justifies another term. On 24 September, PREMIUM TIMES reported that Mr Jimbo faced apparent rejection at a political event in Etim Ekpo Local Government Area when APC chieftain and Senior Advocate of Nigeria, Emmanuel Enoidem, appealed to residents to support his return to the House of Representatives. The audience’s apparent resistance to Mr Enoidem’s appeal raised questions about the lawmaker’s acceptance in parts of his constituency, despite the backing of influential political figures. Governor Eno’s latest intervention in Ika suggests that persuading constituents to support Mr Jimbo’s second-term ambition remains a concern for the APC leadership in the federal constituency. Mr Jimbo’s performance has previously come under public scrutiny. In August 2025, PREMIUM TIMES reported that a constituent, Fabian Atang, publicly challenged the lawmaker to provide evidence of his achievements since assuming office. Mr Jimbo responded by listing several interventions, including the completion of a town hall in Abak, grading of the 10.8-kilometre Ediene/Etinan Road, construction of a solar-powered borehole, provision of school furniture, facilitation of a federal government job and business grants to constituents. He also cited his legislative activities and petitions on behalf of constituents. Mr Atang subsequently described the listed achievements as impressive but said more needed to be done, arguing that a good record of representation should speak for the lawmaker beyond political considerations. Mr Jimbo is serving his first term in the House of Representatives, having been elected in 2023 on the APC platform. PREMIUM TIMES could not immediately get a comment from the lawmaker as he did not respond to calls and text messages from our reporter
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: eno承认自己作为阿夸伊博姆州联邦议员表现不佳，恳请选民再次选举他
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 阿夸伊博姆州州长乌莫·埃诺公开承认，眾议员克莱门特·金博代表阿巴克/埃廷埃克波/伊卡联邦选区的工作表现引发了关注，但他同时呼吁选民再次选举金博。埃诺周一在阿夸伊博姆州伊卡地方政府为全进步大会党（APC）竞选活动鸣锣启动时发出这一呼吁。尽管他承认有关这位议员工作表现的担忧，他仍呼吁选民支持金博。埃诺在一次异常坦率的呼吁中说，有人告诉他金博“表现不佳”，但他仍请求民众投票支持他，并强调选民对政治领袖和长者的尊重。“我听说你（克莱门特·金博）表现不佳。但是，伊卡人民，请投他一票。我们今天所做的一切，就让它来遮护他吧。表现出你们对长者的尊重。”埃诺对人群说。州长的这番干预似乎表明，在2027年大选前，这位议员寻求连任时正面临政治困境。埃诺起初请金博上前，称自己听到了对其工作表现的抱怨。随后，他把这名议员交给参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿克帕比奥，让其举手接受支持，又把金博介绍给石油资源（天然气）国务部长埃克佩里克佩·埃克波。州长随后解释了他为何认为选民不应否决这位议员，并暗示金博曾寻求有影响力的政治人物支持，以保障自己的政治前途。“请投克莱门特·金博一票。我们的意思是，有人过去总躲在别人背后，如今却站出来了。他曾跑去躲在参议院议长和州长背后。他曾跑去拥抱某个人。他曾跑去拥抱部长。”他说。埃诺借童年往事举例，将这位议员在政治上的周旋比作一个孩子为逃避父亲惩罚而寻求另一位成年人庇护。他认为，否决金博会让那些议员曾寻求支持的有影响力领导人难堪。“他曾跑去躲在参议院议长背后；你们要让参议院议长蒙羞吗？他曾跑去依靠州长；你们要让州长蒙羞吗？他曾跑去躲在部长背后；你们要让部长蒙羞吗？”他问道。埃诺还告诉与会者，他和其他政治领导人已经出面处理这位议员无法独自解决的问题。“把问题理顺是好事。现在，他解决不了的事情，我们已经解决了。”他说。州长的呼吁正值外界质疑金博的代表能力，以及他在众议院的履职记录是否足以支持他再任一职之际。9月24日，PREMIUM TIMES报道称，在埃廷埃克波地方政府举行的一场政治活动中，APC党务负责人、尼日利亚资深法律顾问埃马纽埃尔·埃诺伊德姆呼吁居民支持金博重返众议院，听众显然抵制了埃诺伊德姆的呼吁。尽管有 influential 政治人物撑腰，这一反应仍引发了外界对金博在其选区部分地区是否获得接受的疑问。州长埃诺此次在伊卡的干预表明，说服选民支持金博连任竞选，仍是APC在联邦选区领导层面临的难题。金博的工作表现此前曾受到公众审视。2025年8月，PREMIUM TIMES报道称，一名叫法比安·阿唐的选民公开要求这位议员提供证据，说明其上任以来的成就。金博列举了多项工作，包括建成阿巴克一座市政厅、对10.8公里的埃迪埃内/埃蒂南公路进行整修、修建太阳能供电钻井站、提供学校家具，以及协助选民获得联邦政府就业机会和商业补助。他还列举了自己的立法活动，以及代表选民提出的请愿。阿唐随后称，所列成就令人印象深刻，但认为仍需做更多工作，并主张一份出色的履职记录应超越政治因素，为这位议员本身作出说明。金博正在众议院任职首个任期；他于2023年以APC平台参选并当选。PREMIUM TIMES未能立即获得这位议员的置评，因为他没有回复本报记者拨打的电话和发送的短信。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: South Korea will offer rewards of up to 500 million won ($370,888) for reporting cheating on the annual college entrance exam, the anti-corruption agency said Monday, as authorities step up efforts to crack down on cheating aided by artificial intelligence (AI). The government will offer 100 million won for each tip-off that leads to the detection of a cheating case, up to a maximum of 500 million won, according to the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC). Those who confess to cheating and report accomplices will also receive the full reward, while facing reduced penalties for their own misconduct, the commission said. "The measure is aimed at safeguarding the fairness and credibility of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) by encouraging the public to report cheating," it said. The commission is accepting reports of cheating through Jan. 19 as part of a two-month campaign. Last week, authorities said those caught cheating would be barred from taking the exam for 10 years and that rewards of up to 100 million won would be offered for reports of misconduct. The CSAT is the culmination of years of grueling studies for many students and is widely seen as a major life event in South Korea, where the university one goes to can heavily influence career prospects
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔将提供最高5亿韩元奖励，征集大学入学考试作弊线索
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国反-corruption机构星期一表示，将对举报年度大学入学考试作弊行为的举报人给予最高5亿韩元（370,888美元）的奖励，以配合当局打击借助人工智能（AI）作弊的行动。据反腐败与公民权利委员会（ACRC）称，政府将对每条导致查出作弊案件的线索给予1亿韩元奖励，奖励总额最高达5亿韩元。该委员会表示，主动承认作弊并举报同谋者的人也将获得全额奖励，同时其自身违法行为的处罚将从轻处理。该委员会说：“这项措施旨在通过鼓励公众举报作弊行为，维护大学修学能力试验（CSAT）的公平性和公信力。”作为一项为期两个月的宣传活动，该委员会受理作弊举报的截止日期为1月19日。上周，当局表示，被查出作弊者将被禁止参加考试10年，并对举报不当行为的案件给予最高1亿韩元奖励。大学修学能力试验是许多学生多年刻苦学习的 culminative成果，在韩国被广泛视为人生大事，因为就读哪所大学会显著影响职业前景

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — U.S.-traded shares of South Korean chipmaker SK hynix Inc. surged 20 percent Monday following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive officer (CEO) of U.S. artificial intelligence (AI) chip giant Nvidia Corp. SK hynix's American depositary receipts (ADRs), traded on the Nasdaq, jumped 20 percent, or $20.71, to finish at $124.28, according to market data. The sharp increase came after Nvidia announced Huang's reinstatement as CEO, a development that appeared to bolster investor confidence in the AI chipmaker and fuel buying interest in semiconductor-related stocks. Huang had been embroiled in a controversy over allegations that a Chinese businesswoman with whom he purportedly had an affair was working as an intelligence agent for Beijing. China has denied the espionage allegations. He subsequently stepped down as CEO. Nvidia, however, said Monday that its board of directors unanimously voted to reinstate Huang as president, CEO and a board member, effective immediately, following discussions with him. The company said the board also received input from senior U.S. government officials and was confident that his return posed no national security risk. SK hynix is a major supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips used in Nvidia's AI processors, making its shares particularly sensitive to developments involving the U.S. chip giant. The gains also marked a sharp rebound for SK hynix's U.S.-traded shares following recent volatility in technology and semiconductor stocks. SK hynix's ADRs closed at $103.57 in the previous trading session, according to market data. Huang's return as Nvidia CEO provided a much-needed boost for the overall U.S. stock market as well. The S&P 500 jumped 4.7 percent, while the Nasdaq and Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 6.5 percent and 3 percent, respectively. U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed Huang's reinstatement on social media, saying the Nvidia board had made "the correct and proper decision" to return the Nvidia founder to the CEO position. "Congratulations to Jensen, the NVIDIA Board, to the People of the United States -- and, indeed, the World!" Trump wrote on Truth Social

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——在美国交易的韩国芯片制造商SK海力士（SK hynix Inc.）股票周一上涨20%，此前美国人工智能芯片巨头英伟达（Nvidia Corp.）宣布恢复黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）首席执行官（CEO）职务。根据市场数据，SK海力士在纳斯达克交易的美国存托凭证（ADR）上涨20%，涨幅为20.71美元，收于124.28美元。这一大幅上涨发生在英伟达宣布黄仁勋复任CEO之后，此举似乎提振了投资者对这家人工智能芯片制造商的信心，并带动了对半导体相关股票的投资热情。此前，黄仁勋卷入一桩争议。相关指控称，一名据称与他有婚外情的中国女商人正在为北京充当情报特工。中国否认了这些间谍指控。黄仁勋随后辞去CEO职务。不过，英伟达周一表示，在与黄仁勋讨论后，其董事会一致投票决定立即恢复其总裁、CEO及董事职务。公司称，董事会还听取了美国政府高级官员的意见，并确信他回归不会构成国家安全风险。SK海力士是高带宽内存（HBM）芯片的主要供应商，这类芯片用于英伟达的人工智能处理器，因此其股价对涉及这家美国芯片巨头的动态尤为敏感。此次上涨也标志着SK海力士在美国交易的股票在科技和半导体板块近期波动后强劲反弹。根据市场数据，SK海力士的ADR在上一个交易时段收于103.57美元。黄仁勋复任英伟达CEO，也为美国整体股市注入了一股亟需的提振力量。标普500指数上涨4.7%，纳斯达克综合指数和道琼斯工业平均指数分别上涨6.5%和3%。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）在社交媒体上对黄仁勋复职表示欢迎，称英伟达董事会让这位英伟达创始人重返CEO职位是“正确且适当的决定”。特朗普在Truth Social上写道：“祝贺黄仁勋、NVIDIA董事会、美国人民——以及Indeed，全世界！”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-experts-j.body: A team of United States scientists visited Ghana to support efforts to tackle mercury pollution linked to illegal small-scale gold mining and strengthen freshwater protection. The delegation visited from November 7 to 21, bringing together specialists from the US Department of the Interior, the US Geological Survey (USGS) and the US Environmental Protection Agency. Their work focused on water quality monitoring, mercury detection, laboratory capacity and sustainable mining practices. The visit took place under the Ambassador’s Water Experts Program, a joint initiative of the US Departments of State and the Interior. During consultations with Ghana’s Environmental Protection Agency, the experts discussed mercury contamination in freshwater systems affected by galamsey. They also examined the need for standardised testing methods and closer scientific collaboration. The engagement builds on a 2024 baseline assessment by USGS scientist and former Embassy Science Fellow Dr Grace Armstrong. Her research identified elevated mercury levels in the waters and sediments of the Pra and Ankobra river systems. “The challenges posed by mercury pollution require coordinated scientific approaches and trusted partnerships,” she said. A two-day symposium on November 10 and 11 brought together US and Ghanaian experts, civil society organisations, academics and industry representatives. Held under the theme, “Addressing Mercury Pollution: Collaborative Solutions for Sustainable Mining in Ghana,” it examined the environmental, health and security effects of mercury use. Participants also explored practical and commercially viable mercury-free mining technologies. Speaking at the symposium, then US Chargé d’Affaires Rolf Olson said protecting freshwater resources was critical to Ghana’s future. “Protecting Ghana’s freshwater resources is essential not only for environmental and public health, but also for long-term economic and food security,” he said. US Environmental Protection Agency expert Dr Chris Eckley also highlighted the potential value of sharing technical experience. “Drawing on U.S. experience assessing and remediating mercury-contaminated sites could help our Ghanaian counterparts address local environmental challenges,” he said. The delegation engaged students, researchers, civil society organisations and youth groups on water protection, training and field research. Participating institutions included the University of Ghana, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, the University of Environment and Sustainable Development, and Accra STEM Academy. The exchanges aimed to improve the reliability of laboratory analyses and support the adoption of international best practices in water-quality monitoring and mercury detection
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-experts-j.title_zh: 美国专家加入加纳治理河流汞污染的行动
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-experts-j.body_zh: 一个由美国科学家组成的团队访问加纳，支持加纳治理与非法小规模采金相关的水银污染问题，并加强淡水保护。该代表团于11月7日至21日访问加纳，成员来自美国内政部、美国地质调查局（USGS）和美国环境保护署。他们的工作重点包括水质监测、水银检测、实验室能力建设和可持续采矿实践。此次访问通过“大使水专家项目”开展，这是美国国务院和内政部的一项联合倡议。专家团与加纳环境保护署磋商时，讨论了受非法小规模采金活动影响的淡水系统中的水银污染。他们还评估了推行标准化检测方法和加强科学合作的需要。此次合作以美国地质调查局科学家、前使馆科学研究员 Grace Armstrong 博士于2024年开展的基线评估为基础。她的研究发现，普拉河和安科布拉河水系及沉积物中的水银含量升高。她说：“水银污染带来的挑战需要协调一致的科学方法和值得信赖的合作伙伴关系。”11月10日至11日举行的一场两天期研讨会汇集了美国和加纳的专家、民间社会组织、学术界人士及行业代表。研讨会以“应对水银污染：加纳可持续采矿的协作解决方案”为主题，审视了使用水银对环境、健康和安全造成的影响。与会者还探讨了切实可行且具有商业价值的无水银采矿技术。时任美国 Chargé d’Affaires Rolf Olson 在研讨会上表示，保护淡水资源对加纳的未来至关重要。他说：“保护加纳的淡水资源不仅对环境和公共健康至关重要，也是实现长期经济安全和粮食安全的必要条件。”美国环境保护署专家 Chris Eckley 博士还强调，共享技术经验可能具有重要价值。他说：“借鉴美国评估和修复受水银污染场地的经验，可以帮助加纳同行应对本地环境挑战。”代表团还就水资源保护、培训和实地研究，与学生、研究人员、民间社会组织和青年团体开展交流。参与机构包括加纳大学、夸梅·恩克鲁玛科技大学、环境与可持续发展大学以及阿克拉 STEM 学院。这些交流旨在提高实验室分析的可靠性，并支持采用水质监测和水银检测领域的国际最佳实践

https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-exchange-.body: A 2019 Mandela Washington Fellow, Dr Joel Afi Duah, says it is becoming increasingly difficult for beneficiaries of development programs in the United States of America to access post-fellowship grants following donor cuts in the US. Dr. Duah, who is the municipal director of Health Services for Tano South in the Ahafo Region, says the situation has limited alumni efforts to translate knowledge and skills acquired through exchange programmes into practical development projects. He was speaking at the U.S. Embassy Ghana Exchange Alumni Summit in Kumasi. “With the cuts in funding, alumni are leveraging their networks and available resources to sustain their work. However, it has become quite difficult to plan and execute capital projects and meet other major expenses,” he said. He called on the government to increase funding for public institutions struggling with reductions and withdrawals in support from international development partners. He says funding cuts by organisations, including the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) and the United States African Development Foundation (USADF), have disrupted development programmes and weakened the capacity of institutions and beneficiaries to sustain ongoing initiatives. “We are therefore making a passionate appeal to the government to step up funding support in areas where donor funding has been reduced or withdrawn. This will enable us to build on the investments made and the knowledge and skills we have acquired through these fellowship programmes,” he asserted. Dr Duah believes increased government investment will be critical to sustaining the gains made through international partnerships and ensuring that development initiatives do not stall because of funding constraints. The appeal comes as the U.S. Embassy in Ghana brings together about 100 alumni of U.S. government exchange programmes from the Ashanti Region and Ghana’s middle belt for an Alumni Excellence Summit in Kumasi. The event, held on Saturday, November 21, 2026, celebrated the contributions of former exchange programme participants to national development across various sectors. It also forms part of activities marking the 250th anniversary of American independence under the Freedom 250 initiative. Cultural Affairs Attaché at the U.S. Embassy in Ghana, Donya Eldridge, said the exchange programmes are intended to promote knowledge-sharing and expose participants to approaches the US has adopted in addressing development challenges that Ghana also faces. “Our alumni include students and professionals who have had the opportunity to learn from experiences in the United States. The idea is to share what they have done, the lessons they have learned, and help us understand how similar approaches can work in the Ghanaian economy,” she stated
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-exchange-.title_zh: 美国交换生峰会：以往奖学金获得者难以获得结业后的资助，限制了知识转移申请
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-exchange-.body_zh: 2019年曼德拉·华盛顿研究员乔尔·阿菲·杜阿博士表示，随着美国捐助方削减资金，美国发展规划受益者在研究员访学结束后获得后续资助正变得越来越困难。杜阿博士是阿哈福地区塔诺南市卫生服务处主任。他说，处境困难限制了校友将交流项目中学到的知识和技能转化为实际发展项目。他在库马西举行的美国驻加纳使馆交流项目校友峰会上说：“随着资金削减，校友们正利用自己的人脉和现有资源维持工作。然而，规划和执行资本项目以及支付其他大额开支已变得相当困难。”他呼吁政府增加对公共机构的资助；这些机构正因国际发展伙伴削减或撤回支持而举步维艰。他说，包括美国国际开发署（USAID）和美国非洲发展基金会（USADF）在内的组织削减资金，已扰乱发展规划项目，并削弱了机构和受益者维持现有工作的能力。他断言：“因此，我们强烈呼吁政府增加对捐助资金已被削减或撤回领域的资金支持。这将使我们能够巩固已作出的投入，并利用我们通过这些研究员项目获得的知识和技能。”杜阿博士认为，增加政府投资对于维持国际伙伴关系带来的成果，以及确保发展规划项目不因资金受限而停滞至关重要。在美国驻加纳使馆于库马西举办杰出校友峰会、汇集约100名来自阿散蒂地区及加纳中部地带美国政府交流项目校友之际，这项呼吁也随之发出。活动于2026年11月21日星期六举行，旨在表彰前交流项目参与者对各领域国家发展所作的贡献。这也是“自由250”倡议下庆祝美国独立250周年系列活动的一部分。美国驻加纳使馆文化事务随员唐娅·埃尔德里奇说，这些交流项目旨在促进知识分享，让参与者了解美国在应对加纳同样面临的发展挑战时采用的方法。她表示：“我们的校友包括曾有机会向美国学习的学生和专业人士。我们的理念是分享他们的实践、他们吸取的经验，并帮助我们了解类似做法如何适用于加纳经济。”

https://x.com/ngmarketlens/status/212559.snippet:
🇺🇸 The US is opening another front in global trade tensions. But could Nigeria actually benefit from it?

The Trump administration has proposed new tariffs targeting 14 trading partners following a Section 301 investigation into industrial overcapacity, according to Reuters.

Among the proposed measures:

• China: An additional 20% tariff on top of existing first-term duties.
• Vietnam: A proposed 20% tariff.
• EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan: Existing 15% tariff caps to be respected.
• Malaysia: Existing 19% tariff cap to be respected.

Nigeria is not among the economies highlighted here, but that does not mean Nigeria is insulated from the consequences.

There are four important channels to watch.

1. Could imported goods become cheaper in Nigeria?

If Chinese manufacturers face higher barriers to the US market, some may redirect their products towards Africa and other emerging markets.

For Nigeria, this could mean more competitive prices for machinery, electronics, solar equipment, vehicles and industrial materials.

That could benefit consumers and businesses looking to reduce costs.

But there is another side to this.

An influx of competitively priced imports could put additional pressure on Nigerian manufacturers already struggling with expensive electricity, financing and logistics.

Cheaper imports can ease inflation while simultaneously making domestic industrial development more difficult.

2. Oil revenues and the naira

Escalating trade tensions could weaken global economic growth and reduce demand for crude oil.

For Nigeria, lower oil prices could translate into:

• Reduced export earnings.
• Lower government revenues.
• Weaker dollar inflows.
• Additional pressure on the naira.

And remember, cheaper Chinese products do not necessarily mean cheaper products in Nigerian shops if the naira weakens at the same time.

3. Global capital flows

If higher tariffs contribute to persistent US inflation, the Federal Reserve could keep interest rates higher for longer.

Combined with today’s hotter-than-expected US core PCE inflation, this is something Nigerian investors should be watching closely.

Higher US yields could make emerging-market assets less attractive to international investors, increasing competition for the foreign capital Nigeria needs.

4. A potential opportunity for Nigerian manufacturing

Global trade fragmentation is encouraging companies to reconsider where they manufacture, source materials and distribute their products.

Nigeria has a large domestic market, access to regional markets through AfCFTA, natural resources and expanding industrial capacity.

Could Nigeria attract some of the investment looking for alternative production locations?

Potentially, yes.

But investors will also compare electricity costs, infrastructure, regulatory predictability, financing conditions and logistics with competing destinations.

Market size alone will not be enough.

What I find particularly interesting here is the potential contradiction.

Nigeria could benefit from cheaper imported equipment while facing greater competition from imported finished goods.

The first could strengthen domestic production. The second could undermine it.

The difference will depend largely on how effectively Nigeria turns affordable industrial inputs into competitive local manufacturing.

Global trade tensions create risks, but they also redistribute economic opportunities.

For Nigeria, the bigger question is whether we can capture those opportunities as a producer, rather than simply becoming another destination for surplus global production.

https://x.com/ngmarketlens/status/212559.title_zh: 🇺🇸 美国正在全球贸易紧张局势中开辟另一条战线。
https://x.com/ngmarketlens/status/212559.snippet_zh:
🇺🇸 美国正在全球贸易紧张局势中开辟另一条战线。但尼日利亚真的能从中受益吗？

据路透社报道，特朗普政府在依据《贸易法》第301条对工业产能过剩展开调查后，提议对14个贸易伙伴加征新关税。

拟议措施包括：

• 中国：在现有首任期关税的基础上再加征20%关税。
• 越南：拟加征20%关税。
• 欧盟、日本、韩国和中国台湾：须遵守现行15%的关税上限。
• 马来西亚：须遵守现行19%的关税上限。

尼日利亚不在此次重点列出的经济体之列，但这并不意味着尼日利亚可以免受其影响。

有四条重要渠道值得关注。

1. 进口商品在尼日利亚会不会变得更便宜？

如果中国制造商进入美国市场面临更高壁垒，其中一些企业可能会将产品转向非洲及其他新兴市场。

对尼日利亚而言，这意味着机械、电子产品、太阳能设备、车辆和工业材料的价格可能更具竞争力。

这可能让希望降低成本的消费者和企业受益。

但事情还有另一面。

大量具有价格竞争力的进口商品涌入，可能进一步挤压尼日利亚制造商，而他们已经在高企的电费、融资成本和物流成本下艰难经营。

更便宜的进口商品可以缓解通胀，同时也会使本土工业发展更加困难。

2. 石油收入与奈拉

贸易紧张局势升级可能削弱全球经济增长，并降低原油需求。

对尼日利亚而言，油价下跌可能意味着：

• 出口收入减少。
• 政府收入下降。
• 美元流入减少。
• 奈拉承受更大压力。

此外还要记住，如果奈拉同时贬值，中国商品价格下降未必意味着尼日利亚商店里的商品也会变得更便宜。

3. 全球资本流动

如果更高关税助推美国通胀持续，美联储可能会更长时间维持较高利率。

结合目前高于预期的美国核心PCE通胀，这是尼日利亚投资者应当密切关注的因素。

美国收益率上升可能降低新兴市场资产对国际投资者的吸引力，从而加剧对尼日利亚所需外国资本的竞争。

4. 尼日利亚制造业的潜在机遇

全球贸易碎片化正促使企业重新考虑生产地点、原材料采购地和产品分销地。

尼日利亚拥有庞大的国内市场，可通过AfCFTA进入区域市场，并拥有自然资源和不断扩大的工业产能。

尼日利亚能否吸引部分寻求替代生产地点的投资？

有可能。

但投资者也会将当地的电力成本、基础设施、监管可预测性、融资条件和物流成本与其他目的地进行比较。

仅凭市场规模并不足够。

我觉得这里尤其值得关注的是一种潜在矛盾。

尼日利亚既可能从更便宜的进口设备中受益，又将面临进口制成品带来的更大竞争。

前者可以增强国内生产，后者则可能削弱国内生产。

最终结果在很大程度上取决于尼日利亚能否高效地将价格可负担的工业投入品转化为具有竞争力的本地制造业。

全球贸易紧张局势会带来风险，但也会重新分配经济机遇。

对尼日利亚而言，更大的问题在于，我们能否以生产国的身份把握这些机遇，而不是仅仅成为全球过剩产能的另一个销售目的地。

https://x.com/onibudoireke/status/212556.title: Five years after the Federal Executive Council signed off on nearly $3 billion to fix Nigeria’s state-owned refineries, sustained commercial
https://x.com/onibudoireke/status/212556.snippet:
Five years after the Federal Executive Council signed off on nearly $3 billion to fix Nigeria’s state-owned refineries, sustained commercial petrol production from those plants remains out of reach. Port Harcourt briefly restarted in late 2024 before shutting down months later. Warri reopened shortly afterward and went offline again over operational and safety concerns. Today, Nigerians are right back where they started, asking what public value was delivered for one of the largest rehabilitation commitments in our history.

On paper, the 2021 approvals alone were staggering. The federal government approved $1.5 billion for the Port Harcourt refinery contract awarded to Maire Tecnimont, alongside $897.68 million for Warri and $586.90 million for Kaduna, initially announced for Saipem with Daewoo E&C later brought in on quick-fix packages. Together, those approvals came to $2.985 billion. At today’s official CBN rate of roughly ₦1,394 to the dollar, that commitment equals about ₦4.16 trillion in present-day terms, sitting atop wider Turnaround Maintenance spending between 2010 and 2023 that legislative inquiries and analysts have estimated in the tens of billions of dollars.

To be fair to the record, approved contract ceilings are not the same thing as verified cash disbursements. Nor was the naira trading at today’s rate in 2021. Yet that gap in public knowledge is precisely the problem. Years down the line, taxpayers still do not have a consolidated, line-by-line public account showing how much was actually released, what engineering milestones were independently certified, and why the plants could not stay on stream. Energy analysts have long pointed out that sums of this magnitude approach what it takes to finance modern, purpose-built refining capacity from the ground up.

That history makes an older, unresolved industry story from the Buhari administration worth revisiting. According to unconfirmed industry accounts, Chinese energy giant Sinopec approached NNPC during that period with an offer to repair, restore, and help run the Warri and Port Harcourt refineries, before decision-makers opted for another route. There is no public document proving that a formal offer landed on NNPC’s desk, and NNPC Ltd can easily put the matter to rest by stating whether one was ever received and why it did or did not advance.

The question matters because credentials in heavy industry matter. Sinopec is the world’s largest refiner by capacity, processing roughly 5 million barrels of crude a day. That is more than eleven times the 445,000 barrels per day combined nameplate capacity of Port Harcourt, Warri, and Kaduna. Through Sinopec Engineering Group, it has executed complex refinery builds and revamps from Saudi Arabia’s Yasref complex to Algeria’s Hassi Messaoud and Arzew projects. In global refining, Sinopec commands the sort of engineering reputation that Nigerians associate with Julius Berger in major road and civil infrastructure.

Which brings us to April 30, 2026. In Jiaxing City, China, NNPC Ltd signed a fresh Memorandum of Understanding for a potential Technical Equity Partnership covering Port Harcourt and Warri. Only this time, the prospective partners were not a global refining major like Sinopec, but two private Chinese firms: Sanjiang Chemical Company Limited and Xinganchen (Fuzhou) Industrial Park Operation and Management Co. Ltd.

Almost immediately, voices in Nigeria’s organised private sector raised eyebrows. Critics, including former Organised Private Sector of Nigeria (OPSN) president Dele Oye, publicly questioned whether companies profiled mainly around chemical manufacturing and industrial park real estate possess a verifiable track record of rehabilitating and operating complex crude oil refineries.

NNPC Ltd has stressed that the April MoU is only a preliminary framework. If that is the case, there is still room to get this right before binding equity or operating contracts are signed.

Before Nigeria enters another chapter of refinery promises, four things ought to happen in full view of the public:

First, NNPC Ltd should publish a comprehensive financial and technical audit of all refinery rehabilitation contracts since 2010, detailing what was approved, what was actually paid out, and what work was independently certified.

Second, NNPC Ltd and the project contractors should give Nigerians a clear status report on contractual deliverables completed and any obligations still outstanding on the 2021 awards.

Third, NNPC Ltd should clarify once and for all whether Sinopec or other tier-one international refiners ever submitted proposals for our refineries, and how those proposals were assessed.

Fourth, the technical and financial due diligence on Sanjiang and Xinganchen should be made public alongside clear, competitive selection benchmarks before any binding deal is sealed.

Nigeria’s refining crisis has never been caused by a lack of crude, market demand, or capable global engineers. https://x.com/onibudoireke/status/212556.body:
Five years after the Federal Executive Council signed off on nearly $3 billion to fix Nigeria’s state-owned refineries, sustained commercial petrol production from those plants remains out of reach. Port Harcourt briefly restarted in late 2024 before shutting down months later. Warri reopened shortly afterward and went offline again over operational and safety concerns. Today, Nigerians are right back where they started, asking what public value was delivered for one of the largest rehabilitation commitments in our history.

On paper, the 2021 approvals alone were staggering. The federal government approved $1.5 billion for the Port Harcourt refinery contract awarded to Maire Tecnimont, alongside $897.68 million for Warri and $586.90 million for Kaduna, initially announced for Saipem with Daewoo E&C later brought in on quick-fix packages. Together, those approvals came to $2.985 billion. At today’s official CBN rate of roughly ₦1,394 to the dollar, that commitment equals about ₦4.16 trillion in present-day terms, sitting atop wider Turnaround Maintenance spending between 2010 and 2023 that legislative inquiries and analysts have estimated in the tens of billions of dollars.

To be fair to the record, approved contract ceilings are not the same thing as verified cash disbursements. Nor was the naira trading at today’s rate in 2021. Yet that gap in public knowledge is precisely the problem. Years down the line, taxpayers still do not have a consolidated, line-by-line public account showing how much was actually released, what engineering milestones were independently certified, and why the plants could not stay on stream. Energy analysts have long pointed out that sums of this magnitude approach what it takes to finance modern, purpose-built refining capacity from the ground up.

That history makes an older, unresolved industry story from the Buhari administration worth revisiting. According to unconfirmed industry accounts, Chinese energy giant Sinopec approached NNPC during that period with an offer to repair, restore, and help run the Warri and Port Harcourt refineries, before decision-makers opted for another route. There is no public document proving that a formal offer landed on NNPC’s desk, and NNPC Ltd can easily put the matter to rest by stating whether one was ever received and why it did or did not advance.

The question matters because credentials in heavy industry matter. Sinopec is the world’s largest refiner by capacity, processing roughly 5 million barrels of crude a day. That is more than eleven times the 445,000 barrels per day combined nameplate capacity of Port Harcourt, Warri, and Kaduna. Through Sinopec Engineering Group, it has executed complex refinery builds and revamps from Saudi Arabia’s Yasref complex to Algeria’s Hassi Messaoud and Arzew projects. In global refining, Sinopec commands the sort of engineering reputation that Nigerians associate with Julius Berger in major road and civil infrastructure.

Which brings us to April 30, 2026. In Jiaxing City, China, NNPC Ltd signed a fresh Memorandum of Understanding for a potential Technical Equity Partnership covering Port Harcourt and Warri. Only this time, the prospective partners were not a global refining major like Sinopec, but two private Chinese firms: Sanjiang Chemical Company Limited and Xinganchen (Fuzhou) Industrial Park Operation and Management Co. Ltd.

Almost immediately, voices in Nigeria’s organised private sector raised eyebrows. Critics, including former Organised Private Sector of Nigeria (OPSN) president Dele Oye, publicly questioned whether companies profiled mainly around chemical manufacturing and industrial park real estate possess a verifiable track record of rehabilitating and operating complex crude oil refineries.

NNPC Ltd has stressed that the April MoU is only a preliminary framework. If that is the case, there is still room to get this right before binding equity or operating contracts are signed.

Before Nigeria enters another chapter of refinery promises, four things ought to happen in full view of the public:

First, NNPC Ltd should publish a comprehensive financial and technical audit of all refinery rehabilitation contracts since 2010, detailing what was approved, what was actually paid out, and what work was independently certified.

Second, NNPC Ltd and the project contractors should give Nigerians a clear status report on contractual deliverables completed and any obligations still outstanding on the 2021 awards.

Third, NNPC Ltd should clarify once and for all whether Sinopec or other tier-one international refiners ever submitted proposals for our refineries, and how those proposals were assessed.

Fourth, the technical and financial due diligence on Sanjiang and Xinganchen should be made public alongside clear, competitive selection benchmarks before any binding deal is sealed.

Nigeria’s refining crisis has never been caused by a lack of crude, market demand, or capable global engineers. It stems from opaque procurement and a habit of moving on to the next announcement without accounting for the last one. Public assets belong to the Nigerian people, and asking for audited facts is the bare minimum of democratic accountability.

https://x.com/onibudoireke/status/212556.snippet_zh:
联邦执行委员会批准近30亿美元用于修缮尼日利亚国有炼油厂已过去五年，这些炼油厂持续实现商业化汽油生产仍遥不可及。哈特科特港炼油厂在2024年底短暂复产，数月后又停产。瓦里炼油厂不久后重新开工，却因运营和安全方面的疑虑再次停摆。如今，尼日利亚人又回到了原点，追问我国历史上最大规模的修缮承诺之一，究竟交付了多少公共价值。

仅从账面看，2021年的批准金额就十分惊人。联邦政府批准了15亿美元用于哈特科特港炼油厂合同，该合同授予Maire Tecnimont；同时批准瓦里炼油厂8.9768亿美元、卡杜纳炼油厂5.869亿美元，后者最初宣布授予Saipem，后来引入大宇E&C承接快速修复项目。这些批准金额合计达29.85亿美元。按尼日利亚中央银行目前约1,394奈拉兑1美元的官方汇率计算，这笔承诺按今天的水平约合4.16万亿奈拉，而这一切还叠加在2010年至2023年间更大规模的周转维护支出之上——立法调查和分析人士估计这部分支出达数百亿美元。

公平地说，已批准的合同上限并不等于经核实的现金拨付。2021年时奈拉的汇率也不是今天的水平。然而，正是在公共认知上的这一落差构成了问题。时至今日，纳税人仍无法获得一份整合的、逐项列明的公开账目，说明实际拨付了多少资金、哪些工程节点获得了独立认证，以及这些炼油厂为何无法持续运行。能源分析人士早就指出，这一量级的资金已接近从头建设现代化专用炼油能力所需的投入。

这段历史让布赫里政府时期一桩悬而未决、值得重提的行业旧事重新引人关注。据未经证实的行业说法，中国能源巨头中国石化当时曾接触尼日利亚国家石油公司，提出修复、翻新并协助运营瓦里和哈特科特港两座炼油厂，之后决策者选择了另一条路。没有公开文件能证明正式报价曾送达尼日利亚国家石油公司的案头，而尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司只需说明是否曾收到过此类报价、为何推进或不推进，便可轻易了结此事。

之所以重要，是因为重工业领域的资质至关重要。中国石化是全球按产能计最大的炼油企业，每日加工约500万桶原油。这比哈特科特港、瓦里和卡杜纳三厂合计44.5万桶/日的铭牌产能高出十一倍以上。通过中国石化工程集团，中国石化已完成从沙特Yasref综合体到阿尔及利亚Hassi Messaoud和Arzew项目等复杂炼油新建与改造工程。在全球炼油领域，中国石化拥有尼日利亚人常与朱利叶斯·伯杰在大型道路和土木基础设施上相提并论的那种工程声誉。

这就引出了2026年4月30日。在中国嘉兴市，尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司签署了一份新的谅解备忘录，涉及哈特科特港和瓦里炼油厂的潜在技术股权伙伴关系。只是这一次，潜在伙伴并非中国石化这样的全球炼油巨头，而是两家中国民营企业：浙江三江化工股份有限公司和兴安晨（福州）工业园运营管理有限公司。

几乎是立刻，尼日利亚有组织的私营部门就提出了质疑。批评者包括尼日利亚有组织私营部门前主席Dele Oye，他们公开质疑：主要业务集中于化工制造和工业园地产的公司，是否具备修缮并运营复杂原油炼油厂的可核实业绩记录。

尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司强调，4月的谅解备忘录只是一个初步框架。如果确实如此，那么在签署具有约束力的股权或运营合同之前，仍有空间把事情做对。

在尼日利亚开启又一轮炼油厂承诺之前，有四件事应当在公众注视下完成：

第一，尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司应公布一份涵盖2010年以来所有炼油厂修缮合同的综合性财务与技术审计报告，详细说明批准了什么、实际支付了多少、哪些工程获得了独立认证。

第二，尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司和项目承包商应向尼日利亚人提交一份清晰的状态报告，说明2021年批准项目中已完成的合同交付内容以及仍未履行的义务。

第三，尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司应彻底澄清，中国石化或其他一流国际炼油企业是否曾就我国炼油厂提交过方案，以及这些方案是如何评估的。

第四，在敲定任何具有约束力的交易之前，应公开对浙江三江和兴安晨的技术与财务尽职调查，并同时公布明确、具竞争性的遴选基准。

尼日利亚的炼油危机从来不是由原油短缺、市场需求不足或缺乏称职的全球工程师造成的。它根源在不透明的采购，以及在未对上一次公告作出交代的情况下就转向下一次公告的惯性与做法。公共资产属于尼日利亚人民，索取经审计的事实不过是民主问责的最低要求。

https://x.com/instablog9ja/status/212554.snippet:
Nigeria Is Not A Dumping Ground — Senator Ben Murray-Bruce Calls For Stricter Regulations To Protect Nigerian Consumers

Senator Ben Murray-Bruce has called on the Federal Government to introduce stricter regulations to protect Nigerian consumers from companies selling products without proper warranties, spare parts and after-sales services.

He raised concerns over foreign car brands, particularly Chinese manufacturers, opening showrooms in major cities such as Lagos and Abuja, only to shut down and leave customers stranded without access to repairs or replacement parts.

Sharing his personal experience, Murray-Bruce said he invested in a solar power system for his home, but the company that installed it went bankrupt and left Nigeria within a year, rendering his investment useless because there was no one to service it.

He described the situation as exploitation rather than trade, insisting that companies operating in Nigeria must demonstrate their capacity to provide long-term support for the products they sell.

He urged the Minister of Industry, Trade and Investment, Dr Jumoke Oduwole, and the Minister of State for Industry, Senator John Owan Enoh, to establish stricter entry requirements for companies seeking to operate in the Nigerian market.

He also called on the National Automotive Design and Development Council, the Standards Organisation of Nigeria and the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission to ensure that dealerships are properly licensed, substandard products are kept out of the country and consumers are protected.

On solar power systems and inverters, Murray-Bruce urged the Minister of Power, Joseph Tegbe, to insist that only certified installers with long-term service commitments operate in the sector.

Among his proposed measures, he suggested that companies should provide financial bonds, guarantee spare parts and after-sales services for a minimum number of years, and establish local service centres before selling their products.

He further proposed that dealerships that shut down within five years of operating should be held accountable, with their directors pursued and affected customers compensated.

Concluding his message, he stressed that Nigeria’s market of more than 200 million people should not be treated as a dumping ground for products and companies that cannot provide lasting support to consumers.

https://x.com/instablog9ja/status/212554.title_zh: 尼日利亚不是倾销地——参议员Ben Murray-Bruce呼吁加强监管，保护尼日利亚消费者；参议员Ben Murray-B
https://x.com/instablog9ja/status/212554.snippet_zh:
尼日利亚不是倾销地——参议员本·默里-布鲁斯呼吁加强监管，保护尼日利亚消费者
参议员本·默里-布鲁斯呼吁联邦政府出台更严格的监管措施，防止向消费者销售产品却不提供适当保修、备件和售后服务的公司损害消费者利益。
他对外来汽车品牌，尤其是中国制造商在拉各斯、阿布贾等主要城市开设展厅，随后关闭门店并让客户陷入困境、无法获得维修或更换零部件服务的情况表示担忧。
默里-布鲁斯分享了自己的亲身经历：他曾为家中投资安装太阳能供电系统，但负责安装的公司在一年内破产并离开尼日利亚，使其投资变得毫无用处，因为已无人能够提供维护服务。
他将这种局面描述为剥削而非贸易，坚持在尼日利亚经营的公司必须证明其有能力为所售产品提供长期支持。
他敦促工业、贸易与投资部长朱莫克·奥杜沃莱博士，以及工业部国务参议员约翰·奥万·埃诺赫，为寻求进入尼日利亚市场的公司制定更严格的准入要求。
他还呼吁尼日利亚汽车设计与开发委员会、尼日利亚标准组织和联邦竞争与消费者保护委员会，确保经销商取得适当许可、不合格产品被阻挡在国门外，并保护消费者权益。
谈及太阳能供电系统和逆变器，默里-布鲁斯敦促电力部长约瑟夫·特格贝坚持要求该行业仅由承诺提供长期服务的认证安装商经营。
在提出的措施中，他建议公司在销售产品之前缴纳财务保证金、保证在一定最低年限内提供备件和售后服务，并设立本地服务中心。
他进一步建议，对开业五年内关停的经销商追究责任，追究其董事责任，并赔偿受影响的消费者。
他在结束发言时强调，拥有超过2亿人口的市场尼日利亚，不应成为无法为消费者提供持久支持的产品和公司的倾销地。

https://x.com/1thinkingafrica/status/212.title: For over a century, the world has played the same trick on Africa: dig up the rock, ship it out cheap - and sell back the finished product a
https://x.com/1thinkingafrica/status/212.snippet:
For over a century, the world has played the same trick on Africa: dig up the rock, ship it out cheap - and sell back the finished product at ten times the price. With just weeks to go before Zimbabwe's full ban on lithium concentrate exports hits on 1 January 2027, Harare is refusing to blink.

In mid-November, mining companies lobbied for a delay, warning that enforcing the deadline could leave 1.4-million tonnes of unprocessed concentrate sitting in stockpiles. Zim's answer was blunt - instead of backing down, Finance Minister Mthuli Ncube tightened the 10% export tax rules on raw concentrate and mandated local sourcing, while keeping processed lithium sulphate exports completely tax free.

The standoff rests on real proof of concept. At the Arcadia mine outside Harare, a $400-million processing plant run by Prospect Lithium Zimbabwe - a subsidiary of China's Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt - began Africa's first commercial exports of lithium sulphate in April 2026. Between April and September alone, Zimbabwe shipped 33,807 tonnes of the battery-grade precursor (worth roughly $190 million) as the 50,000-tonne facility ramps up.

What started with Zimbabwe banning raw lithium ore exports back in 2022 - followed by a June 2025 notice to end concentrate exports and an abrupt February 2026 crackdown on illegal shipments - has forced miners to build on African soil. Rival Chinese giants Sinomine and Sichuan Yahua are now racing to finish their own sulphate plants at Bikita and Kamativi, with industry forecasts projecting Zimbabwe's output to surge to 208,000 tonnes in 2027.

Zim is not acting alone. Since 2023, roughly 14 African governments - including Burkina Faso, DRC, Gabon, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Namibia and Tanzania - have moved to restrict raw ore exports, suspend or overhaul mining licences, or mandate domestic refining.

But the hard sovereignty test still lies ahead. Foreign firms still own the plants, and lithium sulphate is only the middle rung of the battery supply chain. True economic liberation means using leverage like Harare's January deadline to capture local skills, power infrastructure and eventually African-owned refining all the way to finished batteries.

Is holding the line on raw export bans the turning point for African industrialisation - or does the continent need to push even harder for local ownership?

https://x.com/1thinkingafrica/status/212.title_zh: 一个多世纪以来，世界对非洲始终使用同一套把戏：低价挖出矿石并运走，再把制成品高价卖回非洲
https://x.com/1thinkingafrica/status/212.snippet_zh: 一个多世纪以来，世界一直对非洲施展同一套把戏：挖出矿石，低价运走，再以十倍的价钱卖回成品。距离津巴布韦全面禁止锂精矿出口的规定于2027年1月1日生效只剩数周，哈拉雷却拒绝退让。  11月中旬，矿业公司游说政府推迟实施，警告称若按期执行，可能导致140万吨未加工精矿堆存在库存中。津巴布韦的回应十分强硬。财政部长姆图利·恩库布不但没有退缩，反而收紧了针对原矿精矿的10%出口税规定， mandate 强制实行本地采购，同时对已加工硫酸锂的出口继续完全免税。  这场对峙有真实的概念验证作为支撑。在哈拉雷郊外的Arcadia矿，由中国浙江华友钴业子公司Prospect Lithium Zimbabwe运营的一座价值4亿美元加工厂，于2026年4月开始非洲首次商业出口硫酸锂。随着这座5万吨产能设施逐步满产，仅4月至9月间，津巴布韦便出口了33,807吨电池级硫酸锂前驱体，价值约1.9亿美元。  津巴布韦从2022年禁止原矿锂出口开始，随后在2025年6月发布终止精矿出口的通知，并于2026年2月突然严厉打击非法运输，迫使矿业企业在非洲本土建设工厂。中国竞争对手Sinomine和Sichuan Yahua目前正竞相完成各自位于Bikita和Kamativi的硫酸锂工厂。行业预测显示，津巴布韦的产量到2027年将激增至208,000吨。  津巴布韦并非独自行动。自2023年以来，包括Burkina Faso、DRC、Gabon、Ghana、Kenya、Malawi、Namibia和Tanzania在内的约14个非洲政府，已采取限制原矿出口、暂停或整顿采矿许可证，或强制要求国内精炼等措施。  但真正考验主权的时刻仍在前方。外国企业目前仍拥有这些工厂，而硫酸锂不过是电池供应链的中间一环。真正的经济解放，是利用哈拉雷设定的一月最后期限这一筹码，将本地技能、电力基础设施，乃至最终由非洲企业拥有的精炼产能和成品电池生产环节掌握在自己手中。  坚持执行原矿出口禁令，会成为非洲工业化的转折点吗？还是说，这片大陆需要进一步推动本地所有权？

https://x.com/africanhub_/status/2125312.snippet:
A Chinese businessman named Zheng Xiangming just got a traditional chieftaincy title in Ghana for the money he’s put into the country and the jobs he’s created.

On Friday, August 28, 2026, he was enstooled as Hiowe Golaka Noryam Matse Nene Asumahtsu I at Bright International Industrial Park in Greater Accra. Before the actual ceremony, the local kingmakers even carried him around on their shoulders in celebration.

He’s been investing there since 2011, putting money into commercial hubs and a tourist amusement park that have together created thousands of jobs for local people.

https://x.com/nigeriastories/status/2125.snippet:
Governor Alex Otti has declared Abia State’s readiness to partner with China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (CHEC) on the full development of the proposed Abia Sea Port City — from feasibility studies through construction to final delivery.

https://x.com/nigeriastories/status/2125.snippet_zh:
阿比亚州州长亚历克斯·奥蒂宣布，阿比亚州已准备与China Harbour Engineering Company Limited（CHEC）合作，全面开发拟建的阿比亚海港城，合作内容涵盖可行性研究、建设和最终交付。
